# Flow: Stocks (`stocks`)

> One self-contained file for converting this flow to another platform. Read https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/CONVERT.md first. Design system: Lemonnade V3 @ `6de43c8` (components, tokens and rules: https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonnade-v3-docs/llms.txt).

The Stocks tab — the home after login: indices, holdings, products, movers, watchlists, ideas.

Prototype: https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/#/stocks · machine-readable: https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/stocks.json

## Spec (README.md)


> The spec for this flow. A developer should be able to build it on any platform (Flutter, iOS, web) from this file,
> the screens in this folder and the live app — without reading the rest of the repo.

- **Prototype:** https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/#/stocks · one screen: `#/stocks-01`
- **Source:** screenshots of the live app's Stocks tab (dark theme), shared 2026-10-17 — there's no Figma for it yet.
  Rebuilt in L3.
- **Status:** 🟨 Home done (re-matched to the live app over ADB, 2026-10-22); search is its own flow (`search`), opened from the top bar (stock page and lists come next) · 2026-10-19
- **Entry:** the app's home: after login (returning user), after account setup ("Explore stocks first"), after the
  first deposit ("Start investing"); the Stocks tab of the main navbar. **Exit:** everything on the page opens its
  own screen (not built yet).

### Page structure (top to bottom)

1. **Top bar (sticky, this screen's own — not the L3 Actionbar):** profile initials (34, opens Profile) · search pill
   (38, opens Search) · Wallet (38). 16 at the sides, 12 between. No DASH pill here (DASH is entered from the F&O
   home only, 2026-11-01). Tapping the search field opens Search
   (`search-01`, the Search flow: Stocks tab, keyboard up); nothing is typed on Home. Back on Search returns here.
2. **Summary area** (grey, `surface/secondary`):
   - **Index strip** (scrolls sideways): NIFTY 50 / SENSEX / NIFTY BANK — value, day change; each opens its chart.
   - **IN Stocks holdings:** the value (the page's biggest number) and the overall return; the card opens Portfolio →
     Holdings on the Indian holdings (`us-stocks-05`).
   - **Products** (V8, V12, V13 — Figma 10303:27156): MF (240+ Funds) · F&O (Scalper mode) · Commodity (0 Brokerage) ·
     Smart invest (Scalper mode — Figma's copy, likely a placeholder; the tap scrolls to the Smart Invest section).
     More than three tiles: 112 each, scrolling; three or fewer fill the row. Figma's NEW tag on Commodity is hidden
     for now (the lime NEW style is ready for any tile with `isNew`).
3. **IN Stocks / US Stocks tabs** (a 40 strip between the summary and the feed; it pulls 24 up into the summary's
   bottom padding, so it adds exactly 40 to the page). The selected tab is notched and joins the feed below (an SVG
   outline slides between the two tabs); the US label flips between "US Stocks" and "Live till 2:30 AM". Tap a tab or
   swipe the page sideways to switch **in place** (the feed slides in from the side; the index strip shows the other
   market's indices). Holdings and product cards stay the same on both tabs. Once the strip has scrolled away, a compact
   **IND / US underline tab bar** (L3 Tabs, `width="fill"`) is pinned under the top bar (TopBar `bottom` slot) in the
   strip's place; tapping it switches tab and starts that feed at the top. The top bar itself never hides.
4. **Feed — IND tab** on a sheet whose top edge is the tabs strip's line (the rounded top / overlap it had before the tabs
   is gone), sections 32 apart:
   - **Do more with Lemonn** (no heading — the four shortcuts start the feed): Trade ideas · IPO ("8 new") · Watchlist (count) · Refer & earn ("New").
   - **Top movers:** chips Top gainers / Top losers / Under ₹100 → two rows of stock cards (logo, symbol, price,
     change). View all.
   - **Watchlist:** the user's watchlists (name, stock count). New watchlist.
   - **Smart Invest** (brand tint): strategy cards — name, min. deposit, last week's daily results, AUM, slots left;
     footer: monthly charges (₹0, was ₹300) and Invest now. Tag "NSE/BSE approved".
   - **Announcements:** the campaign's artwork (one banner, the whole banner opens it — live: Jio Platforms IPO).
   - **Invest in sectors:** sector cards — stock count and the day's change. View all.
   - **Highlights:** Mutual funds (tax saving: up to ₹46,800 a year) · F&O (Nifty 50 today).
   - **Invest in ideas:** baskets — their stocks' logos, name, count.
   - **Disclosure:** the broker's registration line, four lines, then "Read More" opens it in place.
5. **Feed — US tab** (same sheet, sections 28 apart; made up, from the US Stocks flow's Home). The card on top follows
   `usState` (`Home` prop, default `'activate'`):
   - **Activation card** (`components/us/UsActivationCard.tsx`, one `CardSpec` per state in `components/us/data.ts`):
     `activate` — blue, "Activate US Stocks / Takes under a minute", rotating benefits strip (Fractional · Diversify · No
     new KYC, every 3 s, with dots), Large primary button → activation pages (`us-stocks-94`) · `review` — honey, hourglass,
     "Activation under review / up to 1 working day", strip, no button · `failed` — red, error icon, "Your PAN details could
     not be verified", Retry Activation · `activated` — green, "Add money to buy your first US stock", strip (5,000+ ·
     Fractional · Evening), Add Money to US wallet · `ready` — green with a tick badge, "Your money is ready / $1,035.37
     added to your US wallet", Explore US Stocks (arrow); the same words also come as a floating **Aerobar toast** above the
     navbar that times out after 6 s · `holding` — **no card**; the holdings summary shows "US holdings" in dollars
     ($1,500.25, +12.4%) instead of "Current holdings" (same block, same size).
   - **Do More With Lemonn:** Analysis · ETFs · Watchlist · Referral (the IND shortcuts component; none opens anything yet).
   - **Top Movers:** View all → Market (`market-10`) on the US list with the picked cap + gainers / losers; a cap chip
     (Mega / Large / Mid / Small, cycles) + pill tabs (Top Gainers, Top Losers, Most Active, 52W High, 52W Low) → five
     rows (logo, name, symbol, price, change); a row opens the US stock page (`us-stocks-13`).
   - **Trillion Dollar Titans:** eight 170-wide cards (logo, name, sparkline, market cap, change); View all → Market,
     mega caps, biggest first.
   - **Brands You Know:** two rows of brand cards, as Top Movers' cards on the India tab (logo, name, today's price, today's move).
   - **Explore by themes:** a sideways rail (about 1.4 cards across, the next one peeks in) of six big theme cards. Each is an
     L3 Card: a 3 × 2 collage of real logos (Avatar 40), the name (Label 16), a two-line description (Description 12) and
     its 1Y return, "N stocks" with a chevron. Tapping one opens the Themes page on that theme (`stocks-23` … `28`, below); the section's View all opens it on the first. Leveraged ETFs is not a theme for now.
   - **Themes page** (`screens/ThemePage.tsx`), laid out like the ETFs page: the Actionbar holds back and "Themes" with
     every theme as a pill tab in its bottom slot (sticky, scrolls sideways), so switching theme never leaves the page.
     Under the tabs, for the picked theme: its description and the disclaimer in a flat Aerobar, the Returns card, then
     its 6 to 8 stocks as `StockListCard`s, 12 apart (live price, day change); a stock → its US stock page (`us-stocks-13`,
     `viewUsStock` first). Back returns to the screen before.
     Themes: AI & chips, Big Tech, Dividend payers, EV & clean energy, Healthcare leaders, Dollar parking (steady large
     caps, since ETFs have no logos in the shared assets yet). Symbols are in `themes` (`components/us/data.ts`); name and
     description are copy `us.theme.<id>` / `.desc`. The opening theme is chosen by the screen id (`themeScreenId(id)`); the tabs switch in place.
6. **Main navbar:** Stocks (selected) · Market · Portfolio · Mutual Fund · F&O.

#### Two homes (V10–V13, no Figma yet)

V1–V9 only swap the feed: the holdings and the product tiles above the switch stay Indian, so the US tab reads as a
section of the Indian home. The business wants the two markets kept apart, so V10–V13 split the app at the top
(`scope: 'page'` in `homeVersions.ts`): **the market is picked first, and everything under the top bar belongs to it.**

- **Whole page per market.** Ticker (NIFTY / SENSEX ↔ S&P 500 / NASDAQ), summary, tiles, feed and search
  ("Search US stocks") all change. The US summary leads with the activation card while there is one (it moves up from
  the feed), else the US holdings in $. US tiles: ETFs (3x leveraged) · Fractional (from $1) · Market hours (8 PM to
  2:30 AM); ETFs opens the ETF list, the others Market on the US list.
- **The switch never scrolls away.** V10 / V11 carry it in the sticky block above the ticker; V12 / V13 in the top bar,
  which then never slides away on scroll (also V5, whose switch is in the bar): scrolled, it stays and turns surface/primary.
- **Search is a round icon button** like the wallet (TopBar `compactSearch`), so the top bar has room for the switch.
- **Switching opens the other home at its top** (it's another page, not the same page at the same depth).
- Swipe sideways still switches.

| Version | Switch | Why try it |
|---|---|---|
| ~~V10 · Two homes · segmented on top~~ (archived) | L3 pill group, flags, US "New", sticky under the top bar; the track is white with a hairline over the grey summary (grey again once scrolled) so it stands out | clearest: two equal choices, always visible |
| ~~V11 · Two homes · tabs on top~~ (archived) | L3 underline tabs, flags, US "New", sticky | lighter; reads as top-level navigation (Delivery / Dining style) |
| V12 · Two homes · switch in top bar | L3 pill group with the big (md, 32) pills "🇮🇳 IND / 🇺🇸 US", right after the profile, in a surface/primary track as tall as search and the wallet (38); the unselected pill has no grey fill | no extra row; most room for content (the top bar never hides on this version) |
| V13 · Two homes · market picker | one round button after the profile, as tall as search and the wallet: "🇮🇳 IN Stocks" + the L3 switch arrows (`lmSwitchArrowVertical`) — one tap switches to the other market (no sheet; TopBar `market`) | the market as the user's context; the smallest switch |

#### One home (V15, no Figma yet, 5 Nov — archived)

The redesign of the top of Home now that the app has two markets. The problem it solves: the old header mixed three
different things on one level — **markets** (IN / US), **products** (MF, F&O, Commodity, Smart invest) and **shortcuts**
(Trade ideas, IPO, Watchlist, Referral) — and the market switch sat above all of them, so the products and the user's
money changed with a tab they had nothing to do with (MF, F&O and Commodity are Indian products; the total is both).

The structure: **you first, then the markets.**

| Zone | What | Scoped to | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Top bar | Profile · search · wallet; stays put while scrolling | — | Search and money are global |
| 1 · You | **Two market sections**, side by side (L3 Grid of 2 Cards): 🇮🇳 Indian Stocks — ₹ value + return · 🇺🇸 US Stocks — $ value + return. No combined total: ₹ + $ in one number hid more than it told. Each opens its holdings | Each market | "How am I doing?" per market, at a glance |
| 1 · You | **US next step inside the US section** until the user holds US stocks: "Not active · Activate in a minute", "Not active · Under review", "Not active · Activation failed · Retry", "$0.00 · Add money to start", "$0.00 · Money on the way" (opens the deposit explainer), "$0.00 · Money ready to invest" | The user | The step sits where the money will be — no separate banner, and the quietest permanent cross-sell |
| 1 · You | **Products**, names only (no highlight line): MF · F&O · Commodity · Smart invest | All | Products aren't markets, so they never hide under a tab |
| 2 · Markets | **Sticky head**: flat IN Stocks / US Stocks tabs + that market's index ticker, one block that sticks under the top bar | The market | The switch sits right where its scope starts, so it's clear what it changes. Switching while stuck starts the other market's feed at its top |
| 2 · Markets | The market's own feed, its shortcuts first (IN: Trade ideas · IPO · Watchlist · Referral; US: Analysis · ETFs · Watchlist · Referral) | The market | Unchanged |

All white (surface default), no grey band, no rounded sheet — about 200 px from the top bar to the tabs. Lemonn KYC pending: zone 1 is the KYC card alone (nothing works before it). Code: `components/HubSummary.tsx`, Home.tsx
(`version.layout === 'hub'`), Home.module.css (`.hub*`).
#### V16 · F1 · US home (from the jojo branch, 8 Nov; V18, its top over V14's body, is the default. Figma Stocks Playground 6441:3)

Figma "F1-01 · US Home · holding · full scroll". Two homes with L3 underline tabs "🇮🇳 IND Stocks / 🇺🇸 US Stocks"
sticky above the ticker, search as an icon (as V10–V13), and the US tab's own design (`usHome: 'f1'`):

- **Hero** (`components/us/UsHero`, once the user holds US stocks; before that the state's card as in every version):
  "US STOCKS • HOLDINGS", the value with ↗ (→ holdings, us-stocks-77), the total return as a soft profit Tag, a soft
  US-accent glow, then **Buy NVDA** (→ the NVDA stock page) and **Add USD** (→ the wallet).
- **Feed** (`components/us/UsHomeF1`): Shortcuts (Zing · ETFs · Analyst picks · +3 more, one outlined strip, Figma's own
  icons) · Start Trading (card rail with the month line) · Top Movers (Watchlist · Most Traded · Top Gainers · Top
  Losers chips with icons, 5 plain rows, View All → Market) · By Market Cap (Large · Mid · Small · Micro, two rows of
  cards scrolling together) · Brands You Know (one row of round logos, name and move) · Discover ETFs (plain rows, funds
  in plain words, View All under the list) · Heatmap (Figma's compact one, `UsHeatmap f1`: inset, rounded, white
  text, no index switcher — tried the earlier edge-to-edge one, then back to this, the user's pick) · Explore by themes (2 × 2 tiles
  with logo stacks) · Announcements (card rail).
- **Not on this home:** Top analyst picks (open from the shortcut) and the Watchlist rail (Top Movers' first chip).
- **One top block:** while a hero is on show, the top bar, the tabs and the ticker's band take the hero's

### Data

- `src/shared/data/companies.ts` — the company catalogue (56 NSE stocks: profile, design-system logo, market data from
  a real Yahoo Finance snapshot). **Top movers come from it:** `topMovers(list)` in `data.ts` — Top gainers = the
  biggest risers today (up only), Top losers = the biggest fallers (down only), Under ₹100 = the cheapest stocks,
  cheapest first (the catalogue carries IDEA, YESBANK, SOUTHBANK, SUZLON, NHPC, IRFC for it); six cards each. The
  movers section calls `useMarketSnapshot()`, so prices re-render when the app re-reads `./market-snapshot.json`
  (on load and every 5 minutes; the site refreshes that file every 15 minutes in NSE hours). Near-live, not live.
- `src/shared/data/market.ts` — `indices[]` and `stocks` (symbol, name, price, day change %, initials, `logoUrl`).
  Shared with Market / F&O. Values are samples from the live app — still used by the index strip, the idea baskets'
  logos and the F&O highlight (Nifty 50 change).
- `src/shared/data/portfolio.ts` — `holdings` (current value, return %) and `watchlists[]`. **Fictional** (the
  screenshots are a real account).
- `components/us/data.ts` — the US tab: `usIndices`, movers per cap bucket (`moversFor`), `titans`, `brandRows`, heat tiles, `themes`, the activation benefits. US logos come from `usLogo(sym)` (`src/shared/data/usStocks.ts`); a US stock's price / change from the shared `catalogue` (stable made-up numbers for symbols not in it). Tapping a US stock calls `viewUsStock(sym)` first; "View all" calls `handToMarket(...)` (`src/shared/data/marketHandoff.ts`) first.
- `data.ts` — `products`, `shortcuts` (with badge count / text), `topMovers(list)` (three lists, from the catalogue), `strategies`,
  `announcement`, `sectors`, `highlights`, `tradeIdeas`, `ideaBaskets`, `disclosure`. Each is one API section.
- API: one home call (sections in order, each optional) + live prices for the index strip and the stock cards.

### Components (L3 → any platform)

| Where | L3 component (Figma name) | Props / variant |
|---|---|---|
| Top bar | Actionbar | `search` (placeholder "Search stocks") + 2 `ActionbarAction`s (Wallet, Profile) |
| Index strip, holdings, shortcuts | Card | `variant="flat"`, `padding="none"`, `onClick` (tap targets with no card look) |
| Changes (indices, holdings, stocks, sectors, ideas) | PriceChange | `sm` in cards, `lg` next to big numbers; sign only, never an arrow |
| Products, movers, sectors, baskets, highlights, ideas, strategies | Card | clickable (`onClick`); strategies `padding="none"` + `footerFilled`; highlights / ideas `footer` |
| Section titles | SectionHeader | View all / New watchlist = `action: view-all`; Smart Invest / Trade ideas = `tag` |
| Movers chips | Tabs | `appearance="pill"` (filter: hug + scroll), icon left |
| Stock / basket logos | Avatar | `src` = logo URL, falls back to `initials`; 40 (48 in ideas); baskets `shape="rounded"` |
| Watchlists | ListCell | `variant="card"`, `as="button"`, Avatar left, chevron right |
| Shortcut / highlight art | **Illustration slot** (`Spot`, src/shared/ui) | md 64, success / discover / brand tone |
| Counts / "New" | Badge (`count`) · Tag (`error`, `sm`) | over the shortcut's icon |
| Rows that scroll sideways | **Rail** (src/shared/ui) | `visible` = how many show (a fraction lets the next peek); `rows={2}` for movers |
| Buttons | Button | Invest now / Explore = tertiary · Details = secondary · Buy = `buy` · Explore now = `brand` |
| Main navbar | BottomNavbar (`MainNav`, src/shared/ui) | `value="stocks"` |
| Layout | Stack · Section · Inset · Grid (Figma auto-layout frames) | Page: Stack → summary Stack `gap="24"` on surface/secondary, feed Stack `gap="32"` on the rounded sheet; tinted bands Section `paddingBlock="24"`. Each block: Stack `as="section" gap="16"`, heading in an Inset `paddingInline="16"`; index strip a horizontal Stack `gap="16"`; shortcuts Inset 16 → Grid `columns={4} gap="00"`; strategy card body Section `padding="12" gap="12"`; trade-idea buttons Grid `columns={2} gap="12"`; disclosure Section `paddingInline="16" gap="04" align="start"`. Content inside clickable cards stays CSS (spans inside a button) |

### Rules & behaviour

- The top bar stays; everything else scrolls. Rails scroll sideways and snap; trade ideas snap to the centre.
- Index values and stock prices update live (prices tick; the change colour follows the sign — never by hand).
- Movers chips switch the list in place; the chip row and both card rows keep their scroll position per list.
- Badges: "8 new" (new IPOs), a count (watchlist stocks), "New" (referral offer) — from the API; hidden when empty.
- Smart Invest slots: show "x/y"; when 0 left, the CTA becomes "Join waitlist" (not drawn).
- Holdings: a user with no holdings sees "Start investing" instead of the value (not drawn).

### Differences from the live app

- **Top bar:** the live app puts the profile avatar on the left of the search field. The L3 Actionbar has no leading
  avatar, so Profile is the second action on the right, and the search field is L3's search mode.
- **Sections:** same order and content, rebuilt with L3 cards, tags and buttons; the grey summary area and the
  rounded feed sheet are kept (they read well in light and dark).
- **Smart Invest / Trade ideas tints** use the L3 brand and discover light surfaces (olive and navy in dark mode).
- **Shortcuts** use illustration slots (green) instead of the live app's icon artwork.
- **Announcement** is an L3 card with an illustration slot instead of the campaign image.
- **Sample data:** holdings and watchlists are fictional; top movers are real (catalogue snapshot); indices, sectors
  and baskets are samples.

#### Market switch guide (FTUX, prototype setting "Market switch guide", on by default)

Shown every time the Home opens, and again for each homepage version picked (a switch
lower on the page is scrolled into view first). `components/MarketSwitchGuide.tsx` + `components/UsIntroStory.tsx`.

- **Torch:** the whole screen (top bar and navbar too, and the phone's status and navigation bars) dims — black at
  75 %, a little darker than surface/overlay — except a hole over this version's
  switch, with a white ring pulsing out of it.
- **The US Stocks intro card** pops out under the switch (over it when the switch is low), its tail on the switch, and
  holds still (no float) — built like DASH's animated Pine Script tip: a dark card (surface/inverted) with a turning blue gradient
  edge; "Introducing US Stocks" + New + ✕; a looping story on a small white stage — a fingertip taps US on a tiny
  IND / US switch, the US list (AAPL, NVDA, TSLA, real prices) slides in, NVIDIA's buy bar slides up, Buy → "Bought
  0.25 NVDA"; a stepper Switch · Explore · Trade fills with a caption per act; and **View US stocks** (L3 Button secondary,
  Large).
- **Taps:** View US stocks, or the lit switch → switches to US and ends the guide; ✕ → ends it. A tap on the dim does nothing (a mis-tap mustn't lose it).
- Reduced motion: no pop or loop; the story shows its last still (bought).

### L3 gaps

- **Lime NEW tag** (product tiles, Figma 10303:27156): a Lemonn-lime gradient (50 → 300) with a 500 border and black
  caps, the same in both modes. L3 Tag has no brand colour or gradient, so `.newTag` dresses the L3 Tag (secondary,
  Small) in the brand hues (FLAG). Figma's text is 8 Bold; L3's smallest Tag text is Label/10.
- **Product tile width** — 112 when the tiles scroll (`--app-stocks-product-tile`, local token): L3 has no card-width
  token. "Smart invest" in L3 Label/12 is a pixel wider than a 112 tile leaves it, so the scrolling tiles never cut a
  name off.

- **Neutral Aerobar:** the theme page's description bar is an inline Aerobar on surface-default with border-light, set through its own variables (L3 has no neutral surface-default look).

- **Select hover underline** — L3 Select underlines its label on hover; the holdings switcher (Home V2–V4) wants
  none, so `.holdingsSelect` in components/Home.module.css turns it off (FLAG). Needs a Select option upstream.
- **Notched market tabs** (IND / US strip with an SVG outline and a flipping label) — no L3 component; hand-made in
  `components/MarketTabs.tsx` (the pinned compact version is a plain L3 Tabs).
- **Homepage versions** — no flag icons in L3 (round flag SVGs of our own in `shared/assets/flags`, not emoji, so they look the same on every device); V9's "Graphite segmented" has no L3 style of
  its own (it is the L3 pill group); V7 / V8's lit folder on top reuses the notched tabs, without Jojo's lit panel. V10's white and V12's surface/primary pill-group
  tracks (V12 also 38 tall, its unselected pill unfilled) are local overrides: L3 Tabs `pill-group` has no option for its track surface or height.
- **Market switch guide** — no L3 coach mark / spotlight: the dim with a hole, the pulsing ring and the story card are
  hand-made (as DASH's Pine Script tip), with local tokens `--app-stocks-guide-*` (card 320, stage 172, the tiny
  switch 128, motion). The tiny Buy on the stage is artwork using the L3 buy-button colours.
- **Swipe between pages** — no L3 behaviour; `components/useSwipeBetween.ts` is a hand-made pointer gesture.
- **Activation card blue** — Figma surface/accent/blue #dee9fe has no L3 semantic surface (us-stock light is #eff4fe): local token `--app-surface-kyc-card`, mixed from the us-stock accent.
- **Market cards carousel** — no L3 carousel: `components/MarketCards.tsx` is a hand-made scroll-snap track (IND and US top cards, full width, 16 apart), with a mouse drag for the desktop preview.
- **US tab hand-made bits** (marked `FLAG` in `components/us/`): activation card + carousel dots, cap chip, Titan / brand
  card insides and logo stacks; a few raw px kept from the US Stocks prototype (card widths, sparkline).
- **US company logos** are PNGs in `src/shared/assets/us-logos` (L3 has Indian logos only); the sparkline, benefit and
  tab icons are SVG illustrations in `assets/us/` with their own colours.
- **Logo stack / group** — L3 has no overlapping Avatar group: the theme page's stack and "+n" disc are hand-made (`components/us/ThemeCard.module.css`, FLAG). The theme cards' sideways row is `Rail` (below).
- **Rail / carousel:** no sideways-scrolling row in L3 — `Rail` (src/shared/ui) stands in.
- **Actionbar leading avatar** (profile on the left of the search field).
- **Illustrations** for shortcuts, highlights and campaigns — `Spot` slots stand in.

- 2026-10-30 — IN Stocks / US Stocks tabs on Home (brought in from the US Stocks flow's Home, `us-stocks-12`): notched
  tabs strip between summary and feed, in-place switch by tap or swipe, pinned compact tabs under the top bar, US index
  strip, and the US tab's feed (`stocks-09`, `stocks-10`). IND content unchanged except the inserted 40 strip (the feed
  moves down by it and loses its rounded top, the strip's line / notch is its top edge). TopBar got an optional `bottom`
  slot; `Shortcuts` and `IndexStrip` got optional `items` props.

- 2026-10-23 — the six Under ₹100 stocks (IDEA, YESBANK, SOUTHBANK, SUZLON, NHPC, IRFC) show their real logos — added
  to the design system (`@l3/assets/company-logos`, now 56), so no movers fall back to initials.
- 2026-10-23 — Top movers show real Indian stock data: gainers / losers / under ₹100 come from the company catalogue
  (real Yahoo Finance snapshot, DS logos) instead of hand-typed prices, and update when the snapshot refreshes. Six
  cheap stocks (IDEA, YESBANK, SOUTHBANK, SUZLON, NHPC, IRFC) joined the catalogue for Under ₹100 — they show
  initials until their logos are in the design system. Layout unchanged (same cards, six per list).
- 2026-10-21 — layout moved from CSS-module classes to the L3 layout blocks (Stack, Section, Inset, Grid); nothing moved (measured at 392). The home shortcuts sit edge to edge (gap 0).
- 2026-10-19 — the search field opens the Search flow (`search-01`).
- 2026-10-17 — first version: Home (7 frames of one page).

### Changelog (live-app match, 2026-10-22)

- Re-matched to the live app (Pixel 8 over ADB, dark theme): profile initials moved to the left of the search; Title Case
  labels as live ("Do More With Lemonn", "Top Movers", "Invest in Sectors" …); shortcuts Trade Ideas · IPO (5 New) ·
  Watchlist (3) · Referral (New); today's indices, top gainers (with the real company logos), Smart Invest numbers
  (92L, 356/500, last four days), sectors, highlights, the "Oil Price Dependents" basket; the announcement is the
  campaign's artwork; the disclosure has Read More; the Smart Invest tag alternates NSE/BSE Approved ↔ Auto Buy & Sell.
- Removed **Trade ideas** — the live app no longer shows it on the home (`stocks-06` now shows highlights & baskets).
- Kept fictional: holdings value, profile initials, watchlist names (the phone is a real account).
- Still L3, not live: the Actionbar's search field (live: a filled pill with a magnifier), PriceChange (live: ▲18.56%
  without "+"), logo sizes (L3 Avatar max 48; live ~60 / ~80), Spot discs on the shortcuts (live: outlined circles),
  the Mutual Funds highlight's badge artwork and the baskets' dark-blue card fill.
- The second idea basket only peeks in on the live app; its name ("High Growth Media") and stocks are a guess.
- Same day, second pass (designer's calls): the top bar is plain elements (no L3 Actionbar), with the DASH pill copied
  from Figma; **no card shadows on this screen** (a one-off, not a rule — `screens/Home.module.css` flatCards); sizes
  re-measured at 360 dp from the live capture: section titles 16, card / summary text 12, shortcut circles 40, card
  widths (products 2.55 visible, movers 2.39, watchlists 1.6, sectors 2.07, highlights 1.67, baskets 1.19).

- 2026-11-04 — Money on the way (`stocks-20`): the card opens the deposit explainer over Home (`shared/ui/DepositProgressSheet`)
  instead of the wallet; the timed move to "money ready" waits while it's open.

### `src/flows/stocks/components/Discover.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Avatar } from '@l3/components/Avatar'
import { Badge } from '@l3/components/Badge'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Grid } from '@l3/components/Grid'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { ListCell } from '@l3/components/ListCell'
import { PriceChange } from '@l3/components/PriceChange'
import { SectionHeader } from '@l3/components/SectionHeader'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { msChevronRight, msCurrencyRupee, msTrendingDown, msTrendingUp } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { inr } from '../../../shared/data/format'
import { watchlists, type Watchlist } from '../../../shared/data/portfolio'
import { Rail } from '../../../shared/ui/Rail'
import { useMarketSnapshot } from '../../../shared/data/companies'
import { useFlowOption } from '../../../shared/prototype'
import { shortcuts, topMovers, type MoverList, type Shortcut } from '../data'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { ShortcutArt } from './ShortcutArt'
import styles from './Home.module.css'

/** Which shortcuts design the Home shows (prototype option "Shortcuts", flow options in index.tsx): V1 is the default. */
export type ShortcutsVersion = 'v1' | 'v2'
export const DEFAULT_SHORTCUTS: ShortcutsVersion = 'v1'

/**
 * "Do more with Lemonn": four feature shortcuts, with a count or "New" where there's something to see.
 * V1: a green icon in a 40 outlined circle over each label. V2: one outlined card, the four side by side split by
 * hairlines, a plain green icon over a secondary label.
 */
export function Shortcuts(props: ShortcutsProps) {
  const version = useFlowOption('stocks', 'shortcuts', DEFAULT_SHORTCUTS) as ShortcutsVersion
  return version === 'v1' ? <ShortcutsCircles {...props} /> : <ShortcutsCard {...props} />
}

type ShortcutsProps = { onOpen?: (id: string) => void; /** The US tab swaps IPO for ETFs (data.ts usShortcuts). */ items?: Shortcut[]; }

/** The shortcut's icon, with its count of new things (IPO: 5) as an L3 Badge on the icon's top-right corner. */
function ShortcutIconWithBadge({ s, children }: { s: Shortcut; children: ReactNode }) {
  if (!s.badge) return <>{children}</>
  return <Badge count={s.badge.count} color="error" label={t('shortcuts.newBadge')}>{children}</Badge>
}

/** V2: one outlined card, four columns split by hairlines. */
function ShortcutsCard({ onOpen, items = shortcuts }: ShortcutsProps) {
  return (
    <Stack as="section" gap="16" aria-label={t('shortcuts.title')}>
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00">
        <Card padding="none" className={styles.shortcutsPanel}>
          <Grid columns={4} gap="00">
            {items.map((s) => (
              <Card key={s.id} variant="flat" padding="none" className={styles.shortcutCard} onClick={() => onOpen?.(s.id)}>
                <span className={`${styles.shortcut} ${styles.shortcutPlain}`}>
                  <span className={styles.shortcutIcon}>
                    <ShortcutIconWithBadge s={s}><span className={styles.shortcutGlyph} aria-hidden="true"><ShortcutArt art={s.art} /></span></ShortcutIconWithBadge>
                  </span>
                  <span className={styles.shortcutPlainLabel}>{s.label}</span>
                </span>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </Grid>
        </Card>
      </Inset>
    </Stack>
  )
}

/** V1: a 40 outlined circle per shortcut. */
function ShortcutsCircles({ onOpen, items = shortcuts }: ShortcutsProps) {
  return (
    <Stack as="section" gap="16" aria-label={t('shortcuts.title')}>
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00">
        <Grid columns={4} gap="00">
          {items.map((s) => (
            <Card key={s.id} variant="flat" padding="none" className={styles.shortcutCard} onClick={() => onOpen?.(s.id)}>
              <span className={styles.shortcut}>
                <span className={styles.shortcutIcon}>
                  <ShortcutIconWithBadge s={s}><span className={styles.shortcutCircle} aria-hidden="true"><ShortcutArt art={s.art} /></span></ShortcutIconWithBadge>
                </span>
                <span className={styles.shortcutLabel}>{s.label}</span>
              </span>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </Grid>
      </Inset>
    </Stack>
  )
}

const moverTabs: { value: MoverList; label: 'movers.gainers' | 'movers.losers' | 'movers.under100'; icon: string }[] = [
  { value: 'gainers', label: 'movers.gainers', icon: msTrendingUp },
  { value: 'losers', label: 'movers.losers', icon: msTrendingDown },
  { value: 'under-100', label: 'movers.under100', icon: msCurrencyRupee },
]

/** Top movers: gainers / losers / under ₹100 (chips), as two rows of stock cards that scroll together. Prices update with the market snapshot. */
export function TopMovers({ initial = 'gainers', onStock, onViewAll }: { initial?: MoverList; onStock?: (symbol: string) => void; onViewAll?: () => void }) {
  const [list, setList] = useState<MoverList>(initial)
  useMarketSnapshot() // re-render when fresher prices arrive
  return (
    <Stack as="section" gap="16" aria-label={t('movers.title')}>
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00"><SectionHeader title={t('movers.title')} action={{ type: 'view-all', onClick: () => onViewAll?.() }} /></Inset>
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00">
        <Tabs
          aria-label={t('movers.tabsLabel')}
          appearance="pill"
          items={moverTabs.map((tab) => ({ value: tab.value, label: t(tab.label), iconLeft: <Icon icon={tab.icon} size={16} /> }))}
          value={list}
          onChange={(v) => setList(v as MoverList)}
        />
      </Inset>
      <Rail label={t(moverTabs.find((m) => m.value === list)!.label)} visible={2.39} rows={2}>
        {topMovers(list).map((stock) => (
          <Card key={stock.symbol} onClick={() => onStock?.(stock.symbol)}>
            <span className={styles.cardStack}>
              <Avatar initials={stock.initials} src={stock.logoUrl} size={48} label={stock.name} />
              <span className={styles.cardSymbol}>{stock.symbol}</span>
              <span className={styles.cardPrice}>{inr(stock.price)}</span>
              <PriceChange value={stock.changePct} size="sm" />
            </span>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </Rail>
    </Stack>
  )
}

/** The user's watchlists, each opening its list. "View all" will open the all-watchlists page (not built yet). `lists`: the US tab passes its own. */
export function Watchlists({ lists = watchlists, onOpen, onViewAll }: { lists?: Watchlist[]; onOpen?: (id: string) => void; onViewAll?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <Stack as="section" gap="16" aria-label={t('watchlists.title')}>
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00"><SectionHeader title={t('watchlists.title')} action={{ type: 'view-all', onClick: () => onViewAll?.() }} /></Inset>
      <Rail label={t('watchlists.railLabel')} visible={1.6}>
        {lists.map((w) => (
          <ListCell
            key={w.id}
            variant="card"
            as="button"
            iconLeft={<Avatar initials={w.name.slice(0, 1)} size={40} />}
            label={w.name}
            description={t(w.count === 1 ? 'watchlists.one' : 'watchlists.many', { count: w.count })}
            iconRight={<Icon icon={msChevronRight} />}
            onClick={() => onOpen?.(w.id)}
          />
        ))}
      </Rail>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/HoldingsHero.module.css`

```css
/* The V16 holdings hero (Figma 6441:5): surface/primary (the header above it is too), bottom corners 16.
   Built as one box (8 Nov, the user's call): one equal 16 padding all round, and two containers inside it, 24 apart
   (the hero's gap) — the value (overline, amount, return) and the actions (buttons or product cards), which have no
   padding or margin of their own. FLAG: the glow is hand-made — Figma's "US glow (us-stock accent)": a 520 × 160 ellipse in the
   market's light accent surface (US blue-900 / IND green-900 in dark, the 50s in light) with a 40 layer blur, its top
   136 down the hero (the actions' middle). */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-24);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  border-radius: 0 0 var(--l3-radius-16) var(--l3-radius-16);
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  --glow: var(--l3-surface-accent-us-stock-light);
}

.hero[data-market='in'] {
  --glow: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-up-light);
}

.glow {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -90px; /* FLAG: raw px — Figma's ellipse: 160 tall, 70 of it inside the hero's foot (136 down a 206 hero), 80 past each side; from the bottom so a hero without actions (IND) keeps it */
  right: -80px; /* FLAG: raw px */
  left: -80px; /* FLAG: raw px */
  height: 160px; /* FLAG: raw px */
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--glow);
  filter: blur(40px); /* FLAG: raw px — Figma's layer blur 40 */
  pointer-events: none;
}

.value {
  position: relative;
}
/* The whole value block opens the holdings (8 Nov): L3's press scale, no box. */
.value[data-pressable] {
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  transition: transform var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}
.value[data-pressable]:active {
  transform: scale(var(--l3-motion-scale-press-default));
}
.value[data-pressable]:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--l3-spacing-02) solid var(--l3-border-dark);
  outline-offset: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-08);
}

.overline {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em; /* Figma: 1.2 on 12 */
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.dot {
  width: var(--l3-size-04);
  height: var(--l3-size-04);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: currentColor;
}

.amount {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-24);
}

/* The return tag fully rounded (Figma: 99) — the user's call, 8 Nov; L3 Tags are 4. */
.pill.pill {
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
}
/* The ▴ / ▾ sits close to the %: the glyph is narrow in its 16 box (5 blank each side), so the Tag's 2 gap and the
   label's 4 inner padding left ~11 of air before the number (8 Nov, the user's catch). Now ~3. */
.pill.pill > :first-child {
  margin-inline-end: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-04));
}
.pill.pill > :last-child {
  padding-inline-start: 0;
}

.actions {
  position: relative;
}
/* HeroButtons (Figma 6444:479): two equal 40 buttons, 16 apart. */
.buttons {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-16);
}

.mark {
  display: block;
  object-fit: contain;
}

/* A logo on its own square tile (Reliance) cropped round, like an L3 Avatar, so it reads as a mark, not a box. */
.mark[data-round] {
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  object-fit: cover;
}

/* The Buy button's company mark at 28 (Figma) in the 40 button — L3's md icon is 20. */
.buy.buy {
  --btn-icon-size: var(--l3-size-28);
}

/* HeroShell: a status card on the hero's surface — 20 above (32 from the ticker's band, as the holdings hero), the
   card's own 16 sides, 24 under it. */
.hero.shell {
  align-items: stretch;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-20) 0 var(--l3-spacing-24);
}
.shellBody {
  position: relative;
}
/* No card (money ready): only the foot, 16 under the ticker's band. */
.hero.shell[data-empty] {
  padding: 0 0 var(--l3-spacing-16);
}

/* Until US Stocks is active the glow takes the status card's colour (8 Nov): honey under review, red when it failed —
   the same light accent surfaces the cards use. Blue cards (KYC, activate) keep the US blue. */
.hero[data-tone='honey'] {
  --glow: var(--l3-surface-accent-warning-light);
}
.hero[data-tone='red'] {
  --glow: var(--l3-surface-accent-error-light);
}

/* Before activation the glow is very soft (8 Nov): a hint of the card's colour, not a wash. */
.hero[data-subtle] .glow {
  opacity: 0.3;
}

/* Just activated (the green card, add money next): a slight green (8 Nov). */
.hero[data-tone='green'] {
  --glow: var(--l3-surface-accent-success-light);
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/HoldingsHero.tsx`

```tsx
// The V16 home's holdings hero (Figma 6441:5, "US hero"), on both tabs: "<MARKET> STOCKS • HOLDINGS", the value with ↗
// (opens the holdings), the return as a soft, fully rounded Tag, a blurred accent glow at the foot, then the tab's
// actions (US: Buy NVDA · Add USD; IND: the product tiles). The hero's surface carries on from the header above it, so
// the top of the page is one block down to the hero's rounded foot.
// IND has no Figma: the US hero restyled for it, with the green accent for the glow (the user's call, 8 Nov).
import type { KeyboardEvent, ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { msArrowDropDown, msArrowDropUp, msArrowOutward } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../copy'
import styles from './HoldingsHero.module.css'

type HoldingsHeroProps = {
  /** Which market: the overline's name and the glow's accent (US blue, IND green). */
  market: 'in' | 'us'
  /** The holdings value, already formatted ($ for US, ₹ for IND). */
  value: string
  /** The total return, %. */
  returnPct: number
  /** The whole value block (overline, amount, return) → that market's holdings on Portfolio. */
  onHoldings?: () => void
  /** Under the value: the tab's actions (the second container, inside the hero's 16 padding). */
  children?: ReactNode
}

export function HoldingsHero({ market, value, returnPct, onHoldings, children }: HoldingsHeroProps) {
  const up = returnPct >= 0
  const pct = `${Math.abs(returnPct).toFixed(2)}%`
  const name = t(market === 'us' ? 'f1.hero.label' : 'f1.hero.labelIn')
  // The whole value block is one tap target (8 Nov, the user's call): a div with role="button", since Stack can't
  // render a <button> and a button can't hold the overline's and tag's blocks.
  const open = onHoldings
    ? {
        role: 'button',
        tabIndex: 0,
        'aria-label': t('f1.hero.open', { value, pct: `${up ? '+' : '−'}${pct}` }),
        onClick: onHoldings,
        onKeyDown: (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); onHoldings() }
        },
      }
    : {}
  return (
    <section className={styles.hero} data-market={market} aria-label={name}>
      <span className={styles.glow} aria-hidden="true" />
      <Stack gap="12" align="center" className={styles.value} data-pressable={onHoldings ? true : undefined} {...open}>
        <span className={styles.overline}>
          {name}
          <span className={styles.dot} aria-hidden="true" />
          {t('f1.hero.holdings')}
        </span>
        <Stack gap="08" align="center">
          <span className={styles.amount}>
            {value}
            <Icon icon={msArrowOutward} size={16} />
          </span>
          <Tag variant="secondary" color={up ? 'profit' : 'loss'} size="md" className={styles.pill} iconLeft={<Icon icon={up ? msArrowDropUp : msArrowDropDown} size={16} />}>{pct}</Tag>
        </Stack>
      </Stack>
      {children && <div className={styles.actions}>{children}</div>}
    </section>
  )
}

/**
 * The hero's surface without the holdings: a status card (activate, under review, failed, add money, KYC…) on the same
 * block — surface/primary, rounded foot, the market's glow — so every state's top ends in the same curve (8 Nov).
 */
export function HeroShell({ market, tone, subtle = false, children }: { market: 'in' | 'us'; /** The card's tint, for the glow until US Stocks is active (honey: under review; red: failed). Else the market's colour. */ tone?: 'honey' | 'red' | 'green'; /** Before activation, and just activated: a very soft glow (8 Nov). */ subtle?: boolean; /** None: only the hero's foot (money ready: the aerobar says it). */ children?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className={`${styles.hero} ${styles.shell}`} data-empty={!children || undefined} data-market={market} data-tone={tone} data-subtle={subtle || undefined}>
      <span className={styles.glow} aria-hidden="true" />
      {children && <div className={styles.shellBody}>{children}</div>}
    </section>
  )
}

type HeroButtonsProps = {
  /** The primary button: "Buy <stock>" with the company's mark at 28 before it (Figma's Buy NVDA). */
  buy: { label: string; mark?: string; onClick?: () => void; /** The mark is a logo on its own square tile (Reliance): crop it round, like an avatar. */ round?: boolean }
  /** The tertiary button: moving money in (Add USD / Add money), with its currency icon. */
  add: { label: string; icon: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void }
}

/** The hero's two equal 40 buttons, 16 apart (Figma 6444:479) — Primary + Tertiary as in Figma, not the project's
 *  buy / brand rule (the user's call, 8 Nov). */
export function HeroButtons({ buy, add }: HeroButtonsProps) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.buttons}>
      <Button variant="primary" size="md" className={styles.buy} iconLeft={buy.mark ? <img src={buy.mark} alt="" width={28} height={28} className={styles.mark} data-round={buy.round || undefined} /> : undefined} onClick={buy.onClick}>
        {buy.label}
      </Button>
      <Button variant="tertiary" size="md" iconLeft={add.icon} onClick={add.onClick}>
        {add.label}
      </Button>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/Home.module.css`

```css
/*
 * Stocks home — the insides of each section (the page layout is screens/Home.module.css). Tokens only. A section is
 * a Stack (heading → content 16, DESIGN_SYSTEM 2.3) with the heading in an Inset (the 16 page margin). Most of what
 * is left here sits inside clickable Cards, which are buttons: only spans go there, and the layout blocks render
 * block elements only.
 */

/* ---- Index strip: NIFTY 50 23,146.15 +0.65% › | SENSEX … — scrolls sideways (padding inside the scroller) ---- */
.indexStrip {
  position: relative; /* keeps absolutely placed bits inside the scrolling strip (see Rail) */
  overflow-x: auto;
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.indexStrip::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

/* One index (divider + card): a horizontal Stack. It keeps its full width in the scrolling strip — a Stack sets
   min-width: 0, which would let it shrink. */
.indexItem {
  flex: none;
}

.index {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.indexName {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12); /* live app at 360 dp: 12 */
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.indexValue {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
}

.divider {
  flex: none;
  align-self: stretch;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light);
}

/* ---- Holdings: the biggest number on the page ---- */
.holdings {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16);
}

.holdingsText {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  min-width: 0;
}

.holdingsLabel {
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12); /* live app at 360 dp: 12 */
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.holdingsValue {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-28);
}

/* V2–V4: the holdings' IN / US switch, at the page margin. */
.holdingsSwitch {
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16);
}

/* FLAG: L3 Select underlines its label on hover; the designer wants none on the holdings switcher (2026-11-02). Listed
   as an L3 gap in the README — drop this once Select has a no-underline option. */
@media (hover: hover) {
  .holdingsSelect.holdingsSelect:hover > span {
    text-decoration: none;
  }
}

/* The caret (no container) that says the whole block opens Portfolio. */
.caret {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

/* ---- Small cards (products, movers, sectors) ---- */
.cardStack {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

.cardRow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

.cardTitle {
  display: -webkit-box;
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2; /* live app: long sector names wrap to two lines */
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
}

.productTitle {
  overflow: hidden;
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12); /* live app at 360 dp: 12 */
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.cardSymbol {
  overflow: hidden;
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12); /* live app at 360 dp: 12 */
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.cardPrice {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
}

.cardMeta {
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

/* A count under a card's name ("12 Stocks"): a number, so Label, not Description (L3 typography roles). */
.cardCount {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

/* Product cards (live app): the chevron right after the name, 4 apart. */
.cardRow:has(> .productTitle) {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.cardRow > .cardMeta {
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.highlight {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
}

.chevron {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

/* "New" sits on the card's top edge, at the content's left (the products row leaves room above for it). */
.onEdge {
  position: absolute;
  /* Figma 10303:27156: the tag sits across the card's top edge (centred on it), just inside the left corner. */
  top: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-10));
  left: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-04));
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

/* FLAG: product tiles. More than three: 112 each, scrolling; three or fewer: they share the row (Rail visible = count).
   [data-rows] only lifts this over the Rail's own column width. "Smart invest" in L3 Label/12 is a pixel wider than a
   112 tile leaves it, so here a name is never cut off (it takes the chevron's side bearing). */
.productTilesScroll[data-rows] {
  grid-auto-columns: var(--app-stocks-product-tile);
}

.productTilesScroll .productTitle {
  overflow: visible;
}

/* FLAG: Figma's NEW tag — lime-50 → lime-300 gradient, lime-500 border, black text, the same in light and dark. L3 Tag
   has no brand colour or gradient (L3 gap), so the Tag's own variables take the Lemonn brand hues. */
.newTag {
  --tag-soft-border: var(--l3-base-hue-brand-lemonn-500);
  --tag-soft-content: var(--l3-base-neutral-black-base);
  background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--l3-base-hue-brand-lemonn-50), var(--l3-base-hue-brand-lemonn-300));
}

/* No top padding above the products: the rail is pulled up over the 24 section gap, leaving only the 12 a "New" tag
   on a card's top edge needs (the sideways-scrolling rail would clip it) — on every version. */
.onEdgeRoom {
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  margin-top: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-24));
}

/* ---- Do more with Lemonn: four shortcuts (an Inset around a 4-column Grid) ---- */
.shortcut {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  /* V1: 8 above the circles, so the "New" tags over them clear what's above (V2 sets its own 12, .shortcutPlain). */
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  text-align: center;
}

/* The flat card rounded (so its hover grey has rounded corners) and not clipping, so the count / "New" can sit over its top edge. */
.shortcutCard[data-variant='flat'][data-padding='none'] {
  overflow: visible;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12);
}

.shortcutIcon {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
}

/* The count / "New" over the icon's top edge. */
.overIcon {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-08));
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.shortcutLabel {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
}

/* V2 shortcuts: one outlined card (L3 Card, static) with the four side by side, a hairline between them. */
/* No padding on the outer card (padding="none", which also clips): the four shortcuts fill it edge to edge, so their
   hover grey does too, square inside the card's rounded corners. They bring the 12 above and below themselves. */
.shortcutsPanel .shortcutCard[data-variant='flat'][data-padding='none'] {
  border-radius: 0;
}
/* The divider is a straight line between two shortcuts, not on the cards (a shadow on a rounded card curves round its corners).
   It floats: 12 short of the card's top and bottom edges. */
.shortcutsPanel .shortcutCard + .shortcutCard {
  position: relative;
}
.shortcutsPanel .shortcutCard + .shortcutCard::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset-block: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  left: 0;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px divider */
}
.shortcutPlain {
  padding-block: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}
/* A plain 24 icon (no circle), in the success green like V1's. */
.shortcutGlyph {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
}
/* The custom shortcut icon: its 20 art in a 24 icon box, like an L3 icon's glyph inside its frame. */
.shortcutArt {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--l3-icon-size-24);
  height: var(--l3-icon-size-24);
}
.shortcutArt svg {
  width: var(--l3-icon-size-20);
  height: var(--l3-icon-size-20);
}
.shortcutPlainLabel {
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* V2's count sits off the icon's top-right corner (as in the design), not centred over it. */
.shortcutPlain .overIcon {
  left: 50%;
  transform: none;
}

/* ---- Smart Invest strategy card: a Section (12 padding, 12 gap); the head is a horizontal Stack ---- */

/* The head's 12 below and its hairline: Section pads both sides alike and has no one-side border. */
.strategyHead {
  padding-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light);
}

.strategyName {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14); /* live app at 360 dp: one line */
}

.strategyDeposit {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-02);
}

/* Three stats: left, centre and right-aligned in auto · 1fr · auto columns (Grid has equal columns only). */
.stats {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-16);
}

.stat {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.stat:nth-child(2) {
  align-items: center;
}

.stat:last-child {
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.statValue {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-16);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Last week: one small ring per trading day, profit or loss. */
.days {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.day {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-20);
  height: var(--l3-size-20);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-10);
}

.day[data-result='profit'] {
  background: var(--l3-surface-accent-success-light);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-accent-success-default);
}

.day[data-result='loss'] {
  background: var(--l3-surface-accent-error-light);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-error-default);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-accent-error-default);
}

/* The footer's charges + Invest now: a horizontal Stack that fills the footer. */
.charges {
  flex: 1;
}

.chargesText {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-02);
}

.price {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-16);
}

.was {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  text-decoration: line-through;
}

/* ---- Highlights ---- */
.highlightCard {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

.highlightTitle {
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-20);
}

.highlightValue {
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-24);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
}

/* ---- Invest in ideas: a basket's logos, 3 across (live app; L3 Avatar tops out at 48 — live tiles are ~80) ---- */
.logos {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, max-content);
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
}

.basketName {
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-18);
}

/* ---- Disclosure ---- */
.disclosureText {
  display: -webkit-box;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 4; /* live app: four lines, then … Read More */
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.disclosureText[data-open] {
  -webkit-line-clamp: unset;
}

/* "Read More": a text link (live app: blue, underlined), not a button. */
.readMore {
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-discover-default);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  text-decoration: underline;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* ---- Announcements: the campaign's artwork, full width, radius 12 ---- */
.announcementImage {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12);
}

/* Shortcut icon, live app at 360 dp: a 40 circle with a 1px edge and the icon in the success green. */
.shortcutCircle {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-40);
  height: var(--l3-size-40);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px edge */
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
}

/* The index strip slides in from the right after the market tab changed (IND ↔ US). */
.indexStripIn {
  animation: index-strip-in var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

@keyframes index-strip-in {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    translate: var(--l3-spacing-12) 0;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .indexStripIn {
    animation: none;
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/HomeSwitcher.module.css`

```css
/* PROTOTYPE ONLY: the floating User status · Version · Header pill over the Home (phone app mode). Copied from the nudges flow's SheetSwitcher. Tokens only. */

/* Starts top-left, under the floating settings button and above the sheet; once dragged, left / top come from the
   component. */
.pill {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: var(--app-layer-fab);
  left: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  top: var(--l3-size-64);
  width: max-content;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  max-width: calc(100% - var(--l3-spacing-24));
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-24);
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--l3-shadow-elevation-high);
  touch-action: none;
}

/* Out of its edge: next to the side it's tucked into, sliding out of it. */
.pill[data-side='left'] {
  left: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  animation: outOfLeft var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}
.pill[data-side='right'] {
  left: auto;
  right: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  animation: outOfRight var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}
@keyframes outOfLeft { from { transform: translateX(-100%); opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes outOfRight { from { transform: translateX(100%); opacity: 0; } }

/* Tucked away: a small tab on the edge (drag it up or down; a tap brings the pill out). */
.tab {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: var(--app-layer-fab);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-20);
  height: var(--l3-size-48);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  box-shadow: var(--l3-shadow-elevation-high);
  cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: none;
}
.tab[data-side='left'] { left: 0; border-radius: 0 var(--l3-radius-12) var(--l3-radius-12) 0; }
.tab[data-side='right'] { right: 0; border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12) 0 0 var(--l3-radius-12); }
/* The tab shows 20 × 48 but takes touches in a 48 × 72 zone (12 above and below, reaching into the screen), so it's
   easy to grab and drag out (the user's call, 5 Nov). */
.tab::before {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-12));
  bottom: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-12));
  width: var(--l3-size-48);
  content: '';
}
.tab[data-side='left']::before { left: 0; }
.tab[data-side='right']::before { right: 0; }

.grip {
  flex: none;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-32);
  height: var(--l3-size-32);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  cursor: grab;
  touch-action: none;
}
.grip:active { cursor: grabbing; }

.chip {
  flex: 0 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-02);
  height: var(--l3-size-32);
  padding: 0 var(--l3-spacing-04) 0 var(--l3-spacing-08);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.chip > svg { flex: none; transition: transform var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard); }
.chip[data-open] { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-dark); }
.chip[data-open] > svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }
/* Every pill keeps its size; one too long for the row is cut with an ellipsis (the menu shows it whole). */
.value { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

/* The dropdown: a floating card with the full names. */
.menu {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: var(--app-layer-fab);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-width: calc(var(--l3-size-96) * 2);
  max-width: calc(100% - var(--l3-spacing-16));
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-16);
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--l3-shadow-elevation-high), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light);
  animation: drop var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}
.menuTitle {
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-04);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
}
.item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  width: 100%;
  min-height: var(--l3-size-40);
  padding: 0 var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12);
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.item:hover { background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); }
.item[data-picked] { background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); }
.itemLabel { flex: 1; }
.item > svg { flex: none; color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default); }

@keyframes drop { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(calc(var(--l3-spacing-04) * -1)); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .menu, .pill, .chip > svg { animation: none; transition: none; } }
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/HomeSwitcher.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore, type PointerEvent } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { msCheck, msChevronLeft, msChevronRight, msDragIndicator, msKeyboardArrowDown } from '@l3/icons/material'
import type { FlowOption } from '../../types'
import { setFlowOption, useFlowOption, usePreview } from '../../../shared/prototype'
import { USER_STATUS, userStatusOptions, type UsActivation, type UsHoldings, type UsWallet } from '../../../shared/userStatus'
import { activeHomeVersions, DEFAULT_HOME_VERSION } from './homeVersions'
import { t } from '../copy'
import styles from './HomeSwitcher.module.css'

/** Where the pill is: a free spot, or tucked into the left / right edge at height `y` (then `x` isn't used). */
type Spot = { x: number; y: number; dock?: 'left' | 'right' }
/** One pill: the option, whose settings it is (a flow id, or the app's user status) and its short text. */
type Item = { owner: string; option: FlowOption; short: (value: string, label: string) => string }

const SPOT_KEY = 'stocks-home-switcher-spot'
// First visit: tucked into the right edge (only the tab shows) until it's tapped out or dragged somewhere.
const DEFAULT_SPOT: Spot = { x: 0, y: 160, dock: 'right' }
const readSpot = (): Spot => {
  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SPOT_KEY) ?? 'null') ?? DEFAULT_SPOT } catch { return DEFAULT_SPOT }
}
const saveSpot = (spot: Spot) => {
  try { localStorage.setItem(SPOT_KEY, JSON.stringify(spot)) } catch { /* storage off: it stays for this visit */ }
}
// Dropped with its edge this close to the screen's side (or past it), the pill tucks into that side.
const TUCK_AT = 24
const EDGE_GAP = 12

// The same test the preview uses to run as the app itself (preview/Preview.tsx phoneQuery): a phone, or the app
// installed on one. On a laptop these settings already float beside the phone mockup (an option's `floatOn`).
const phoneQuery = '(max-width: 767px), ((display-mode: standalone) and (pointer: coarse)), ((display-mode: fullscreen) and (pointer: coarse))'
const usePhone = () =>
  useSyncExternalStore(
    (onChange) => { const m = window.matchMedia(phoneQuery); m.addEventListener('change', onChange); return () => m.removeEventListener('change', onChange) },
    () => window.matchMedia(phoneQuery).matches,
  )

const userStatus = (id: string) => userStatusOptions.find((o) => o.id === id)!
const homeVersionOption: FlowOption = {
  id: 'homeVersion', label: 'Homepage version', default: DEFAULT_HOME_VERSION,
  values: activeHomeVersions.map((v) => ({ value: v.id, label: `${v.id.toUpperCase()} · ${v.name}` })),
}

// The pills, in order. User status first (each one only while the one before has the listed values, as in the panel),
// then the Home's own settings.
const items: Item[] = [
  { owner: USER_STATUS, option: userStatus('us'), short: (v) => t(`switcher.us.${v as UsActivation}`) },
  { owner: USER_STATUS, option: userStatus('usWallet'), short: (v) => t(`switcher.wallet.${v as UsWallet}`) },
  { owner: USER_STATUS, option: userStatus('usHoldings'), short: (v) => t(`switcher.holdings.${v as UsHoldings}`) },
  { owner: 'stocks', option: homeVersionOption, short: (v) => v.toUpperCase() },
]

/**
 * PROTOTYPE ONLY — not part of the design. On a phone (the prototype running as the app), a small floating pill over
 * the Home: US Stocks activation · USD wallet · US holdings · Homepage version · Header, each a dropdown pill (its own
 * menu, with the full names), so states and versions can be switched without opening the settings. Drag it by the
 * grip; it remembers where it was left (this browser). Copied from the nudges flow's SheetSwitcher.
 *
 * It starts tucked into the right edge (the user's call, 3 Nov).
 * Slide it into the left or right edge and it tucks away: only a small tab stays on that edge (drag it up or down).
 * A tap on the tab brings the pill out next to it; a tap anywhere else tucks it back.
 *
 * A sheet makes everything inside the screen inert, so the pill is drawn just outside the screen (in the layer that
 * holds it), over any sheet.
 */
export function HomeSwitcher() {
  const { interactive } = usePreview()
  const phone = usePhone()
  const anchor = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null)
  const [host, setHost] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const screen = anchor.current?.closest('[data-part="page"]')?.parentElement
    setHost(screen?.parentElement ?? null)
  }, [])

  return <>
    <span ref={anchor} hidden />
    {interactive && phone && host && createPortal(<Pill host={host} />, host)}
  </>
}

type MenuState = { item: Item; chip: HTMLElement } | null

function Pill({ host }: { host: HTMLElement }) {
  const pill = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [spot, setSpot] = useState<Spot | null>(readSpot)
  // Tucked into an edge: is the pill out (tapped open) or only the tab showing?
  const [out, setOut] = useState(false)
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState<MenuState>(null)
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState<Spot | null>(null)
  const grab = useRef<{ id: number; dx: number; dy: number; startX: number; startY: number; moved: boolean } | null>(null)
  // A drag of the tab ends with a click too; that one mustn't open the pill.
  const dragged = useRef(false)
  const us = useFlowOption(USER_STATUS, 'us', userStatus('us').default)
  const wallet = useFlowOption(USER_STATUS, 'usWallet', userStatus('usWallet').default)
  const status: Record<string, string> = { us, usWallet: wallet }
  const shown = items.filter(({ option }) => !option.showIf || Object.entries(option.showIf).every(([id, values]) => values.includes(status[id])))
  const dock = spot?.dock
  const tucked = !!dock && !out && !drag

  // Pointer position in the screen's own pixels (the mockup may be scaled).
  const local = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    const origin = host.getBoundingClientRect()
    const scale = origin.width / host.clientWidth || 1
    return { x: (e.clientX - origin.left) / scale, y: (e.clientY - origin.top) / scale }
  }
  const keepY = (y: number, h: number) => Math.min(Math.max(EDGE_GAP, y), host.clientHeight - h - EDGE_GAP)

  // Out of its edge, a tap anywhere else (not in the pill or its open menu) tucks it back.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dock || !out) return
    const away = (e: Event) => {
      const target = e.target as Element
      if (pill.current?.contains(target) || target.closest?.('[role="listbox"]')) return
      setMenu(null)
      setOut(false)
    }
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', away)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', away)
  }, [dock, out])

  const down = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    const box = (tucked ? e.currentTarget : pill.current!).getBoundingClientRect()
    const origin = host.getBoundingClientRect()
    const scale = origin.width / host.clientWidth || 1
    setMenu(null)
    dragged.current = false
    grab.current = { id: e.pointerId, dx: (e.clientX - box.left) / scale, dy: (e.clientY - box.top) / scale, startX: e.clientX, startY: e.clientY, moved: false }
    try { e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId) } catch { /* the pointer is already gone */ }
  }
  const move = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    const g = grab.current
    if (!g || g.id !== e.pointerId) return
    if (!g.moved && Math.hypot(e.clientX - g.startX, e.clientY - g.startY) < 6) return
    g.moved = true
    const at = local(e)
    // The tab slides along its edge; the pill goes anywhere, even half out of the screen (that's how it's tucked away).
    if (tucked) setSpot({ ...spot!, y: keepY(at.y - g.dy, e.currentTarget.offsetHeight) })
    else setDrag({ x: at.x - g.dx, y: at.y - g.dy })
  }
  const up = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    const g = grab.current
    grab.current = null
    if (!g || g.id !== e.pointerId || !g.moved) return
    dragged.current = true
    if (tucked) return saveSpot(spot!)
    const w = pill.current?.offsetWidth ?? 0
    const h = pill.current?.offsetHeight ?? 0
    const at = drag ?? { x: 0, y: 0 }
    setDrag(null)
    const side = at.x < TUCK_AT ? 'left' : at.x + w > host.clientWidth - TUCK_AT ? 'right' : undefined
    const next: Spot = side
      ? { x: 0, y: keepY(at.y, h), dock: side }
      : { x: Math.min(Math.max(0, at.x), host.clientWidth - w), y: keepY(at.y, h) }
    if (side) setOut(false)
    setSpot(next)
    saveSpot(next)
  }
  const drags = { onPointerDown: down, onPointerMove: move, onPointerUp: up, onPointerCancel: () => { grab.current = null; setDrag(null) } }

  if (tucked) {
    return <button type="button" className={styles.tab} data-side={dock} style={{ top: spot!.y }}
      aria-label={t('switcher.open')} aria-expanded={false} {...drags}
      onClick={() => { if (dragged.current) { dragged.current = false; return } setOut(true) }}>
      <Icon icon={dock === 'left' ? msChevronRight : msChevronLeft} size={16} />
    </button>
  }

  const place = drag ? { left: drag.x, top: drag.y }
    : dock ? { top: Math.min(spot!.y, host.clientHeight - (pill.current?.offsetHeight ?? 0) - EDGE_GAP) }
    : spot ? { left: spot.x, top: spot.y } : undefined
  return <div ref={pill} className={styles.pill} role="group" aria-label={t('switcher.label')}
    data-side={!drag ? dock : undefined} style={place}>
    <button type="button" className={styles.grip} aria-label={t('switcher.drag')} {...drags}>
      <Icon icon={msDragIndicator} size={20} />
    </button>
    {shown.map((item) => <Pick key={item.option.id} item={item} menu={menu} setMenu={setMenu} />)}
    {menu && <Menu item={menu.item} chip={menu.chip} host={host} onClose={() => setMenu(null)} />}
  </div>
}

/** A dropdown pill: the short value (cut with an ellipsis when it doesn't fit) and a chevron; a tap opens the menu. */
function Pick({ item, menu, setMenu }: { item: Item; menu: MenuState; setMenu: (menu: MenuState) => void }) {
  const { owner, option, short } = item
  const value = useFlowOption(owner, option.id, option.default)
  const label = option.values.find((o) => o.value === value)?.label ?? value
  const open = menu?.item.option.id === option.id
  return <button type="button" className={styles.chip} data-open={open ? '' : undefined}
    aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded={open} aria-label={`${option.label}: ${label}`}
    onClick={(e) => setMenu(open ? null : { item, chip: e.currentTarget })}>
    <span className={styles.value}>{short(value, label)}</span>
    <Icon icon={msKeyboardArrowDown} size={16} />
  </button>
}

/** The open dropdown: every value by its full name, the picked one ticked. Under its pill (above it when there's no
 *  room), kept inside the screen; a tap outside or Escape closes it. */
function Menu({ item, chip, host, onClose }: { item: Item; chip: HTMLElement; host: HTMLElement; onClose: () => void }) {
  const { owner, option } = item
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const value = useFlowOption(owner, option.id, option.default)
  const [spot, setSpot] = useState<{ left: number; top: number; maxHeight: number } | null>(null)

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const origin = host.getBoundingClientRect()
    const scale = origin.width / host.clientWidth || 1
    const at = chip.getBoundingClientRect()
    const gap = 8
    const width = box.current?.offsetWidth ?? 0
    const left = Math.min(Math.max(gap, (at.left - origin.left) / scale), host.clientWidth - width - gap)
    const below = (at.bottom - origin.top) / scale + gap
    const above = (at.top - origin.top) / scale - gap
    const roomBelow = host.clientHeight - below - gap
    const height = box.current?.scrollHeight ?? 0
    setSpot(height <= roomBelow || roomBelow >= above
      ? { left, top: below, maxHeight: roomBelow }
      : { left, top: Math.max(gap, above - height), maxHeight: above - gap })
  }, [chip, host])

  useEffect(() => {
    const away = (e: Event) => {
      const target = e.target as Node
      if (!box.current?.contains(target) && !chip.contains(target)) onClose()
    }
    const key = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose() }
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', away)
    document.addEventListener('keydown', key)
    return () => { document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', away); document.removeEventListener('keydown', key) }
  }, [chip, onClose])

  return createPortal(<div ref={box} className={styles.menu} role="listbox" aria-label={option.label}
    style={spot ?? { visibility: 'hidden' }}>
    <div className={styles.menuTitle}>{option.label}</div>
    {option.values.map((o) => {
      const picked = o.value === value
      return <button key={o.value} type="button" role="option" aria-selected={picked} className={styles.item}
        data-picked={picked ? '' : undefined}
        onClick={() => { setFlowOption(owner, option.id, option.default, o.value); onClose() }}>
        <span className={styles.itemLabel}>{o.label}</span>
        {picked && <Icon icon={msCheck} size={16} />}
      </button>
    })}
  </div>, host)
}
```

```css
/* Home V15's two market sections (IN · US), side by side on the white page. */
```
