### `src/flows/stocks/components/HubSummary.tsx`

```tsx
// Home V15 "One home": the top of the page is about the user, the markets come after it. On the page's white.
// 5 Nov, third take: no combined total (₹ + $ in one number hid more than it told). Two separate sections instead:
//  1. Two market sections side by side — Indian stocks (₹) and US Stocks ($) — each with its value and return, opening its
//     holdings. Until the user holds US stocks, the US section carries its own next step (activate, under review, add
//     money, money on the way …): the step sits where the money will be, so there's no separate banner.
//  2. The other ways to invest (MF, F&O, Commodity, Smart invest), names only: products, not markets.
// Lemonn KYC pending: the KYC card alone (nothing works before it).
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Grid } from '@l3/components/Grid'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { ListCell } from '@l3/components/ListCell'
import { PriceChange } from '@l3/components/PriceChange'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { msChevronRight, msLock } from '@l3/icons/material'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { holdings } from '../../../shared/data/portfolio'
import { inr } from '../../../shared/data/format'
import { useUsd } from '../../../shared/money'
import { Flag } from '../../../shared/ui/Flag'
import { ProductCards } from './Overview'
import { inKycCard, usHoldings, type UsState } from './us/data'
import { productsWithInvest } from '../data'
import { t } from '../copy'
import styles from './HubSummary.module.css'

type CopyKey = Parameters<typeof t>[0]

type Props = {
  usState: UsState
  onInHoldings?: () => void
  onUsHoldings?: () => void
  onActivateUs?: () => void
  /** Money on the way: its section opens the deposit explainer. */
  onTransfer?: () => void
  onProduct?: (id: string) => void
}

export function HubSummary({ usState, onInHoldings, onUsHoldings, onActivateUs, onTransfer, onProduct }: Props) {
  const usd = useUsd()
  if (usState === 'kyc') {
    return (
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00">
        <ListCell
          variant="card"
          as="button"
          iconLeft={<span className={styles.lock}><Icon icon={msLock} /></span>}
          label={t(inKycCard.title)}
          description={t(inKycCard.subtitle)}
          iconRight={<Icon icon={msChevronRight} />}
          onClick={onActivateUs}
        />
      </Inset>
    )
  }
  const us = usSection[usState]
  const onUs = usState === 'holding' ? onUsHoldings : usState === 'onTheWay' ? onTransfer : usState === 'review' ? undefined : onActivateUs
  return (
    <Stack gap="16">
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00">
        <Grid columns={2} gap="12" role="group" aria-label={t('hub.breakdown')}>
          <MarketSection flag="in" label={t('hub.in')} value={inr(holdings.current)} onClick={onInHoldings}>
            <PriceChange value={holdings.returnPct} size="sm" />
          </MarketSection>
          <MarketSection flag="us" label={t('hub.us')} value={us.value === 'usd' ? usd(usState === 'holding' ? usHoldings.value : 0) : t(us.value)} muted={us.value !== 'usd'} onClick={onUs}>
            {usState === 'holding'
              ? <PriceChange value={usHoldings.returnPct} size="sm" />
              : <span className={styles.status} data-tone={us.tone}>{us.line && t(us.line)}</span>}
          </MarketSection>
        </Grid>
      </Inset>
      <ProductCards items={productsWithInvest} onProduct={onProduct} compact />
    </Stack>
  )
}

/** What the US section shows in each state before the user holds US stocks: the value line (a $ amount, or a word when
 *  there is no wallet yet) and the next step under it. */
const usSection: Record<Exclude<UsState, 'kyc'>, { value: 'usd' | CopyKey; line: CopyKey | ''; tone?: 'action' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success' }> = {
  activate: { value: 'hub.usState.notActive', line: 'hub.usState.activate', tone: 'action' },
  review: { value: 'hub.usState.notActive', line: 'hub.usState.review', tone: 'warning' },
  support: { value: 'hub.usState.notActive', line: 'hub.usState.review', tone: 'warning' },
  failed: { value: 'hub.usState.notActive', line: 'hub.usState.failed', tone: 'error' },
  activated: { value: 'usd', line: 'hub.usState.addMoney', tone: 'action' },
  onTheWay: { value: 'usd', line: 'hub.usState.onTheWay', tone: 'warning' },
  ready: { value: 'usd', line: 'hub.usState.ready', tone: 'success' },
  holding: { value: 'usd', line: '' },
}

/** One market: flag + name, the value, and the return (or the next step) under it. */
function MarketSection({ flag, label, value, muted, onClick, children }: { flag: 'in' | 'us'; label: string; value: string; muted?: boolean; onClick?: () => void; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Card padding="none" onClick={onClick}>
      <span className={styles.section}>
        <span className={styles.head}>
          <Flag code={flag} />
          <span className={styles.label}>{label}</span>
          {onClick && <span className={styles.chevron}><Icon icon={msChevronRight} size={16} /></span>}
        </span>
        <span className={styles.value} data-muted={muted || undefined}>{value}</span>
        {children}
      </span>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/Ideas.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Avatar } from '@l3/components/Avatar'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { Section } from '@l3/components/Section'
import { SectionHeader } from '@l3/components/SectionHeader'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { msChevronRight } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { Rail } from '../../../shared/ui/Rail'
import { disclosure, ideaBaskets } from '../data'
import { t } from '../copy'
import styles from './Home.module.css'

/** Invest in ideas: curated baskets — their stocks' logos, the name and the count. */
export function IdeaBaskets({ onOpen }: { onOpen?: (id: string) => void }) {
  return (
    <Stack as="section" gap="16" aria-label={t('baskets.title')}>
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00"><SectionHeader title={t('baskets.title')} description={t('baskets.description')} /></Inset>
      <Rail label={t('baskets.railLabel')} visible={1.19}>
        {ideaBaskets.map((b) => (
          <Card key={b.id} onClick={() => onOpen?.(b.id)}>
            <span className={styles.cardStack}>
              <span className={styles.logos} aria-hidden="true">
                {b.stocks.slice(0, 6).map((s) => <Avatar key={s.symbol} initials={s.initials} src={s.logoUrl} size={48} shape="rounded" />)}
              </span>
              <span className={styles.basketName}>{b.name}</span>
              <span className={styles.cardRow}>
                <span className={styles.cardCount}>{t('baskets.count', { count: b.stocks.length })}</span>
                <span className={styles.chevron}><Icon icon={msChevronRight} /></span>
              </span>
            </span>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </Rail>
    </Stack>
  )
}

/** The broker's regulatory line: three lines, then "Read More" (live app) — it opens the full text in place. */
export function Disclosure() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  return (
    <Section paddingInline="16" gap="04" align="start">
      <p className={styles.disclosureText} data-open={open || undefined}>{disclosure}</p>
      <button type="button" className={styles.readMore} aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}>
        {t(open ? 'disclosure.readLess' : 'disclosure.readMore')}
      </button>
    </Section>
  )
}
```

```tsx
// The V16 IND tab's shortcuts (no Figma; the user's call, 8 Nov): the US tab's strip (ShortcutStrip) with the products —
// Mutual funds · Equity F&O · Commodities — and "+3 more", which opens the strip in place (the user's reference): a
// second row with Trade Ideas · IPO · Watchlist and "View Less ⌃". They replace the product tiles and the "Do More With
// Lemonn" circles on this version.
// Icons in the US strip's style (8 Nov): single-colour glyphs, in green on this tab (content/accent/success) — the
// navbar's Mutual Fund and F&O glyphs (NavIcon, unselected = masked), the F&O flow's commodities glyph (copied into
// assets/in) and the US strip's "more" dots. The second row keeps the old shortcuts' own two-tone green art.
import { Badge } from '@l3/components/Badge'
import { fno as fnoGlyph, mutualFund as mutualFundGlyph } from '@l3/components/BottomNavbar/glyphs'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { MaskIcon } from '@l3/components/MaskIcon'
import { msKeyboardArrowUp } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { shortcuts } from '../data'
import { t } from '../copy'
import commoditiesGlyph from '../assets/in/commodities.svg'
import moreArt from '../assets/shortcuts/more.svg'
import { ShortcutArt } from './ShortcutArt'
import { ShortcutStrip } from './us/UsHomeF1'
import styles from './InShortcutsF1.module.css'

/** A navbar glyph at full strength: its dimmer parts (baked in at 40% / 60% for the navbar's unselected look) made solid,
 *  so the strip's green isn't washed out (8 Nov: "looks very dull"). */
const solid = (glyph: string) => glyph.replace(/fill-opacity='0\.\d+'/g, '')

/** What "+3 more" holds: the IND shortcuts that used to be on the page (Trade Ideas · IPO · Watchlist) and Referral, which
 *  fills the second row so "View Less" is its last cell (the user's reference, 8 Nov). The label still says "+3 more"
 *  (the three the user asked for; Referral is a filler for now). */
const moreShortcuts = shortcuts
const MORE_COUNT = 3

type InShortcutsProps = {
  /** Mutual funds → the Mutual Fund tab. */
  onMutualFunds?: () => void
  /** Equity F&O → the F&O tab. */
  onFno?: () => void
  /** Commodities → the Commodities home (F&O flow). */
  onCommodities?: () => void
}

export function InShortcutsF1({ onMutualFunds, onFno, onCommodities }: InShortcutsProps) {
  return (
    <ShortcutStrip
      items={[
        { id: 'mutual-funds', label: t('f1.in.mutualFunds'), icon: <span className={styles.tint}><MaskIcon src={solid(mutualFundGlyph)} /></span>, onOpen: onMutualFunds },
        { id: 'fno', label: t('f1.in.fno'), icon: <span className={styles.tint}><MaskIcon src={solid(fnoGlyph)} /></span>, onOpen: onFno },
        { id: 'commodities', label: t('f1.in.commodities'), icon: <span className={styles.tint}><MaskIcon src={commoditiesGlyph} /></span>, onOpen: onCommodities },
        { id: 'more', label: t('f1.shortcuts.more', { count: MORE_COUNT }), icon: <span className={styles.tint}><MaskIcon src={moreArt} /></span> },
      ]}
      more={moreShortcuts.map((s) => ({
        id: s.id,
        label: s.label,
        icon: (
          <span className={styles.art}>
            {s.badge ? <Badge count={s.badge.count} color="error" label={t('shortcuts.newBadge')}><ShortcutArt art={s.art} /></Badge> : <ShortcutArt art={s.art} />}
          </span>
        ),
      }))}
      lessIcon={<span className={styles.tint}><Icon icon={msKeyboardArrowUp} size={24} /></span>}
    />
  )
}
```

```tsx
  useEffect(() => {

  }, [interactive])
  return (
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/MarketSwitchGuide.module.css`

```css
/*
 * The market switch guide (MarketSwitchGuide.tsx): the whole screen dims except a torch hole over the switch. The hole
 * is a box over the switch whose huge spread shadow is the scrim (--app-stocks-guide-scrim, a little darker than
 * surface/overlay), so the real switch shows through it.
 */
.guide {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 20; /* over the top bar, the sticky marquee and the navbar */
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

/* Until the switch is found: a plain scrim, so the screen never flashes undimmed. */
.guide:not([data-ready]) {
  background: var(--app-stocks-guide-scrim);
  animation: guide-in var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}

.spot {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--spot-y);
  left: var(--spot-x);
  width: var(--spot-w);
  height: var(--spot-h);
  border-radius: var(--spot-radius);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 200vmax var(--app-stocks-guide-scrim); /* the scrim around the hole */
  animation: guide-in var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}

/* The torch: a white ring that keeps pulsing out from the switch, so the eye lands on it. */
.spot::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border: var(--l3-spacing-02) solid var(--l3-static-white);
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: guide-pulse calc(var(--l3-motion-duration-long) * 4) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) infinite;
}

/* The US Stocks intro card (UsIntroStory): placed by the guide under (or over) the hole. It pops out of its tail
   with an overshoot and then holds still (no float or wiggle); a blue conic edge keeps turning around it and the tail points at the switch —
   as DASH's Pine Script tip does (dash Chat.module.css .ftux). */
@property --guide-angle {
  syntax: '<angle>';
  inherits: false;
  initial-value: 0deg;
}

.tip {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 1;
  cursor: default;
  transform-origin: var(--tail) 100%;
  animation: guide-pop var(--app-stocks-guide-pop) var(--app-stocks-guide-pop-easing) var(--l3-motion-duration-short) both;
}

.tip[data-below] {
  transform-origin: var(--tail) 0;
}

/* The gradient edge: a turning conic gradient behind the card, 1.5 of it showing around. */
.tip::before {
  position: absolute;
  inset: calc(-1 * var(--app-stocks-guide-edge));
  border-radius: calc(var(--l3-radius-20) + var(--app-stocks-guide-edge));
  background: conic-gradient(from var(--guide-angle), var(--l3-base-hue-blue-300), var(--l3-base-hue-blue-600), var(--l3-static-white), var(--l3-base-hue-blue-300));
  content: '';
  animation: guide-turn 4s linear infinite;
}

/* The tail: a small turned square on the card's edge, over the switch's middle, in the card's colour, edged like it. */
.tip::after {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-06));
  left: calc(var(--tail) - var(--l3-spacing-06));
  width: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  height: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-right: var(--app-stocks-guide-edge) solid var(--l3-base-hue-blue-300);
  border-bottom: var(--app-stocks-guide-edge) solid var(--l3-base-hue-blue-300);
  background: var(--l3-surface-inverted);
  content: '';
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.tip[data-below]::after {
  top: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-06));
  bottom: auto;
  transform: rotate(225deg);
}

@keyframes guide-pop {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(var(--l3-spacing-12)) scale(0.5);
  }
}

@keyframes guide-turn {
  to { --guide-angle: 360deg; }
}

@keyframes guide-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes guide-pulse {
  0% {
    opacity: 0.9;
    scale: 1;
  }
  70%,
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    scale: 1.12;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .guide,
  .spot,
  .spot::after,
  .tip,
  .tip::before {
    animation: none;
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/MarketSwitchGuide.tsx`

```tsx
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type MouseEvent } from 'react'
import { UsIntroStory } from './UsIntroStory'
import styles from './MarketSwitchGuide.module.css'

type Spot = { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; radius: string }
/** Where the intro card sits: left edge, its tail's x inside it, and below or above the switch. */
type Card = { left: number; width: number; tail: number; below: boolean; top: number; bottom: number }

/** Room around the switch inside the lit hole. */
const PAD = 4
/** The card's gap to the hole (its tail sits in it), its side gutter, and the room it needs under the switch. */
const GAP = 14
const GUTTER = 16
const CARD_ROOM = 400
const CARD_WIDTH = 320
/** The dim's strength (black at 75 %, --app-stocks-guide-scrim): `data-scrim` tells the phone's system bars to dim too. */
const SCRIM = '0.75'

/**
 * FTUX guide for the IND / US switch, on every homepage version (prototype setting "Market switch guide"). Like the
 * F&O chart tools guide (DASH's "Your indicators"): the screen dims (surface/overlay) and a torch hole stays lit over
 * the switch — wherever this version puts it (notched strip, pill group, tabs, top-bar switch, V13's market button) —
 * with a pulsing ring, and the US Stocks intro card (UsIntroStory: an animated story, like DASH's Pine Script tip)
 * pops in under it (above it when the switch is low), its tail on the switch. "View US stocks" or tapping the lit
 * switch switches market and ends the guide; ✕ ends it. Tapping the dim does nothing, so a mis-tap can't lose it.
 * Rendered in Screen's `sheet` slot, so it covers the whole screen (top bar and navbar too).
 */
export function MarketSwitchGuide({ onView, onClose }: { onView: () => void; onClose: () => void }) {
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [spot, setSpot] = useState<Spot | null>(null)
  const [card, setCard] = useState<Card | null>(null)
  // No switch on this version (V1, the current homepage): no guide at all.
  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false)

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const measure = (last = false) => {
      const el = root.current
      if (!el) return
      const target = findSwitch(el)
      if (!target) {
        setSpot(null)
        if (last) setMissing(true)
        return
      }
      const box = el.getBoundingClientRect()
      // Below the fold (a switch in the middle of the page): bring it into view first.
      if (target.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > box.bottom) target.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' })
      const r = target.getBoundingClientRect()
      // The preview scales the phone (and a phone may zoom): screen px → this layer's own CSS px.
      const scale = box.width / el.offsetWidth || 1
      // Keep the switch's own corners (round pills, the round V13 button); square strips get the 12 corner.
      const own = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(target).borderTopLeftRadius) || 0
      const next = {
        x: (r.left - box.left) / scale - PAD,
        y: (r.top - box.top) / scale - PAD,
        w: r.width / scale + PAD * 2,
        h: r.height / scale + PAD * 2,
        radius: own ? `${own + PAD}px` : 'var(--l3-radius-12)',
      }
      setSpot(next)
      const boxW = el.offsetWidth
      const boxH = el.offsetHeight
      const width = Math.min(boxW - GUTTER * 2, CARD_WIDTH)
      const middle = next.x + next.w / 2
      const left = Math.min(Math.max(middle - width / 2, GUTTER), boxW - GUTTER - width)
      setCard({
        left,
        width,
        tail: Math.min(Math.max(middle - left, GUTTER * 2), width - GUTTER * 2),
        below: next.y + next.h + GAP + CARD_ROOM <= boxH,
        top: next.y + next.h + GAP,
        bottom: boxH - next.y + GAP,
      })
    }
    measure()
    // The home settles for a moment after a version change (top bar, marquee): measure again once it has.
    const timers = [120, 400].map((ms) => window.setTimeout(() => measure(ms === 400), ms))
    const onResize = () => measure()
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize)
    return () => {
      timers.forEach((id) => window.clearTimeout(id))
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize)
    }
  }, [])

  const onTap = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const el = root.current
    if (!el) return
    const box = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const scale = box.width / el.offsetWidth || 1
    const x = (e.clientX - box.left) / scale
    const y = (e.clientY - box.top) / scale
    const onSpot = spot && x >= spot.x && x <= spot.x + spot.w && y >= spot.y && y <= spot.y + spot.h
    // A tap on the dim does nothing (a mis-tap shouldn't lose the guide): only ✕, View US stocks or the switch end it.
    if (!onSpot) return
    // Hand the tap to the switch under the hole (IND ↔ US), then end the guide.
    el.style.visibility = 'hidden'
    ;(document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY) as HTMLElement | null)?.click()
    onClose()
  }

  if (missing) return null

  const style = spot && ({ '--spot-x': `${spot.x}px`, '--spot-y': `${spot.y}px`, '--spot-w': `${spot.w}px`, '--spot-h': `${spot.h}px`, '--spot-radius': spot.radius } as CSSProperties)

  return (
    <div ref={root} className={styles.guide} data-scrim={SCRIM} style={style ?? undefined} data-ready={spot ? '' : undefined} onClick={onTap}>
      {spot && <div className={styles.spot} />}
      {card && (
        <div
          className={styles.tip}
          data-below={card.below || undefined}
          style={{ left: card.left, width: card.width, top: card.below ? card.top : undefined, bottom: card.below ? undefined : card.bottom, '--tail': `${card.tail}px` } as CSSProperties}
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <UsIntroStory onClose={onClose} onView={() => { onView(); onClose() }} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

/** The market switch this version shows on screen: the first one marked `data-market-switch` that is visible. */
function findSwitch(from: HTMLElement): HTMLElement | null {
  for (let scope = from.parentElement; scope; scope = scope.parentElement) {
    const marked = [...scope.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-market-switch]')]
    if (!marked.length) continue
    const screen = scope.getBoundingClientRect()
    for (const el of marked) {
      // A pill group or tabs: light the tab row itself, not the padded strip around it.
      const target = el.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="tablist"]') ?? el
      const r = target.getBoundingClientRect()
      if (r.width && r.height && r.top >= screen.top) return target
    }
    return null
  }
  return null
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/MarketTabs.module.css`

```css
/*
 * Stocks home — the IND / US market tabs. Ported from the US Stocks prototype's HomeChrome.module.css. The strip sits on
 * the summary's grey and pulls up 24 into the summary's bottom padding (so it adds exactly its own 40 to the page);
 * the notch of the selected tab and the line under the strip join the feed sheet below. Tokens only.
 */
.marketTabs {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  height: var(--l3-size-40);
  /* The tabs sit between 16 in from each edge, each half of that: equal, and they never move (only the notch does). */
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  margin-top: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-24));
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
}

/* Home versions V7, V8: under the top bar, above the index ticker — no pull-up, and 12 under the strip for the sticky
   ticker's band (it reaches 12 above the ticker), so the band never covers the tabs' bottom or their line. */
.marketTabs[data-place='top'] {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-12);
}

/* ---- The IND / US switch as L3 Tabs (MarketSwitch) ---- */
.switch {
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
}

.switch:not([data-compact], [data-bare]) {
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-16);
}

/* Inside a container that brings its own padding (Home's sheet head), or hugging the track (compact, in a top bar): no
   background of its own — a square fill around the round track would show sharp corners past it. */
.switch:is([data-bare], [data-compact]) {
  background: none;
}

.switch[data-appearance='underline'] {
  padding-block: 0;
}

/* V12 in the top bar: the big (32) pills in a track the top bar's control height (38, like search and the wallet), on
   surface/primary with the wallet's 1px edge. */
.switch[data-top-bar] {
  flex: none;
  background: none;
}

.switch[data-top-bar] [role='tablist'][data-appearance='pill-group'] {
  padding: calc((var(--app-stocks-topbar-control) - var(--l3-size-32)) / 2);
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px edge */
}

/* Every version's pill group: the unselected pill has no fill of its own — it always matches its track / container
   (only the selected one is filled). */
.switch [role='tablist'][data-appearance='pill-group'] [role='tab'][data-appearance='pill'][aria-selected='false'] {
  --tab-surface: transparent;
}

/* V6, V9: under the top bar on the summary's grey. The track is surface/primary with a 1px edge so it stands out from
   the grey (L3's track is surface/secondary — the same grey); its unselected pill has no fill (above), so it is white
   too. 12 more under it for the sticky ticker's band (it reaches 12 above the ticker), so the band never covers the
   track's bottom: 21 above the track (the top bar's 13 + 8), 20 below it to the ticker. L3 gap: no track-surface option. */
.switch[data-place='top'] {
  margin-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-12);
}

/* V5's compact switch in the top bar: on the bar's grey, the track is surface/primary with the wallet's 1px edge. */
.switch[data-place='top'] [role='tablist'][data-appearance='pill-group'],
.switch[data-compact] [role='tablist'][data-appearance='pill-group'] {
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px edge */
}

/* The small pill groups are one toggle (MarketSwitch): the whole track takes the tap. */
.switch[data-toggle] [role='tablist'] {
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Drawn by MarketTabs.tsx at the measured width. */
.outline {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: visible;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.outlineFill,
.outlineStroke,
.outlineCrest {
  transition: d 0.32s var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.outlineCrest {
  fill: none;
  stroke-width: 1px;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.crestMid {
  stop-color: var(--l3-border-accent-success-light);
}

.crestEdge {
  stop-color: var(--l3-border-accent-success-light);
  stop-opacity: 0;
}

.outlineStroke {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--l3-border-accent-success-default);
  stroke-width: 1px;
}

.washTop {
  stop-color: var(--l3-surface-accent-success-light);
}

.washBottom {
  stop-color: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

/* V7, V8: on top the selected tab sits on the summary's grey (not the feed sheet), so its wash fades into that grey. */
.marketTabs[data-place='top'] .washBottom {
  stop-color: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
}

.marketTab {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  touch-action: manipulation;
  transition: color 0.32s var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.marketTab:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--l3-spacing-02) solid var(--l3-border-dark);
  outline-offset: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-02));
}

.marketTab > span {
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-02);
}

.marketTab[aria-selected='true'] {
  z-index: 1;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

.flip {
  display: inline-grid;
  perspective: 160px; /* FLAG: raw px */
}

.flipFace {
  display: inline-flex;
  grid-area: 1 / 1;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-02);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  transition: transform 0.52s var(--l3-motion-easing-standard), opacity 0.32s var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.flipFace[data-side='live'] {
  transform: rotateX(-90deg) translateZ(var(--l3-spacing-08));
  opacity: 0;
}

.flip[data-face='1'] .flipFace[data-side='name'] {
  transform: rotateX(90deg) translateZ(var(--l3-spacing-08));
  opacity: 0;
}

.flip[data-face='1'] .flipFace[data-side='live'] {
  transform: none;
  opacity: 1;
}

.liveDot {
  position: relative;
  flex: none;
  width: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  height: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  margin-inline: var(--l3-spacing-04) calc(var(--l3-spacing-06) - var(--l3-spacing-02));
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
}

.liveDot::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: inherit;
  animation: live-ring 1.6s var(--l3-motion-easing-standard) infinite;
}

@keyframes live-ring {
  0% {
    opacity: 0.6;
    scale: 1;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 0;
    scale: 2.6;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .outlineFill,
  .outlineStroke,
  .outlineCrest,
  .marketTab,
  .flipFace {
    transition: none;
  }

  .liveDot::after {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* ---- The pinned compact tabs (the sticky overlay on Home, under the sticky index marquee) ---- */
/* White, like the sticky marquee above them. */
.pinned {
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

.pinnedIcon {
  display: inline-block;
  flex: none;
  width: var(--l3-size-16);
  height: var(--l3-size-16);
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/MarketTabs.tsx`

```tsx
// The IN Stocks / US Stocks switch between the summary and the feed: two tabs with an SVG outline that slides between
// them (the selected tab is notched and joins the feed sheet below), and a US label that flips between "US Stocks" and
// "Live till 2:30 AM". Ported from the US Stocks prototype (screens/home/MarketTabs.tsx).
// L3 gap: notched market tabs — no L3 component (L3 Tabs has flat / pill / ribbon only). The pinned compact version
// (PinnedMarketTabs) is a plain L3 Tabs, appearance="underline".
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type MouseEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { MaskIcon } from '@l3/components/MaskIcon'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { Flag as CountryFlag } from '../../../shared/ui/Flag'
import indOff from '../assets/us/ind-icon-off.svg'
import indOn from '../assets/us/ind-icon-on.svg'
import usOff from '../assets/us/us-icon-off.svg'
import usOn from '../assets/us/us-icon-on.svg'
import styles from './MarketTabs.module.css'

export type Market = 'in' | 'us'

const icons: Record<Market, { on: string; off: string }> = { in: { on: indOn, off: indOff }, us: { on: usOn, off: usOff } }

/** The home version's look for the tabs (components/homeVersions.ts): labels, flags, a "New" tag on US. */
export type MarketTabsLook = { labels?: 'stocks' | 'short' | 'ind'; flags?: boolean; usNew?: boolean }

const labelKeys = {
  stocks: { in: 'us.tabs.in', us: 'us.tabs.us' },
  short: { in: 'us.tabs.inShort', us: 'us.tabs.usShort' },
  // V16 (Figma 6441:3): "IND Stocks / US Stocks" — the user's call, 8 Nov.
  ind: { in: 'us.tabs.inInd', us: 'us.tabs.us' },
} as const

// Round flags come from the shared Flag (shared/ui/Flag.tsx, shared/assets/flags).
export const Flag = ({ market }: { market: Market }) => <CountryFlag code={market === 'in' ? 'in' : 'us'} />
const NewTag = () => <Tag color="success" size="sm">{t('us.tabs.new')}</Tag>

/**
 * The notched tab strip (40 tall, full width). `place="top"` (home versions V7, V8): right under the top bar, so it
 * doesn't pull up into the summary.
 */
export function MarketTabs({ value, onChange, look = {}, place = 'mid' }: { value: Market; onChange: (market: Market) => void; look?: MarketTabsLook; place?: 'mid' | 'top' }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.marketTabs} role="tablist" aria-label={t('us.tabs.label')} data-on={value} data-home="tabs" data-market-switch data-place={place}>
      <TabOutline on={value} />
      <MarketTab market="in" on={value === 'in'} onClick={() => onChange('in')} look={look} />
      <MarketTab market="us" on={value === 'us'} onClick={() => onChange('us')} look={look} />
    </div>
  )
}

function MarketTab({ market, on, onClick, look }: { market: Market; on: boolean; onClick: () => void; look: MarketTabsLook }) {
  const svg = icons[market][on ? 'on' : 'off']
  const icon = look.flags ? <Flag market={market} /> : <img src={svg} alt="" width={16} height={16} />
  const label = t(labelKeys[look.labels ?? 'stocks'][market])
  const [pressed, setPressed] = useState(false)
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      role="tab"
      aria-selected={on}
      aria-label={market === 'us' ? t('us.tabs.usLabel') : undefined}
      className={styles.marketTab}
      data-value={market}
      onClick={onClick}
      onPointerDown={() => setPressed(true)}
      onPointerUp={() => setPressed(false)}
      onPointerLeave={() => setPressed(false)}
      onPointerCancel={() => setPressed(false)}
    >
      {market === 'in' ? (
        <>
          {icon}
          <span>{label}</span>
        </>
      ) : (
        <FlipLabel icon={icon} label={label} isNew={look.usNew} paused={pressed} />
      )}
    </button>
  )
}

/** "US Stocks" ↔ "Live till 2:30 AM": flips every 2.5–3.5 s, pauses while pressed or when the page is hidden, still with reduced motion. */
function FlipLabel({ icon, label, isNew, paused }: { icon: ReactNode; label: string; isNew?: boolean; paused: boolean }) {
  const [face, setFace] = useState(0)
  const [still, setStill] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const query = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')
    const sync = () => setStill(query.matches)
    sync()
    query.addEventListener('change', sync)
    return () => query.removeEventListener('change', sync)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (still || paused) return
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') setFace((f) => +(f === 0))
      else setFace(0)
    }, face === 0 ? 3500 : 2500)
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [face, still, paused])

  return (
    <span className={styles.flip} data-face={still ? 0 : face} aria-hidden="true">
      <span className={styles.flipFace} data-side="name">
        {icon}
        {label}
        {isNew && <NewTag />}
        {still && <span className={styles.liveDot} />}
      </span>
      <span className={styles.flipFace} data-side="live">
        <span className={styles.liveDot} />
        {t('us.tabs.live')}
      </span>
    </span>
  )
}

/** The outline drawn around the selected tab (a rounded notch in a full-width × 40 strip). `on` picks which tab is notched. */
function TabOutline({ on }: { on: Market }) {
  // The strip is as wide as the screen: measure it so the geometry lines up with the tabs at any width.
  const ref = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const id = useId()
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(360)
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const sync = () => setWidth(el.clientWidth || 360)
    sync()
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(sync)
    observer.observe(el)
    return () => observer.disconnect()
  }, [])

  // Two equal tabs between 16 in from each edge; only the notch moves from one to the other, the labels stay put.
  const half = width / 2
  const [left, right] = on === 'in' ? [16, half] : [half, width - 16]
  const l = left + 0.5
  const r = right - 0.5
  const top = `L ${l} 12.5 A 12 12 0 0 1 ${l + 12} 0.5 L ${r - 12} 0.5 A 12 12 0 0 1 ${r} 12.5 L ${r} 27`
  const stroke = `M 0 39.5 L ${l - 12.5} 39.5 A 12.5 12.5 0 0 0 ${l} 27 ${top} A 12.5 12.5 0 0 0 ${r + 12.5} 39.5 L ${width} 39.5`
  const crest = `M ${l} 12.5 A 12 12 0 0 1 ${l + 12} 0.5 L ${r - 12} 0.5 A 12 12 0 0 1 ${r} 12.5`
  const fill = `M ${l - 12.5} 40 L ${l - 12.5} 39.5 A 12.5 12.5 0 0 0 ${l} 27 ${top} A 12.5 12.5 0 0 0 ${r + 12.5} 39.5 L ${r + 12.5} 40 Z`
  const path = (d: string) => ({ d: `path('${d}')` }) as unknown as CSSProperties

  return (
    <svg ref={ref} className={styles.outline} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} 40`} width="100%" height={40} aria-hidden="true">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id={`${id}-wash`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0.028" className={styles.washTop} />
          <stop offset="1" className={styles.washBottom} />
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id={`${id}-crest`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
          <stop offset="0.1" className={styles.crestEdge} />
          <stop offset="0.5" className={styles.crestMid} />
          <stop offset="0.9" className={styles.crestEdge} />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <path className={styles.outlineFill} d={fill} style={path(fill)} fill={`url(#${id}-wash)`} />
      <path className={styles.outlineStroke} d={stroke} style={path(stroke)} />
      <path className={styles.outlineCrest} d={crest} style={path(crest)} stroke={`url(#${id}-crest)`} />
    </svg>
  )
}

/** The compact tabs pinned under the sticky index marquee once the strip has scrolled away: L3 Tabs, underline, filling the width. */
export function PinnedMarketTabs({ value, onChange }: { value: Market; onChange: (market: Market) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.pinned}>
      <Tabs
        appearance="underline"
        width="fill"
        aria-label={t('us.tabs.label')}
        value={value}
        onChange={(next) => onChange(next as Market)}
        items={[
          { value: 'in', label: t('us.tabs.in'), iconLeft: <span className={styles.pinnedIcon}><MaskIcon src={indOn} /></span> },
          { value: 'us', label: t('us.tabs.us'), iconLeft: <span className={styles.pinnedIcon}><MaskIcon src={usOn} /></span> },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * The IND / US switch drawn with L3 Tabs (home versions V3–V6, V9: components/homeVersions.ts): a pill group or
 * underline tabs filling the row, or (`compact`, V5) a small pill group hugging its labels in the top bar, or (`topBar`,
 * V12) the big pills hugging their labels in a surface/primary track as tall as the top bar's search and wallet.
 * The small pill groups (hugging their labels: V5, V12) are one toggle: a tap anywhere on them — either pill or the
 * track — switches to the other market, since a pill that small is easy to miss. The full-width ones switch only on a
 * tap on the other tab.
 * L3 gap: Jojo's V9 "Graphite segmented" has no L3 style of its own — it is the L3 pill group.
 */
export function MarketSwitch({ value, onChange, appearance, look = {}, compact = false, topBar = false, bare = false, onTop = false }: { value: Market; onChange: (market: Market) => void; appearance: 'pill-group' | 'underline'; look?: MarketTabsLook; compact?: boolean; topBar?: boolean; /** No padding or background of its own (its container has them). */ bare?: boolean; /** Under the top bar, on the summary's grey, right above the sticky ticker (V6, V9). */ onTop?: boolean }) {
  const keys = labelKeys[look.labels ?? 'stocks']
  const small = compact || topBar
  // Small pill group: catch the tap before it reaches a pill, and flip the market whichever part was tapped.
  const toggle = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.stopPropagation()
    onChange(value === 'in' ? 'us' : 'in')
  }
  return (
    <div className={styles.switch} data-home="tabs" data-market-switch data-appearance={appearance} data-compact={small || undefined} data-top-bar={topBar || undefined} data-bare={bare || undefined} data-place={onTop ? 'top' : undefined} data-toggle={(small && appearance === 'pill-group') || undefined} onClickCapture={small && appearance === 'pill-group' ? toggle : undefined}>
      <Tabs
        appearance={appearance}
        width={small ? 'hug' : 'fill'}
        size={compact ? 'sm' : 'md'}
        aria-label={t('us.tabs.label')}
        value={value}
        onChange={(next) => onChange(next as Market)}
        items={(['in', 'us'] as const).map((market) => ({
          value: market,
          label: t(keys[market]),
          iconLeft: look.flags ? <Flag market={market} /> : undefined,
          badge: market === 'us' && look.usNew ? <NewTag /> : undefined,
        }))}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/Overview.tsx`

```tsx
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { PriceChange } from '@l3/components/PriceChange'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Select } from '@l3/components/Select'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { msChevronRight } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { liveQuote, useLiveTick } from '../../../shared/data/live'
import { indices, type MarketIndex } from '../../../shared/data/market'
import { holdings } from '../../../shared/data/portfolio'
import { inr } from '../../../shared/data/format'
import { Rail } from '../../../shared/ui/Rail'
import { products, type Product } from '../data'
import { usHoldings } from './us/data'
import { InrEquivalent, useUsd, useUsdInrRate } from '../../../shared/money'
import { t } from '../copy'
import styles from './Home.module.css'

/** NIFTY 50 · SENSEX · … — today's index moves; each opens its chart. Scrolls sideways. */
export function IndexStrip({ onIndex, items = indices, label = t('indices.label'), slideIn = false, className }: { onIndex?: (id: string) => void; /** The US tab shows S&P 500 · NASDAQ · DOW JONES (components/us/data.ts). */ items?: MarketIndex[]; label?: string; /** The strip slides in (after the market tab changed). */ slideIn?: boolean; /** Extra class on the strip (the sticky white variant on Home). */ className?: string }) {
  const at = useLiveTick()
  return (
    <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="16" className={[styles.indexStrip, slideIn && styles.indexStripIn, className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} role="region" aria-label={label}>
      {items.map((item, i) => {
        // Every index ticks around its real level (live.ts).
        const live = liveQuote(item.id, item.value, item.changePct, at)
        const index = { ...item, value: live.price, changePct: live.changePct }
        return (
        <Stack key={index.id} direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08" className={styles.indexItem}>
          {i > 0 && <span className={styles.divider} aria-hidden="true" />}
          <Card variant="flat" padding="none" onClick={() => onIndex?.(index.id)}>
            <span className={styles.index}>
              <span className={styles.indexName}>{index.name}</span>
              <span className={styles.indexValue}>{index.value.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span>
              <PriceChange value={index.changePct} size="sm" />
              <span className={styles.chevron}><Icon icon={msChevronRight} size={16} /></span>
            </span>
          </Card>
        </Stack>
        )
      })}
    </Stack>
  )
}

/** Current value of the holdings and the overall return — the page's headline number. The block opens Portfolio. */
export function HoldingsSummary({ onOpen, us = false, overall = false, label: labelOverride, usEmpty = false }: { onOpen?: () => void; /** The US tab of a user who holds US stocks: the US holdings in dollars. */ us?: boolean; /** Indian + US together, in ₹ (the US part at today's USD/INR rate). */ overall?: boolean; /** The label above the number (default: "IN Stocks holdings" / "US Stocks holdings"); null: none (HoldingsSwitcher draws its own). */ label?: string | null; /** Nothing bought in the US yet: $0.00 and no return (and nothing US in the overall). */ usEmpty?: boolean }) {
  const label = labelOverride === undefined ? (us ? t('us.holdings.label') : t('holdings.label')) : labelOverride
  const usd = useUsd()
  const rate = useUsdInrRate()
  const usValue = usEmpty ? 0 : usHoldings.value
  let value: string
  let returnPct: number | undefined
  if (overall) {
    // Overall return on what was invested: each side's invested amount is its value ÷ (1 + its return).
    const usInr = usValue * rate
    const invested = holdings.current / (1 + holdings.returnPct / 100) + (usEmpty ? 0 : usInr / (1 + usHoldings.returnPct / 100))
    const current = holdings.current + usInr
    value = inr(current)
    returnPct = Math.round(((current - invested) / invested) * 10000) / 100
  } else if (us) {
    value = usd(usValue)
    returnPct = usEmpty ? undefined : usHoldings.returnPct
  } else {
    value = inr(holdings.current)
    returnPct = holdings.returnPct
  }
  return (
    <Card variant="flat" padding="none" onClick={onOpen}>
      <span className={styles.holdings}>
        <span className={styles.holdingsText}>
          {label && <span className={styles.holdingsLabel}>{label}</span>}
          <span className={styles.holdingsValue}>
            {value}
            {returnPct !== undefined && <PriceChange value={returnPct} size="lg" />}
          </span>
          {us && !overall && <InrEquivalent usd={usValue} />}
        </span>
        <span className={styles.caret} aria-hidden="true"><Icon icon={msChevronRight} /></span>
      </span>
    </Card>
  )
}

/** What the Home V2–V4 holdings show: everything (in ₹), or one market. */
export type HoldingsView = 'overall' | 'in' | 'us'
const nextView: Record<HoldingsView, HoldingsView> = { overall: 'in', in: 'us', us: 'overall' }
const viewLabel = { overall: 'holdings.overallLabel', in: 'holdings.inLabel', us: 'us.holdings.label' } as const

/**
 * Home V2–V4: the holdings' label is the switch — an L3 Select (switcher, ↕): "Overall holdings" → "IN holdings" →
 * "US holdings", each tap the next. It sits over the number, outside the holdings block (both are buttons). It is
 * not the page's market tabs: those sit lower, over the feed, and never change it.
 */
export function HoldingsSwitcher({ view, onView, usEmpty, onOpen }: { view: HoldingsView; onView: (view: HoldingsView) => void; /** Nothing bought in the US yet: US $0.00, overall = Indian. */ usEmpty?: boolean; onOpen?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <Stack gap="04">
      <span className={styles.holdingsSwitch}>
        <Select size="sm" subtle className={styles.holdingsSelect} onClick={() => onView(nextView[view])}>
          {t(viewLabel[view])}
        </Select>
      </span>
      <HoldingsSummary us={view === 'us'} overall={view === 'overall'} label={null} usEmpty={usEmpty} onOpen={onOpen} />
    </Stack>
  )
}

/** Mutual funds · Equity F&O · Commodities — each product's one-line promise. */
export function ProductCards({ onProduct, items = products, compact = false }: { onProduct?: (id: string) => void; /** The home version's tiles (components/homeVersions.ts). */ items?: Product[]; /** Names only, one line (Home V15): no highlight line under them. */ compact?: boolean }) {
  return (
    // More than three tiles (Figma 10303:27156): 112 each, scrolling. Three or fewer: they fill the row.
    <Rail label={t('products.label')} visible={Math.min(items.length, 3)} className={[items.length > 3 && styles.productTilesScroll, items.some((p) => p.isNew) && styles.onEdgeRoom].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || undefined}>
      {items.map((p) => (
        <Card key={p.id} onClick={() => onProduct?.(p.id)}>
          <span className={styles.cardStack}>
            {/* FLAG: Figma's NEW tag (10303:27156) is a Lemonn-lime gradient with black caps; L3 Tag has no brand / gradient
                colour, so the L3 Tag (secondary, Small) is dressed in brand tokens here (.newTag). L3 gap in README. */}
            {p.isNew && <span className={styles.onEdge}><Tag variant="secondary" size="sm" className={styles.newTag}>{t('products.new')}</Tag></span>}
            <span className={styles.cardRow}>
              <span className={styles.productTitle}>{p.name}</span>
              <span className={styles.chevron}><Icon icon={msChevronRight} size={16} /></span>
            </span>
            {!compact && (
              <span className={styles.cardMeta}>
                <span className={styles.highlight}>{p.highlight}</span> {p.detail}
              </span>
            )}
          </span>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </Rail>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/ProductRowF1.module.css`

```css
/* V17's hero product row (Figma 6548:45253): the hero's second container. No padding or margin of its own — the hero's
   16 padding places it — and the 8 between cards is the row's gap. A longer row (IND's four) scrolls sideways
   from the hero's edge to edge (below). */
.row {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  overflow-x: auto;
  overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.row::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

/* A row that scrolls (IND's four) runs to the hero's edges — the screen's — so the next card shows coming in, not cut at
   the hero's 16 padding (8 Nov, the user's catch); its first and last cards still line up with the hero's 16. A full-width
   row (US) doesn't scroll and stays inside the padding. */
.row:not([data-fill]) {
  margin-inline: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-16));
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  scroll-padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16);
}

/* A card: the L3 clickable Card (surface/primary, border/light, elevation-soft, its 12 padding — the user's call over
   Figma's 8), at least Figma's 110 wide and wider when a name needs it ("Boosted ETFs" on one line). */
.item {
  position: relative;
  flex: none;
  min-width: 110px; /* FLAG: raw px — Figma's card width */
}
/* Full width: equal cards across the row (the US tab's three), no minimum. */
.row[data-fill] > .item {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
/* No shadow (the user's call, 8 Nov): the clickable card keeps its border/light hairline and its press, without
   L3's elevation-soft — over both L3's clickable card and Home's flatCards rule (which adds the shadow to every card). */
.row > .item > .card.card[data-interactive][data-variant] {
  box-shadow: var(--card-border);
}
.card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  text-align: left;
}

.name {
  display: flex;
  white-space: nowrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-02);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}
.nameText {
  flex: 1 0 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
.arrow {
  display: flex;
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-02);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.highlight {
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
}
.detail {
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
}

/* NEW: the L3 Tag over the card's top edge, 12 in from the left, with Figma's shimmer across it. */
.tag {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-08));
  left: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-04);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Figma's shimmer: a thin white streak tilted 20°, from off the tag's left across it every 2 s. */
.shimmer {
  position: absolute;
  inset-block: -50%;
  left: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-16));
  width: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75), transparent); /* FLAG: raw colour — Figma's white streak */
  rotate: 20deg;
  animation: shimmer 2s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes shimmer {
  to {
    left: 100%;
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .shimmer {
    animation: none;
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/ProductRowF1.tsx`

```tsx
// V17's product row inside the hero (Figma 6548:45253, Stocks Playground "row 2", 8 Nov): small cards in a sideways row —
// the product's name with a ▸, then its promise (green highlight · grey detail). The new product wears a NEW tag over its
// top edge with a shimmer running across it.
// Built from L3: each card is a clickable L3 Card (its border, soft shadow and press), the NEW tag an L3 Tag (zing).
// L3's 12 padding (the user's call, 8 Nov, over Figma's 8). FLAG: the 110 minimum width (Figma's card) and the tag's shimmer (L3 has no shimmer tag) are local (ProductRowF1.module.css).
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { msArrowRight } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../copy'
import type { Product } from '../data'
import styles from './ProductRowF1.module.css'

// `fill`: a short row (the US tab's three) shares the full width in equal cards instead of scrolling.
export function ProductRowF1({ items, fill = false, onProduct }: { items: Product[]; fill?: boolean; onProduct?: (id: Product['id']) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.row} data-fill={fill || undefined} role="list" aria-label={t('products.label')}>
      {items.map((p) => (
        <div key={p.id} role="listitem" className={styles.item}>
          <Card onClick={() => onProduct?.(p.id)} className={styles.card}>
            <span className={styles.name}>
              <span className={styles.nameText}>{p.name}</span>
              <span className={styles.arrow} aria-hidden="true"><Icon icon={msArrowRight} size={14} /></span>
            </span>
            <span className={styles.meta}>
              <span className={styles.highlight}>{p.highlight}</span>
              <span className={styles.detail}>{p.detail}</span>
            </span>
          </Card>
          {p.isNew && (
            <span className={styles.tag}>
              <Tag color="zing" size="sm">{t('products.new')}</Tag>
              <span className={styles.shimmer} aria-hidden="true" />
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
// The shortcuts' own two-tone icons (Jojo's custom set, not L3 system icons), drawn inline so their var(--l3-…)
// colours (success green + its light surface) follow light / dark.
import type { ShortcutArt as Art } from '../data'
import styles from './Home.module.css'

const svgs = import.meta.glob('../assets/shortcuts/*.svg', { eager: true, query: '?raw', import: 'default' }) as Record<string, string>
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/TopBar.module.css`

```css
/*
 * Stocks home top bar. Sizes measured on the live app at 360 dp (2026-10-22): avatar 34, search pill and wallet 38 with
 * a 1px edge, 16 above, 6 below (the summary's own 16 makes the 22 down to the index strip). With the DASH pill the
 * spacing follows Figma's home (DASH AI main flow): 16 at the sides, 12 between; the DASH pill keeps its own Figma
 * size (≈ 32, centred).
 * The bar takes the summary area's surface/secondary, the pill and the wallet surface/default.
 */
.bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  padding-right: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  padding-left: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
  position: sticky;
  height: var(--l3-size-64);
}

/* Scrolled: the bar leaves the summary's grey for surface/default (the page under it) — at once, with no fade, so the
 * status bar, the bar and the marquee band change together. */
.bar[data-scrolled] {
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

.bar > :is(.profile, .search, .wallet, .market) {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: var(--app-stocks-topbar-control);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  transition: transform var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.bar > :is(.profile, .search, .wallet, .market):active {
  transform: scale(var(--l3-motion-scale-press-default));
}

.bar > :is(.profile, .search, .wallet, .market):focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--l3-content-primary);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Initials on an indigo disc with a 1px indigo ring. */
.bar .profile {
  width: var(--app-stocks-topbar-avatar);
  height: var(--app-stocks-topbar-avatar);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-accent-indigo-light);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-accent-indigo-default); /* 1px ring */
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
}

.bar .profile {
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-indigo-default);
}

/* The search pill fills the space between the two circles. */
.bar .search {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px edge */
}

.placeholder {
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.wallet {
  width: var(--app-stocks-topbar-control);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px edge */
}

/* Two-homes versions: with search as a round button, the free room sits between the start and the buttons. */
.gap {
  flex: 1;
}

/* V13: the market switch — the wallet's round surface and height, wide enough for flag · name · swap icon. */
.bar .market {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px edge */
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* V13: the flag and name slide on a switch (TopBar's MarketFace) — both faces share one cell, clipped to the button. */
.faces {
  display: inline-grid;
  align-items: center;
  height: var(--app-stocks-topbar-control);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.face {
  display: inline-flex;
  grid-area: 1 / 1;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-06);
}

.face[data-leaving] {
  animation: face-out var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard) both;
}

.face[data-entering] {
  animation: face-in var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard) both;
}

/* Up (to US): out through the top, in from the bottom. Down (to IN): the other way. */
.faces[data-dir='up'] {
  --face-from: 100%;
  --face-to: -100%;
}

.faces[data-dir='down'] {
  --face-from: -100%;
  --face-to: 100%;
}

@keyframes face-out {
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    translate: 0 var(--face-to);
  }
}

@keyframes face-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    translate: 0 var(--face-from);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .face[data-leaving] {
    display: none;
  }

  .face[data-entering] {
    animation: none;
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/TopBar.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { msAccountBalanceWallet, msSearch } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { lmSwitchArrowVertical } from '@l3/icons/lemonnade'
import { Flag, type Market } from './MarketTabs'
import { t } from '../copy'
import styles from './TopBar.module.css'

type TopBarProps = {
  /** The profile's initials ("RM"). */
  initials: string
  onProfile?: () => void
  /** The search pill is a button: it opens the Search screen, where the typing happens. */
  onSearch?: () => void
  onWallet?: () => void
  /** The page is scrolled: the bar turns surface/primary. */
  scrolled?: boolean
  /** After the wallet: the IND / US switch of home versions V5, V12 (components/homeVersions.ts). */
  end?: ReactNode
  /** After the profile: V12's IND / US switch (components/homeVersions.ts). */
  start?: ReactNode
  /**
   * After the profile: V13's market switch (components/homeVersions.ts) — a round button the height of search and the
   * wallet, showing the market the home is on; one tap switches to the other market (no sheet).
   */
  market?: { value: Market; onSwitch: () => void }
  /** The search pill's text (default "Search stocks"; the US home says "Search US stocks"). */
  placeholder?: string
  /** Two-homes versions: search is a round icon button like the wallet (its label is the placeholder), not a pill. */
  compactSearch?: boolean
}

/**
 * Stocks home's own top bar, as in the live app (a one-off for this screen — not the L3 Actionbar):
 * profile initials (indigo circle) · a search pill ("Search stocks", opens Search) · the wallet. (No DASH pill: DASH
 * is entered from the F&O home only — 2026-11-01.)
 * The bar sits on the summary area's grey; the pill and the wallet are on surface/default.
 */
export function TopBar({ initials, onProfile, onSearch, onWallet, scrolled = false, end, start, market, placeholder = t('search.placeholder'), compactSearch = false }: TopBarProps) {
  return (
    <header className={styles.bar} data-scrolled={scrolled || undefined}>
      <button type="button" className={styles.profile} aria-label={t('top.profile')} onClick={onProfile}>
        {initials}
      </button>
      {start}
      {market && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.market}
          data-market-switch
          aria-label={t('market.switch.label', { market: t(market.value === 'us' ? 'us.tabs.in' : 'us.tabs.us') })}
          onClick={market.onSwitch}
        >
          <MarketFace value={market.value} />
          <Icon icon={lmSwitchArrowVertical} size={16} />
        </button>
      )}
      {compactSearch ? (
        <>
          <span className={styles.gap} aria-hidden="true" />
          <button type="button" className={styles.wallet} aria-label={placeholder} onClick={onSearch}>
            <Icon icon={msSearch} size={20} />
          </button>
        </>
      ) : (
        <button type="button" className={styles.search} onClick={onSearch}>
          <Icon icon={msSearch} size={20} />
          <span className={styles.placeholder}>{placeholder}</span>
        </button>
      )}
      <button type="button" className={styles.wallet} aria-label={t('top.wallet')} onClick={onWallet}>
        <Icon icon={msAccountBalanceWallet} size={20} />
      </button>
      {end}
    </header>
  )
}

/**
 * V13's flag and market name, which slide when the market changes: the old one leaves and the new one comes in from the
 * other side. Going to US they move up, and going back to IN they move down. A still swap with reduced motion.
 */
function MarketFace({ value }: { value: Market }) {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(value)
  const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState<Market | null>(null)
  if (value !== shown) {
    setLeaving(shown)
    setShown(value)
  }
  const face = (market: Market) => (
    <>
      <Flag market={market} />
      <span>{t(market === 'us' ? 'us.tabs.us' : 'us.tabs.in')}</span>
    </>
  )
  return (
    <span className={styles.faces} data-dir={value === 'us' ? 'up' : 'down'}>
      {leaving && (
        <span key={`out-${leaving}`} className={styles.face} data-leaving aria-hidden="true" onAnimationEnd={() => setLeaving(null)}>
          {face(leaving)}
        </span>
      )}
      <span key={value} className={styles.face} data-entering={leaving ? '' : undefined}>
        {face(value)}
      </span>
    </span>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/UsIntroStory.module.css`

```css
/*
 * The US Stocks intro card (UsIntroStory.tsx), built like DASH's animated Pine Script tip: a dark card (surface/inverted)
 * with a turning blue gradient edge, around one light stage — a tiny Stocks home, always white (static colours) so it
 * reads the same in both themes. Everything on the stage is always there and moves by transitions between the story's
 * phases, so nothing cuts. Where it sits, its tail and its pop come from MarketSwitchGuide.module.css (.tip).
 * Stage geometry is artwork (172 tall, --app-stocks-guide-*).
 */
.card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-20);
  background: var(--l3-surface-inverted);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-24) color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-base-hue-blue-500) 35%, transparent);
}

.head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

.logo {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
}

.logo img {
  width: var(--l3-size-28);
  height: var(--l3-size-28);
}

.title {
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
}

.badge {
  padding: 0 var(--l3-spacing-06);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-base-hue-blue-500);
  color: var(--l3-static-white);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
}

.close {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-28);
  height: var(--l3-size-28);
  margin-left: auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* ---- The stage */
.stage {
  --move: var(--app-stocks-guide-move);
  --ease: var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  height: var(--app-stocks-guide-stage);
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12);
  background: var(--l3-static-white);
  color: var(--l3-static-black);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  transition: opacity var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--ease);
}

/* The loop's end: a soft fade before it starts again. */
.stage[data-reset] {
  opacity: 0;
}

/* The tiny IND / US switch, centred at the top: a grey track, a white knob that slides to the tapped half. */
.switch {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  left: 50%;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  width: var(--app-stocks-guide-switch);
  height: var(--l3-size-32);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-02);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 7%, transparent);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.knob {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--l3-spacing-02);
  bottom: var(--l3-spacing-02);
  left: var(--l3-spacing-02);
  width: calc(50% - var(--l3-spacing-02));
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-static-white);
  box-shadow: 0 1px var(--l3-spacing-04) color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 18%, transparent);
  transition: transform var(--move) var(--app-stocks-guide-pop-easing);
}

.switch[data-us] .knob {
  transform: translateX(100%);
}

.half {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-12);
}

.half img {
  width: var(--l3-size-16);
  height: var(--l3-size-16);
}

/* ---- The lists: IND sits in, US waits on the right; on the switch IND leaves left as US comes in. */
.list {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(var(--l3-spacing-08) + var(--l3-size-32) + var(--l3-spacing-04));
  right: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  left: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  transition: transform var(--move) var(--ease), opacity var(--move) var(--ease);
}

.list[data-place='out'] {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(-60%);
}

.list[data-place='next'] {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(60%);
}

.row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  height: var(--l3-size-40);
  padding: 0 var(--l3-spacing-06);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-08);
  transition: background var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--ease);
}

.row[data-picked] {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-base-hue-blue-500) 14%, transparent);
}

.sym {
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-12);
}

.price {
  margin-left: auto;
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* ---- NVIDIA's buy bar: a small sheet that slides up over the stage's bottom. */
.buy {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  height: var(--l3-size-56);
  padding: 0 var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-16) var(--l3-radius-16) 0 0;
  background: var(--l3-static-white);
  box-shadow: 0 calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-04)) var(--l3-spacing-16) color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 14%, transparent);
  transform: translateY(105%);
  transition: transform var(--move) var(--ease);
}

.buy[data-open] {
  transform: none;
}

.buyName {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.fraction {
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 55%, transparent);
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
}

.buyButton {
  margin-left: auto;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-06) var(--l3-spacing-16);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-button-buy-surface);
  color: var(--l3-button-buy-content);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-12);
  transition: transform var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--ease);
}

.buyButton[data-press] {
  transform: scale(0.88);
}

.half[data-press] {
  transform: scale(0.9);
}

/* Bought: the bar turns into a green check line that pops in. */
.bought {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-12);
  animation: story-pop var(--app-stocks-guide-pop) var(--app-stocks-guide-pop-easing) both;
}

@keyframes story-pop {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    scale: 0.6;
  }
}

/* The fingertip: one for the whole story — it glides between targets, presses (a ring ripples out), and leaves. */
.cursor {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--cy);
  left: var(--cx);
  z-index: 4;
  width: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  height: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  margin: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-08)) 0 0 calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-08));
  border: var(--l3-spacing-02) solid var(--l3-static-white);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 70%, transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-base-hue-blue-500) 60%, transparent);
  transition:
    top var(--app-stocks-guide-glide) var(--ease),
    left var(--app-stocks-guide-glide) var(--ease),
    opacity var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--ease);
}

.cursor[data-away] {
  opacity: 0;
}

.cursor[data-press] {
  animation: story-tap var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--ease) both;
}

@keyframes story-tap {
  40% { scale: 0.75; }
  100% { scale: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--l3-spacing-12) color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-base-hue-blue-500) 0%, transparent); }
}

/* ---- Switch · Explore · Trade */
.steps {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

.track {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: var(--l3-spacing-02);
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-content-inverted) 18%, transparent);
}

.track span {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: var(--l3-base-hue-blue-400);
  transition: width var(--app-stocks-guide-move) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.act {
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  transition: color var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.act:nth-child(3) { text-align: center; }
.act:nth-child(4) { text-align: end; }

.act[data-state='now'] {
  color: var(--l3-base-hue-blue-400);
}

.act[data-state='done'] {
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted);
}

.caption {
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
  animation: story-in var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}

@keyframes story-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(var(--l3-spacing-04));
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .stage *,
  .caption,
  .track span {
    transition: none;
    animation: none;
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/UsIntroStory.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState, type CSSProperties } from 'react'
import { Avatar } from '@l3/components/Avatar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { msCheck, msClose } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { getCompany } from '../../../shared/data/companies'
import { usLogo } from '../../../shared/data/usStocks'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { Flag } from './MarketTabs'
import { usStock } from './us/data'
import styles from './UsIntroStory.module.css'

/**
 * The story's timeline (ms from the loop's start). One stage, one fingertip: the IND list → tap US on the switch →
 * the US list slides in → tap NVIDIA → its buy bar slides up → tap Buy → bought → hold → fade, again.
 */
const TIMELINE = [
  { at: 0, phase: 'start' },
  { at: 300, phase: 'toUs' },
  { at: 1000, phase: 'tapUs' },
  { at: 1250, phase: 'us' },
  { at: 2200, phase: 'toRow' },
  { at: 2900, phase: 'tapRow' },
  { at: 3150, phase: 'sheet' },
  { at: 3700, phase: 'toBuy' },
  { at: 4400, phase: 'tapBuy' },
  { at: 4650, phase: 'bought' },
  { at: 7400, phase: 'reset' },
] as const
const LOOP_MS = 7900
type Phase = (typeof TIMELINE)[number]['phase']
const order = TIMELINE.map((s) => s.phase)
/** Reduced motion: the still — the US list with the stock bought. */
const STILL: Phase = 'bought'

/** Where the fingertip is in each phase (x in % of the stage's width, y in stage px; the stage is 172 tall). */
const CURSOR: Record<Phase, [number, number]> = {
  start: [110, 200],
  toUs: [62, 24],
  tapUs: [62, 24],
  us: [62, 24],
  toRow: [36, 104],
  tapRow: [36, 104],
  sheet: [36, 104],
  toBuy: [86, 144],
  tapBuy: [86, 144],
  bought: [110, 200],
  reset: [110, 200],
}

const ACTS = ['switchGuide.actSwitch', 'switchGuide.actExplore', 'switchGuide.actTrade'] as const
const CAPTIONS = ['switchGuide.captionSwitch', 'switchGuide.captionExplore', 'switchGuide.captionTrade'] as const
const actOf = (p: Phase) => (order.indexOf(p) < order.indexOf('toRow') ? 0 : order.indexOf(p) < order.indexOf('toBuy') ? 1 : 2)

/** The rows the story's tiny home lists: three Indian stocks, then three US ones (real prices, the picked one 2nd). */
const IND_ROWS = ['RELIANCE', 'TCS', 'HDFCBANK'].map((sym) => ({ sym, logo: getCompany(sym)?.logoUrl, price: getCompany(sym)?.market?.price ?? 0 }))
const US_ROWS = ['AAPL', 'NVDA', 'TSLA'].map((sym) => ({ sym, logo: usLogo(sym), price: usStock(sym).price }))
const PICKED = US_ROWS[1]

const inr = (n: number) => `₹${n.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`
const usd = (n: number) => `$${n.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`

/**
 * The US Stocks intro (the market switch guide's card): a dark floating card with a turning blue edge — like DASH's
 * animated Pine Script tip — with a small continuous story on a light stage: one fingertip switches the tiny home from
 * IND to US, opens NVIDIA and buys it. A stepper (Switch · Explore · Trade) fills as it goes, a caption says each act,
 * and "View US stocks" (L3 Button secondary, Large) switches the real home to US. ✕ hides it.
 */
export function UsIntroStory({ onView, onClose }: { onView: () => void; onClose: () => void }) {
  const reduced = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>(reduced ? STILL : 'start')
  const [lap, setLap] = useState(0)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduced) return
    const timers = TIMELINE.map(({ at, phase: p }) => window.setTimeout(() => setPhase(p), at))
    timers.push(window.setTimeout(() => setLap((n) => n + 1), LOOP_MS))
    return () => timers.forEach(window.clearTimeout)
  }, [lap, reduced])

  const at = (p: Phase) => order.indexOf(phase) >= order.indexOf(p)
  const act = actOf(phase)
  const [cx, cy] = CURSOR[phase]
  const pressing = phase === 'tapUs' || phase === 'tapRow' || phase === 'tapBuy'
  const stage = { '--cx': `${cx}%`, '--cy': `${cy}px` } as CSSProperties

  return (
    <span className={styles.card} role="note">
      <span className={styles.head}>
        <span className={styles.logo} aria-hidden="true"><Flag market="us" /></span>
        <span className={styles.title}>{t('switchGuide.title')}</span>
        <span className={styles.badge}>{t('us.tabs.new')}</span>
        <button type="button" className={styles.close} aria-label={t('switchGuide.hide')} onClick={onClose}>
          <Icon icon={msClose} size={16} />
        </button>
      </span>

      <span className={styles.stage} style={stage} data-reset={phase === 'reset' || undefined} aria-hidden="true">
        {/* The tiny home's IND / US switch: the knob slides to US when it's tapped. */}
        <span className={styles.switch} data-us={at('us') || undefined}>
          <span className={styles.knob} />
          <span className={styles.half} data-press={phase === 'tapUs' || undefined}><Flag market="in" />{t('us.tabs.inShort')}</span>
          <span className={styles.half}><Flag market="us" />{t('us.tabs.usShort')}</span>
        </span>

        {/* The lists: IND slides out to the left as US slides in from the right. */}
        <span className={styles.list} data-place={at('us') ? 'out' : 'in'}>
          {IND_ROWS.map((row) => (
            <span key={row.sym} className={styles.row}>
              <Avatar src={row.logo} initials={row.sym.slice(0, 2)} size={24} />
              <span className={styles.sym}>{row.sym}</span>
              <span className={styles.price}>{inr(row.price)}</span>
            </span>
          ))}
        </span>
        <span className={styles.list} data-place={at('us') ? 'in' : 'next'}>
          {US_ROWS.map((row) => (
            <span key={row.sym} className={styles.row} data-picked={(row === PICKED && at('tapRow')) || undefined}>
              <Avatar src={row.logo} initials={row.sym.slice(0, 2)} size={24} />
              <span className={styles.sym}>{row.sym}</span>
              <span className={styles.price}>{usd(row.price)}</span>
            </span>
          ))}
        </span>

        {/* NVIDIA's buy bar: slides up, Buy is tapped, it says bought. */}
        <span className={styles.buy} data-open={at('sheet') || undefined}>
          <Avatar src={PICKED.logo} initials={PICKED.sym.slice(0, 2)} size={24} />
          {at('bought') ? (
            <span className={styles.bought} key={`bought-${lap}`}>
              <Icon icon={msCheck} size={16} />
              {t('switchGuide.bought', { sym: PICKED.sym })}
            </span>
          ) : (
            <>
              <span className={styles.buyName}>
                <span className={styles.sym}>{PICKED.sym}</span>
                <span className={styles.fraction}>{t('switchGuide.fraction')}</span>
              </span>
              <span className={styles.buyButton} data-press={phase === 'tapBuy' || undefined}>{t('switchGuide.buy')}</span>
            </>
          )}
        </span>

        {/* One fingertip for the whole story. */}
        <span className={styles.cursor} data-press={pressing || undefined} data-away={phase === 'start' || at('bought') || undefined} />
      </span>

      {/* Switch · Explore · Trade: the line fills as the story goes. */}
      <span className={styles.steps} aria-hidden="true">
        <span className={styles.track}><span style={{ width: `${(act + (at('reset') ? 1 : 0.5)) * 33.34}%` }} /></span>
        {ACTS.map((a, i) => <span key={a} className={styles.act} data-state={i < act ? 'done' : i === act ? 'now' : 'next'}>{t(a)}</span>)}
      </span>
      <span className={styles.caption} key={act}>{t(CAPTIONS[act])}</span>

      <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" fullWidth onClick={onView}>{t('switchGuide.cta')}</Button>
    </span>
  )
}
```
