### `src/flows/stocks/components/us/UsHomeF1.tsx`

```tsx
// The US tab of homepage version V16, "F1 · US home" (Figma 6441:3, "F1-01 · US Home · holding · full scroll"):
// the holdings hero (UsHero, on top of the page), then this feed — shortcuts, Start Trading, Top Movers (a list),
// By Market Cap, Brands You Know (round logos), Discover ETFs, Heatmap, Explore by themes (the earlier rail, not
// Figma's 2 × 2 — the user's call) and Announcements.
// Top analyst picks and the Watchlist rail are not on this home: the picks open from the shortcut, the watchlist is
// Top Movers' first chip.
// FLAG: hand-made sideways scrollers, logo bubbles and announcement cards' insides — see UsHomeF1.module.css.
import { Avatar } from '@l3/components/Avatar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Grid } from '@l3/components/Grid'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { MaskIcon } from '@l3/components/MaskIcon'
import { PriceChange } from '@l3/components/PriceChange'
import { SectionHeader } from '@l3/components/SectionHeader'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { msChevronRight } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { handToMarket } from '../../../../shared/data/marketHandoff'
import { useLiveQuote } from '../../../../shared/data/live'
import { usLogo, usQuote, viewUsStock } from '../../../../shared/data/usStocks'
import { Usd } from '../../../../shared/money'
import { useFlowOption } from '../../../../shared/prototype'
import { StockListCard } from '../../../../shared/ui/StockListCard'
import { t } from '../../copy'
import zingArt from '../../assets/shortcuts/zing.svg'
import etfArt from '../../assets/shortcuts/etf-pie.svg'
import picksArt from '../../assets/shortcuts/analyst-picks.svg'
import moreArt from '../../assets/shortcuts/more.svg'
import watchlistIcon from '../../assets/us/movers/watchlist.svg'
import activeIcon from '../../assets/us/movers/most-traded.svg'
import gainersIcon from '../../assets/us/movers/gainers.svg'
import losersIcon from '../../assets/us/movers/losers.svg'
import {
  announcements,
  f1Brands,
  f1CapStocks,
  f1Caps,
  f1MoverChips,
  f1MoversFor,
  f1Themes,
  startTrading,
  themes,
  usStock,
  type Brand,
  type F1Cap,
  type F1MoverChip,
  type F1Theme,
  type Mover,
  type ThemeId,
} from './data'
import { Shortcuts as HomeShortcuts } from '../Discover'
import { DiscoverEtfs, FlatList, MonthLine, UsHeatmap } from './UsHome'
import { LogoStack, ThemeRail } from './ThemeCard'
import styles from './UsHomeF1.module.css'

type UsHomeF1Props = {
  /** A US stock was tapped (already remembered with `viewUsStock`) → its stock page. */
  onStock?: (sym: string) => void
  /** Top Movers' View All (Market was handed what to open on) → the Market page. */
  onMarket?: () => void
  /** A theme tile → that theme's page. */
  onTheme?: (id: ThemeId) => void
  /** The ETFs shortcut, Discover ETFs' View All and the Leveraged ETFs tile → the ETF list. */
  onEtfs?: () => void
  /** A Discover ETFs row (already remembered with `viewUsStock`) → the ETF page. */
  onEtf?: (sym: string) => void
  /** The Analyst picks shortcut → the Top analyst picks page. */
  onPicks?: () => void
  /** V17: the shortcuts as round icons over their labels (IND's look), not the outlined strip (8 Nov). */
  roundShortcuts?: boolean
}

const moverIcons: Record<F1MoverChip, string> = { watchlist: watchlistIcon, active: activeIcon, gainers: gainersIcon, losers: losersIcon }

export function UsHomeF1({ onStock, onMarket, onTheme, onEtfs, onEtf, onPicks, roundShortcuts = false }: UsHomeF1Props) {
  const open = (sym: string) => {
    viewUsStock(sym)
    onStock?.(sym)
  }
  return (
    <>
      <Shortcuts onEtfs={onEtfs} onPicks={onPicks} round={roundShortcuts} />
      <StartTrading onOpen={open} />
      <TopMovers onOpen={open} onMarket={onMarket} />
      <ByMarketCap onOpen={open} />
      <Brands onOpen={open} />
      <DiscoverEtfs f1 onOpen={(sym) => { viewUsStock(sym); onEtf?.(sym) }} onViewAll={() => onEtfs?.()} />
      {/* Figma's compact heatmap: inset 16, rounded, shorter tiles, white text, no index switcher (the user's pick, 8 Nov). */}
      <UsHeatmap f1 onOpen={open} />
      <Themes onTheme={onTheme} />
      <Announcements onOpen={open} />
    </>
  )
}

/** V17's round US shortcuts on their own, for V18's top over the earlier US feed (UsHome `shortcuts`). */
export function UsRoundShortcuts({ onEtfs, onPicks }: { onEtfs?: () => void; onPicks?: () => void }) {
  return <Shortcuts onEtfs={onEtfs} onPicks={onPicks} round />
}

/**
 * Four shortcuts in one outlined strip split by hairlines (Figma's own icons): Zing, ETFs, Analyst picks, +3 more.
 * Zing and "+3 more" have no screen in the prototype yet, so they do nothing. `round` (V17): ETFs · Analyst picks ·
 * Watchlist · Referral in circles; Watchlist and Referral do nothing yet either.
 */
function Shortcuts({ onEtfs, onPicks, round = false }: { onEtfs?: () => void; onPicks?: () => void; round?: boolean }) {
  // V17 / V18: shown unless the "US shortcuts" option is off (on by default, 8 Nov).
  const roundOn = useFlowOption('stocks', 'usShortcuts', 'on') === 'on'
  const art = (src: string) => <img src={src} alt="" width={24} height={24} className={styles.shortcutArt} />
  const items: StripItem[] = [
    { id: 'zing', label: t('f1.shortcuts.zing'), icon: art(zingArt) },
    { id: 'etfs', label: t('f1.shortcuts.etfs'), icon: art(etfArt), onOpen: onEtfs },
    { id: 'picks', label: t('f1.shortcuts.picks'), icon: art(picksArt), onOpen: onPicks },
    { id: 'more', label: t('f1.shortcuts.more', { count: 3 }), icon: art(moreArt) },
  ]
  if (!round) return <ShortcutStrip items={items} />
  if (!roundOn) return null
  // V17 / V18 (8 Nov, the user's call): ETFs · Analyst picks · Watchlist · Referral — Watchlist and Referral in place of
  // Zing and +3 more — as the home's own shortcuts (Discover Shortcuts), so the Shortcuts option (V1 circles · V2 one
  // card) switches them as on the IND tab. The icons are V14's two-tone set in the US Stocks colour (.usArt).
  // Watchlist and Referral do nothing yet.
  return (
    <div className={styles.usArt}>
      <HomeShortcuts
        items={[
          { id: 'etfs', label: t('f1.shortcuts.etfs'), art: 'etf' },
          { id: 'picks', label: t('f1.shortcuts.picks'), art: 'analysis' },
          { id: 'watchlist', label: t('f1.shortcuts.watchlist'), art: 'watchlist' },
          { id: 'referral', label: t('f1.shortcuts.referral'), art: 'referral' },
        ]}
        onOpen={(id) => { if (id === 'etfs') onEtfs?.(); else if (id === 'picks') onPicks?.() }}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

export type StripItem = { id: string; label: string; icon: ReactNode; onOpen?: () => void }

/**
 * The V16 shortcut strip (Figma 6444:502): four columns in one outlined card, split by hairlines — a 24 icon over a
 * Label 10. US and IND tabs both use it.
 * `more`: the strip opens in place (8 Nov, the user's reference): the "+N more" cell (the last of `items`, id 'more')
 * unfolds the card into rows of four, split by a soft line, with these shortcuts after the first three and
 * "View Less ⌃" as the last cell, which folds it back.
 */
export function ShortcutStrip({ items, more, lessIcon }: { items: StripItem[]; more?: StripItem[]; /** View Less's icon (the strip's own colour). */ lessIcon?: ReactNode }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const toggle = more ? () => setOpen(!open) : undefined
  const cells = open && more
    ? [...items.filter((s) => s.id !== 'more'), ...more, { id: 'less', label: t('f1.shortcuts.less'), icon: lessIcon }]
    : items
  const rows: StripItem[][] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < cells.length; i += 4) rows.push(cells.slice(i, i + 4))
  return (
    <Inset paddingInline="12" paddingBlock="00">
      <Card padding="none" surface="default" className={styles.shortcuts} data-open={open || undefined}>
        {rows.map((row, r) => (
          <div key={r} className={styles.shortcutRow}>
            <Grid columns={4} gap="00">
              {row.map((s) => (
                <Card
                  key={s.id}
                  variant="flat"
                  padding="none"
                  className={styles.shortcut}
                  aria-expanded={s.id === 'more' || s.id === 'less' ? open : undefined}
                  onClick={(s.id === 'more' || s.id === 'less' ? toggle : s.onOpen) ?? (() => {})}
                >
                  <span className={styles.shortcutIcon}>{s.icon}</span>
                  <span className={styles.shortcutLabel}>{s.label}</span>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </Grid>
          </div>
        ))}
      </Card>
    </Inset>
  )
}

/** Start Trading: a sideways row of cards — logo, name over symbol, ›, the month's line, price and day change. */
function StartTrading({ onOpen }: { onOpen: (sym: string) => void }) {
  return (
    <Stack as="section" gap="12" aria-label={t('f1.start.title')}>
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00"><SectionHeader title={t('f1.start.title')} /></Inset>

function TradeCard({ mover, onOpen }: { mover: Mover; onOpen: (sym: string) => void }) {
  const stock = usStock(mover.sym, mover.name)
  const live = useLiveQuote(mover.sym, stock.price, stock.change)
  const up = live.changePct >= 0
  return (
    <Card onClick={() => onOpen(mover.sym)} surface="default" className={styles.tradeCard}>
      <span className={styles.tradeHead}>
        <Avatar src={usLogo(mover.sym)} initials={mover.sym.slice(0, 2)} size={24} />
        <span className={styles.tradeName}>
          <span>{mover.name}</span>
          <span>{mover.sym}</span>
        </span>
        <Icon icon={msChevronRight} size={20} />
      </span>
      <MonthLine closes={[...(usQuote(mover.sym)?.closes ?? []), live.price]} up={up} className={styles.tradeLine} />
      <span className={styles.tradeFoot}>
        <Usd value={live.price} layout="inline" />
        <PriceChange value={live.changePct} size="sm" />
      </span>
    </Card>
  )

/** Top Movers: icon chips (Watchlist · Most Traded · Top Gainers · Top Losers), five rows split by hairlines, View All. */
function TopMovers({ onOpen, onMarket }: { onOpen: (sym: string) => void; onMarket?: () => void }) {
  const [chip, setChip] = useState<F1MoverChip>('watchlist')
  // View All: Market on the US list, on the matching list where Market has one (gainers / losers), else All.

  return (

          value={chip}

/** Brands You Know: one row of round logos with the name and today's move under each. */
function Brands({ onOpen }: { onOpen: (sym: string) => void }) {

/**

 * Figma's 2 × 2 tiles — the user's call, 8 Nov. The tiles stay below (F1Themes) in case they come back.

function Themes({ onTheme }: { onTheme?: (id: ThemeId) => void }) {

/** Figma 6441:3's themes: four tiles, two by two — the name, ›, and an overlapping logo stack with "+n". Not shown. */
export function F1Themes({ onTheme, onEtfs }: { onTheme?: (id: ThemeId) => void; onEtfs?: () => void }) {
  const openTheme = (theme: F1Theme) => (theme.opens === 'etfs' ? onEtfs?.() : onTheme?.(theme.opens))
  return (

/** Announcements: a sideways row of cards — a "New listing" tag, the stock's logo, a line and a description. */
function Announcements({ onOpen }: { onOpen: (sym: string) => void }) {
  return (
    <Stack as="section" gap="12" aria-label={t('f1.announcements.title')}>
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00"><SectionHeader title={t('f1.announcements.title')} /></Inset>
      <div className={styles.scroller} role="region" aria-label={t('f1.announcements.railLabel')}>
        <div className={styles.row}>
          {announcements.map((a) => (
            <Card key={a.id} onClick={() => onOpen(a.sym)} surface="primary" className={styles.announcement}>
              <Tag color="discover" size="sm">{t('f1.announcements.tag')}</Tag>
              <span className={styles.announcementBody}>
                <Avatar src={usLogo(a.sym)} initials={a.sym.slice(0, 2)} size={32} />
                <span className={styles.announcementText}>
                  <span>{t('f1.announcements.arm.title')}</span>
                  <span>{t('f1.announcements.arm.text')}</span>
                </span>
              </span>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/us/data.ts`

```ts
// Data for the US Stocks tab of Home (what the API sends for it), ported from the US Stocks prototype's Home
// (usHomeData.ts, marketState.ts). Prices, day changes and the indices are real (the shared US snapshot,
// src/shared/data/us-market-snapshot.json) and tick with live.ts; market caps and the user's holdings are samples.
// The words the app itself says are in copy.json (`us.*`).
import { catalogue, usIndexQuote, usQuote } from '../../../../shared/data/usStocks'
import type { Watchlist } from '../../../../shared/data/portfolio'
import benefitBolt from '../../assets/us/benefit-bolt.svg'
import benefitDash from '../../assets/in/benefit-dash.svg'
import benefitBrokerage from '../../assets/in/benefit-brokerage.svg'
import benefitMtf from '../../assets/in/benefit-mtf.svg'
import { t } from '../../copy'

/** The US tab's index strip (the IND tab's strip shows NIFTY 50 / SENSEX / NIFTY BANK). Same shape as shared `indices`. */
export const usIndices = [
  { id: 'sp-500', name: 'S&P 500' },
  { id: 'nasdaq', name: 'NASDAQ' },
  { id: 'dow-jones', name: 'DOW JONES' },
].map((index) => ({
  ...index,
  // Read each time, so the strip follows the runtime refresh of the US snapshot.
  get value() { return usIndexQuote(index.id)?.price ?? 0 },
  get changePct() { return usIndexQuote(index.id)?.changePct ?? 0 },
}))

/** A US stock as a card or row shows it: the catalogue's (real) data, or made-up but stable numbers for a symbol the
 *  snapshot doesn't have. */
export function usStock(sym: string, name?: string) {
  const known = catalogue[sym]
  const seed = [...sym].reduce((n, c) => n * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0), 7) % 9000
  return {
    sym,
    name: known?.name ?? name ?? sym,
    price: known?.price ?? 20 + seed / 20,
    change: known?.change ?? ((seed % 400) - 200) / 100,
  }
}

// ---- Activation card (one per US state) ----

/** Where the user is with US Stocks: the card on top of the US tab (and what the tab shows) follows it. */
export type UsState = 'kyc' | 'activate' | 'review' | 'support' | 'failed' | 'activated' | 'onTheWay' | 'ready' | 'holding'

export type BenefitId = 'fractional' | 'diversify' | 'kyc' | 'stocks' | 'evening' | 'debit' | 'convert' | 'credit' | 'dash' | 'brokerage' | 'mtf'
type CopyKey = Parameters<typeof t>[0]
/** A slide of the benefit strip: `tag` and `text` are copy keys (`us.benefit.<id>.*`, `in.benefit.<id>.*`). */
export type Benefit = { id: BenefitId; icon: string; tag: CopyKey; text: CopyKey }
type UsBenefitId = Exclude<BenefitId, 'dash' | 'brokerage' | 'mtf'>
const benefit = (id: UsBenefitId): Benefit => ({ id, icon: benefitBolt, tag: `us.benefit.${id}.tag`, text: `us.benefit.${id}.text` })
/** Indian stocks' benefits, each with its own icon (Figma "IND KYC Not started"). */
const inBenefit = (id: 'dash' | 'brokerage' | 'mtf', icon: string): Benefit => ({ id, icon, tag: `in.benefit.${id}.tag`, text: `in.benefit.${id}.text` })
/** The three benefits a not-yet-active card rotates through. */
export const lockedBenefits: Benefit[] = [benefit('fractional'), benefit('diversify'), benefit('kyc')]

export type CardSpec = {
  /** The card's tint: blue (US-stock accent) · honey (under review, money on the way) · red (failed) · green (activated, ready) · neutral (holdings only). */
  tone: 'blue' | 'honey' | 'red' | 'green' | 'neutral'
  /** Copy keys (copy.json) of the card's words. */
  title: CopyKey
  subtitle: CopyKey
  cta?: CopyKey
  /** A state icon beside the title. */
  icon?: 'hourglass' | 'error' | 'check' | 'clock'
  /** The rotating benefits strip (none when the card is only a message). */
  slides?: Benefit[]
  /** The button ends with an arrow. */
  arrow?: boolean
  /** The CTA moves money (add money): brand colour, the app's rule for transaction buttons. Not on the activated card's
   *  "Add Money to US wallet" (3 Nov): an exception, it stays Primary like the card's other CTAs. */
  money?: boolean
  /** The line over the benefits, with a lock ("Start to unlock exclusive benefits"); `unlocked`: an open lock. */
  lockLine?: CopyKey
  unlocked?: boolean
  /** In place of the benefits: the money's journey to the US wallet (money on the way). */

}

/**
 * Money on the way: an add-money transfer from the user's Indian bank to the US wallet (LRS). It takes 1–2 working days:

 * bank by wire (the slow step) → in the wallet, ready to trade. Sample data — the API sends the amounts, times and which
 * step it's on.
 */

/** The (up to) fifteen movers (one swipeable row of cards) of a cap bucket for a filter, from their real day change and range: gainers = biggest rises,
 *  losers = biggest falls, most active = highest volume, 52W high / low = closest to it. */
export function moversFor(cap: CapValue, filter: MoverFilter): MoverToday[] {
  // Only stocks the snapshot has a real price for (a symbol Yahoo didn't answer for is left out).
  const today = movers[cap].filter((m) => usQuote(m.sym)?.price != null).map((m) => ({ ...m, change: usStock(m.sym).change, q: usQuote(m.sym) }))
  const near = (to: 'high52' | 'low52') => (m: (typeof today)[number]) => (m.q?.[to] ? Math.abs(m.q.price / m.q[to]! - 1) : 9)
  const sorted =
    filter === 'gainers' ? today.filter((m) => m.change > 0).sort((a, b) => b.change - a.change)
    : filter === 'losers' ? today.filter((m) => m.change < 0).sort((a, b) => a.change - b.change)
    : filter === 'active' ? today.sort((a, b) => (b.q?.volume ?? 0) - (a.q?.volume ?? 0))
    : today.sort((a, b) => near(filter)(a) - near(filter)(b))
  return sorted.slice(0, 15).map(({ sym, name, change }) => ({ sym, name, up: change >= 0 }))
}

/** The analysts' consensus (sample). Home shows four as a list (or all as cards); "View all" opens the Top analyst
 *  picks page (stocks-29), with the full breakdown and the closed picks. */
export type AnalystPick = {
  sym: string
  name: string
  rating: 'Strong Buy' | 'Buy' | 'Sell'
  /** Expected profit, % (sample): the analysts' average 12-month target over today's price. Always positive — a pick. */
  expectedProfit: number
  /** Share of the analysts covering it who rate it Buy or Strong Buy, % (= ratings: strong buy + buy over all). */
  analystsPct: number
  /** How the analysts covering it rate it (sample counts). */
  ratings: { strongBuy: number; buy: number; hold: number; sell: number }
  /** When it became a pick. */
  pickedOn: string
}

    { sym: 'BOTZ', headline: 'Robots and AI makers', fund: 'Global X Robotics & AI ETF', issuer: 'globalx' },
    discoverEtfs.china[3],
  ],
  industrials: [
    { sym: 'ITA', headline: 'US aircraft and defence', fund: 'iShares US Aerospace & Defense', issuer: 'ishares' },
    { sym: 'UFO', headline: 'Space and satellite companies', fund: 'Procure Space ETF' },
  ],
  financials: [{ sym: 'XLF', headline: 'US banks and insurers', fund: 'Financial Select Sector SPDR', issuer: 'spdr' }],
  healthcare: [{ sym: 'XLV', headline: 'US drug makers and hospitals', fund: 'Health Care Select Sector SPDR', issuer: 'spdr' }],
  energy: [{ sym: 'XLE', headline: 'US oil and gas companies', fund: 'Energy Select Sector SPDR', issuer: 'spdr' }],
}

// ---- Explore by themes ----

export type ThemeId = 'ai' | 'bigtech' | 'dividend' | 'ev' | 'health' | 'parking'

/** A theme's return, %, over 1 and 3 years: all its stocks in equal amounts (sample — the snapshot has one month of closes). */
export type ThemeReturns = { '1y': number; '3y': number }

/**
 * A theme (the old app's "idea"): its stocks, in the order the theme page lists them. Name and description are copy
 * (`us.theme.<id>`, `us.theme.<id>.desc`); every symbol is in the US snapshot with a logo, so prices and logos are real.
 * Leveraged ETFs are off for now (no theme), "Dollar parking" is steady large caps to hold dollars in (ETFs have the ETFs shortcut).
 */
export const themes: { id: ThemeId; symbols: string[]; returns: ThemeReturns }[] = [
  { id: 'ai', symbols: ['NVDA', 'AMD', 'AVGO', 'MU', 'QCOM', 'INTC', 'PLTR', 'ORCL'], returns: { '1y': 48.6, '3y': 212.4 } },
  { id: 'bigtech', symbols: ['AAPL', 'MSFT', 'GOOGL', 'AMZN', 'META', 'NFLX', 'ADBE', 'CRM'], returns: { '1y': 27.3, '3y': 96.8 } },
  { id: 'dividend', symbols: ['KO', 'JNJ', 'XOM', 'PEP', 'PG', 'CVX', 'ABBV', 'MRK'], returns: { '1y': 9.4, '3y': 24.1 } },
  { id: 'ev', symbols: ['TSLA', 'RIVN', 'NIO', 'LCID', 'F', 'GM', 'PLUG', 'CHPT'], returns: { '1y': -18.2, '3y': -41.5 } },
  { id: 'health', symbols: ['LLY', 'JNJ', 'UNH', 'ABBV', 'MRK', 'PFE'], returns: { '1y': 6.1, '3y': 38.7 } },
  { id: 'parking', symbols: ['JPM', 'V', 'MA', 'WMT', 'COST', 'MCD', 'PG', 'HD'], returns: { '1y': 16.8, '3y': 52.3 } },
]

export const themeById = (id: ThemeId) => themes.find((theme) => theme.id === id)!

/** A theme's 1-month return, %: its stocks in equal amounts, from the snapshot's month of closes (real). */
export const themeMonthReturn = (symbols: string[]) => {
  const moves = symbols.flatMap((sym) => {
    const closes = usQuote(sym)?.closes ?? []
    return closes.length > 1 ? [(closes[closes.length - 1] - closes[0]) / closes[0]] : []
  })
  return moves.length ? (moves.reduce((sum, m) => sum + m, 0) / moves.length) * 100 : 0
}

/** The theme the theme page (stocks-23 …) shows is one screen per theme: `themeScreenId`. */
export const themeScreenId = (id: ThemeId) => `stocks-${23 + themes.findIndex((theme) => theme.id === id)}`


/** The user's US watchlists on the US tab (names are the user's own), in the IN tab's Watchlist rail. */
export const usWatchlists: Watchlist[] = [
  { id: 'us-tech', name: 'US tech', count: 9 },
  { id: 'dividends', name: 'Dividend payers', count: 5 },
  { id: 'us-research', name: 'To research', count: 0 },
]

// ---- F1 home (Figma 6441:3, homepage version V16) ----

/** Start Trading: the cards in Figma's order (real prices and month lines from the snapshot). */
export const startTrading: Mover[] = [
  { sym: 'MSFT', name: 'Microsoft' },
  { sym: 'AAPL', name: 'Apple' },
  { sym: 'NVDA', name: 'NVIDIA' },
  { sym: 'AMZN', name: 'Amazon' },
  { sym: 'GOOGL', name: 'Google' },
]

/** Top Movers' chips on the F1 home, in Figma's order. Watchlist is the user's own list; the rest are today's movers. */
export type F1MoverChip = 'watchlist' | 'active' | 'gainers' | 'losers'
export const f1MoverChips: F1MoverChip[] = ['watchlist', 'active', 'gainers', 'losers']
/** How many rows Top Movers lists (View All → Market for the rest). */
export const F1_MOVERS_COUNT = 5

/** The stocks on the user's US watchlist (Top Movers' first chip), as in Figma. */
export const usWatchlistStocks: Mover[] = [
  { sym: 'TSLA', name: 'Tesla' },
  { sym: 'GOOGL', name: 'Google' },
  { sym: 'AAPL', name: 'Apple' },
  { sym: 'MSFT', name: 'Microsoft' },
  { sym: 'NVDA', name: 'NVIDIA' },
]

/** Top Movers rows for a chip: the watchlist as it is, the others from today's mega caps (moversFor). */
export function f1MoversFor(chip: F1MoverChip): Mover[] {
  if (chip === 'watchlist') return usWatchlistStocks.filter((m) => usQuote(m.sym)?.price != null)
  return moversFor('mega', chip).slice(0, F1_MOVERS_COUNT)
}

/**
 * By Market Cap's chips: Figma's Large / Mid / Small / Micro, one per cap bucket the data has (largest first). So
 * "Large" lists the mega caps and "Micro" the small ones — the buckets are the same four, only the names are Figma's.
 */
export type F1Cap = 'large' | 'mid' | 'small' | 'micro'
export const f1Caps: F1Cap[] = ['large', 'mid', 'small', 'micro']
export const f1CapBucket: Record<F1Cap, CapValue> = { large: 'mega', mid: 'large', small: 'mid', micro: 'small' }
/** Cards per row in By Market Cap (two rows that scroll sideways together). */
export const F1_CAP_PER_ROW = 5

/** The cap's stocks for the two rows, biggest volume first (they have real prices). */
export function f1CapStocks(cap: F1Cap): Mover[] {
  return moversFor(f1CapBucket[cap], 'active').slice(0, F1_CAP_PER_ROW * 2)
}

/** Brands You Know as one row of round logos (Figma), the two-row list's brands in order. */
export const f1Brands: Brand[] = brandRows.flat()

/**
 * Explore by themes on the F1 home: Figma's four tiles. Each opens the closest page the prototype has: Trending → the
 * AI & chips theme, Leveraged ETFs → the ETF list (its Leveraged tab), Dividend Stocks and Dollar Parking → their themes.
 */
export type F1Theme = { id: 'trending' | 'leveraged' | 'dividend' | 'parking'; symbols: string[]; more: number; opens: ThemeId | 'etfs' }
export const f1Themes: F1Theme[] = [
  { id: 'trending', symbols: ['NVDA', 'AMD', 'AAPL'], more: 4, opens: 'ai' },
  { id: 'leveraged', symbols: ['MSFT', 'TSLA', 'AVGO'], more: 4, opens: 'etfs' },
  { id: 'dividend', symbols: ['META', 'AMZN', 'NFLX'], more: 4, opens: 'dividend' },
  { id: 'parking', symbols: ['GOOGL', 'KO', 'AVGO'], more: 24, opens: 'parking' },
]

/** Announcements rail: the tag, the stock (logo, tap → its page) and the copy keys. */
export type Announcement = { id: string; sym: string }
export const announcements: Announcement[] = [
  { id: 'arm', sym: 'ARM' },
  { id: 'arm-2', sym: 'ARM' },
]
```

```tsx
import { useId } from 'react'
import { BottomSheetHeader } from '@l3/components/BottomSheet'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { msCheckCircle } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { Sheet } from '../../../../../shared/ui/Sheet'
import { Spot } from '../../../../../shared/ui/Spot'
import { t } from '../../../copy'

/**
 * stocks-22 · "US Stocks is active", over the activated Home: the moment the review is approved (the twin of the
 * "activation submitted" sheet, stocks-18). Add Money → the $0 USD wallet; Later (or closing) → the activated Home.
 * Not in Jojo's Figma: added so the user is told they were approved, not only shown a green card.
 */
export function ActivationApprovedSheet({ onAddMoney, onLater }: { onAddMoney?: () => void; onLater?: () => void }) {
  const id = useId()
  return (
    <Sheet
      labelledBy={id}
      onClose={onLater}
      header={<BottomSheetHeader size="lg" headingId={id} icon={<Spot icon={msCheckCircle} tone="success" size="md" />} heading={t('us.approved.title')} description={t('us.approved.description')} />}
      footer={
        <ButtonGroup aria-label={t('us.approved.actions')}>
          <Button variant="brand" size="lg" onClick={onAddMoney}>{t('us.approved.addMoney')}</Button>
          <Button size="lg" variant="secondary" onClick={onLater}>{t('us.approved.later')}</Button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      }
    />
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/us/sheets/UsFtuxSheet.tsx`

```tsx
// The US Stocks intro (FTUX) sheet: shown over Home on the first launch after release. It animates in (blooms, an
// animated flag, company logos, a title, three benefits, an Activate button). Ported from the US Stocks prototype
// (screens/ftux/FtuxIntro.tsx). Rendered through Screen's `sheet`, so it covers the Home it was opened on.
// FLAG: hand-made sheet + scrim (layer / overlay / sheet in UsFtuxSheet.module.css) instead of L3 BottomSheet / Overlay.
// FLAG: hand-made close button, logo avatars and benefits list instead of L3 Button / Avatar / Card.
// FLAG: the artwork is positioned in px on a 360 frame (flag, blooms) — kept as the prototype drew it.
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties } from 'react'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { msClose, msHowToReg, msPieChart, msSchedule } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../../../copy'
import bloomBlue from '../../../assets/us/ftux/bloom-blue.svg'
import bloomRed from '../../../assets/us/ftux/bloom-red.svg'
import flag from '../../../assets/us/ftux/flag.webp'
import flagGhost from '../../../assets/us/ftux/flag-ghost.png'
import flagMaskGhost from '../../../assets/us/ftux/flag-mask-ghost.svg'
import flagMaskMain from '../../../assets/us/ftux/flag-mask-main.svg'
import markAapl from '../../../assets/us/ftux/mark-aapl.svg'
import markGoogl from '../../../assets/us/ftux/mark-googl.svg'
import markMsft from '../../../assets/us/ftux/mark-msft.svg'
import markNvda from '../../../assets/us/ftux/mark-nvda.svg'
import tsla from '../../../assets/us/ftux/tsla.png'
import styles from './UsFtuxSheet.module.css'

/** The width (px) the prototype drew the FTUX artwork on. */
const ART_FRAME = 360

/** `dark`: a white / dark-designed mark on a black plate (Apple, NVIDIA) — the sheet as it was.
 *  `invert`: with `onePlate` (the F1 homes, V16 / V17, 8 Nov), every logo shares one light plate and Apple's white mark
 *  is drawn black on it instead. */
type CompanyLogo = { name: string; src: string; size?: number; dark?: boolean; invert?: boolean; round?: boolean }

const logos: CompanyLogo[] = [
  { name: 'Apple', src: markAapl, size: 21.25, dark: true, invert: true },
  { name: 'NVIDIA', src: markNvda, size: 26.25, dark: true },
  { name: 'Tesla', src: tsla, round: true },
  { name: 'Microsoft', src: markMsft, size: 20 },
  { name: 'Google', src: markGoogl, size: 21.25 },
]

const benefits = [
  { icon: msPieChart, text: 'us.ftux.benefit.fractional' },
  { icon: msHowToReg, text: 'us.ftux.benefit.kyc' },
  { icon: msSchedule, text: 'us.ftux.benefit.evening' },
] as const

/** Activate → the activation pages (us-stocks-94); ✕, the scrim or Esc → Home (IND tab). Both play the closing animation first. */
export function UsFtuxSheet({ onActivate, onClose, cta, onePlate = false }: { onActivate?: () => void; onClose?: () => void; /** One light plate for every logo (the F1 homes). */ onePlate?: boolean; /** The button's label (default "Activate US Stocks"; an activated user gets "Explore US Stocks"). */ cta?: string }) {
  const [closing, setClosing] = useState(false)

  // Plays the closing animation (260 ms), then goes.
  const leave = (then?: () => void) => {
    if (closing) return
    setClosing(true)
    window.setTimeout(() => then?.(), 260)
  }
  const close = () => leave(onClose)

  // The artwork (flag, blooms) is drawn on a 360-wide frame: scale it to the sheet's width so the flag runs edge to edge
  // on every phone (360, 392, 412), instead of centring the 360 frame and leaving a gap at the sides.
  const sheet = useRef<HTMLElement>(null)
  const [artScale, setArtScale] = useState(1)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = sheet.current
    if (!el) return
    const sync = () => setArtScale((el.offsetWidth || ART_FRAME) / ART_FRAME)
    sync()
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(sync)
    observer.observe(el)
    return () => observer.disconnect()
  }, [])

  return (
    <div className={styles.layer} data-closing={closing || undefined} onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Escape' && close()}>
      <div className={styles.overlay} onClick={close} aria-hidden="true" />
      <section ref={sheet} className={styles.sheet} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="us-ftux-title">
        <div className={styles.decor} aria-hidden="true">
          <span className={styles.backdrop} />
          <div className={styles.art} style={{ '--art-scale': artScale } as CSSProperties}>
            <span className={styles.bloomRed}><img src={bloomRed} alt="" /></span>
            <span className={styles.bloomBlue}><img src={bloomBlue} alt="" /></span>
            <span className={styles.scrim} />
            <span className={styles.flagMask} data-layer="ghost" style={{ '--mask': `url("${flagMaskGhost}")` } as CSSProperties}>
              <span className={styles.flag}><img src={flagGhost} alt="" /></span>
            </span>
            <span className={styles.flagMask} data-layer="main" style={{ '--mask': `url("${flagMaskMain}")` } as CSSProperties}>
              {/* Animated WebP (the prototype's flag.gif was 29 MB) */}
              <span className={styles.flag}><img src={flag} alt="" /></span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <span className={styles.sheetBg} aria-hidden="true" />
        <button type="button" className={styles.close} onClick={close} aria-label={t('us.sheet.close')}>
          <Icon icon={msClose} size={18} />
        </button>
        <div className={styles.fade} />
        <div className={styles.content}>
          <div className={styles.logos} role="img" aria-label={t('us.ftux.logos')}>
            {logos.map((logo, i) => (
              <span key={logo.name} className={styles.logo} data-one-plate={onePlate || undefined} data-dark={(!onePlate && logo.dark) || undefined} style={{ '--i': i } as CSSProperties}>
                {logo.round ? <img src={logo.src} alt="" className={styles.logoImg} /> : <img src={logo.src} alt="" data-invert={(onePlate && logo.invert) || undefined} className={styles.logoMark} style={{ width: logo.size, height: logo.size }} />}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
          <h2 id="us-ftux-title" className={styles.title} style={{ '--i': 0 } as CSSProperties}>{t('us.ftux.title')}</h2>
          <ul className={styles.benefits}>
            {benefits.map((benefit, i) => (
              <li key={benefit.text} className={styles.benefit} style={{ '--i': i + 2 } as CSSProperties}>
                <Icon icon={benefit.icon} size={20} />
                {t(benefit.text)}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
        <ButtonGroup aria-label={t('us.ftux.actions')} className={styles.dock}>
          <Button variant="primary" size="lg" fullWidth onClick={() => leave(onActivate)}>{cta ?? t('us.ftux.cta')}</Button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/us/useAutoSlide.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'

/**
 * Auto-advancing carousel position. `pos` counts up (the track has one extra copy of slide 0 at the end); when it reaches
 * the copy, `snap` flips on for a frame while `pos` jumps back to 0 without animating. `index` is the visible slide.
 * `go(1)` / `go(-1)` step by hand (a swipe) and restart the timer, so the next auto step waits a full `every`.
 */
export function useAutoSlide(count: number, { every = 3000, slideMs = 500, still = false }: { every?: number; slideMs?: number; still?: boolean } = {}) {
  const [pos, setPos] = useState(0)
  const [snap, setSnap] = useState(false)
  const [restart, setRestart] = useState(0)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (still || count < 2 || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setPos((p) => p + 1), every)
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer)
  }, [count, every, still, restart])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (count < 2 || pos < count) return
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setSnap(true)
      setPos(0)
    }, slideMs + 20)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [pos, count, slideMs])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!snap) return
    let inner = 0
    const outer = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      inner = requestAnimationFrame(() => setSnap(false))
    })
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(outer)
      cancelAnimationFrame(inner)
    }
  }, [snap])

  const go = useCallback((step: 1 | -1) => {
    if (count < 2) return
    // Back from the first slide runs across to the last one.
    setPos((p) => (step === 1 ? Math.min(p + 1, count) : p % count === 0 ? count - 1 : p - 1))
    setRestart((r) => r + 1)
  }, [count])

  return { pos, index: count ? pos % count : 0, snap, go }
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/us/useLiveHeatmap.ts`

```ts
import { liveQuote, useLiveTick } from '../../../../shared/data/live'
import { heatSymbols, usStock, type HeatValue } from './data'

/** The heatmap's tiles: each stock's real price and day change (the US snapshot), moving every 2 s with live.ts.
 *  `symbols`: the tiles to show (the Sectors heatmap passes a sector's); default the nine on the original heatmap. */
export function useLiveHeatmap(symbols: string[] = heatSymbols): HeatValue[] {
  const at = useLiveTick()
  return symbols.map((sym) => {
    const stock = usStock(sym)
    const live = liveQuote(sym, stock.price, stock.change, at)
    return { sym, pct: live.changePct, price: live.price }
  })
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/components/useSwipeBetween.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, useLayoutEffect, useRef } from 'react'

// Ported from the US Stocks prototype (screens/home/useSwipeBetween.ts): swipe the page sideways to switch IND ↔ US.
// FLAG: hand-made swipe gesture (pointer events + translate) — L3 has no swipeable pages.

const MIN_DISTANCE = 48
const MIN_VELOCITY = 0.45
const EASING = 'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)'
const SLIDE_MS = 280
// The rest of the page: a quick dissolve, done while the card is still moving.
const FADE_OUT_MS = 100
const FADE_IN_MS = 200

const reducedMotion = () => typeof matchMedia !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches

/** The item `step` places after/before `current` in `list`, or null at the ends. */
export const neighbour = <T,>(list: T[], current: T, step: number): T | null => {
  const at = list.indexOf(current) + step
  return at >= 0 && at < list.length ? list[at] : null
}

// Is there a sideways-scrolling element between the touch target and the swipe container (a card rail)? Then it scrolls, not swipes.
const insideSideScroller = (from: HTMLElement | null, stop: HTMLElement) => {
  for (let el = from; el && el !== stop; el = el.parentElement) {
    const overflowX = getComputedStyle(el).overflowX
    if ((overflowX === 'auto' || overflowX === 'scroll') && el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1) return true
  }
  return false
}

/** Pointer-swipe on an element: `onSwipe(±1)` when released far/fast enough, `onDrag(dx)` while dragging (null when it ends). */
function useSwipe(onSwipe: (direction: 1 | -1) => void, onDrag: (dx: number | null) => void, area?: string) {
  const swipeRef = useRef(onSwipe)
  swipeRef.current = onSwipe
  const dragRef = useRef(onDrag)
  dragRef.current = onDrag
  const cleanup = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null)

  return useCallback((el: HTMLElement | null) => {
    cleanup.current?.()
    cleanup.current = null
    if (!el) return
    el.style.touchAction = 'pan-y'
    let start: { x: number; y: number; t: number; id: number } | null = null
    let swiped = false
    let dragging = false

    const down = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement
      // `data-own-swipe`: a part with its own swipe (the activation card's benefits strip) keeps the gesture.
      if (e.button !== 0 || target.closest('input, textarea, [role="dialog"], [contenteditable], [data-own-swipe]') || insideSideScroller(target, el)) return
      // `area`: the swipe starts only there (the top card), not anywhere on the page.
      if (area && !target.closest(area)) return
      start = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, t: e.timeStamp, id: e.pointerId }
      swiped = false
      dragging = false
    }
    const move = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!start || e.pointerId !== start.id || !dragRef.current) return
      const dx = e.clientX - start.x
      const dy = e.clientY - start.y
      if (!dragging) {
        if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 8) return
        if (Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy) * 1.5) {
          start = null
          return
        }
        dragging = true
      }
      dragRef.current(dx)
    }
    const up = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!start || e.pointerId !== start.id) return
      const dx = e.clientX - start.x
      const dy = e.clientY - start.y
      const velocity = Math.abs(dx) / Math.max(1, e.timeStamp - start.t)
      start = null
      if (dragging) dragRef.current?.(null)
      dragging = false
      if (Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy) * 1.5) return
      if (Math.abs(dx) >= MIN_DISTANCE || (Math.abs(dx) >= 24 && velocity >= MIN_VELOCITY)) {
        swiped = true
        swipeRef.current(dx < 0 ? 1 : -1)
      }
    }
    const cancel = () => {
      if (dragging) dragRef.current?.(null)
      start = null
      dragging = false
    }
    // A swipe that ends on a button must not also click it.
    const click = (e: Event) => {
      if (swiped) {
        swiped = false
        e.preventDefault()
        e.stopPropagation()
      }
    }
    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', down)
    el.addEventListener('pointermove', move)
    el.addEventListener('pointerup', up)
    el.addEventListener('pointercancel', cancel)
    el.addEventListener('click', click, true)
    cleanup.current = () => {
      el.removeEventListener('pointerdown', down)
      el.removeEventListener('pointermove', move)
      el.removeEventListener('pointerup', up)
      el.removeEventListener('pointercancel', cancel)
      el.removeEventListener('click', click, true)
    }
  }, [])
}

/**
 * Swipe between two markets' pages: only the top cards move sideways — a track with both, the other one beside it,
 * follows the finger and slides across so the other market's card comes into view, as in a carousel — while the rest of the page (`fades()`) just dissolves
 * into the other market's. A tap on a switcher (`go`) runs the same switch, so a swipe and a tap look alike.
 * `bind` goes on the scroll container; `area` is where a swipe may start (the cards); `slides()` returns what moves
 * sideways (the cards' track), `fades()` what dissolves (the feed under it).
 */
export function useSwipeBetween({ canGo, onSwitch, page, area, slides, fades }: { canGo: (direction: 1 | -1) => boolean; onSwitch: (direction: 1 | -1) => void; page: string; area?: string; slides: () => HTMLElement[]; fades: () => HTMLElement[] }) {
  const entering = useRef<number>(0)
  const settling = useRef(false)
  const leaving = useRef(false)
  const pageNow = useRef(page)
  pageNow.current = page

  const springBack = () => {
    for (const el of slides()) {
      if (!el.style.translate) continue
      const from = { translate: el.style.translate }
      el.style.translate = ''
      el.animate([from, { translate: '0 0' }], { duration: 240, easing: EASING })
    }
  }

  // The track slides to the other card (from where the finger left it) as the rest fades out; then the switch.
  const leave = (direction: 1 | -1, commit: () => void) => {
    if (leaving.current) return
    entering.current = direction
    const moving = slides()
    const dissolving = fades()
    if (reducedMotion() || (!moving.length && !dissolving.length)) return commit()
    leaving.current = true
    Promise.all([
      ...moving.map((el) => {
        const from = { translate: el.style.translate || '0 0' }
        el.style.translate = ''
        // The track moves one card's width: the other card is then where this one was.
        return el.animate([from, { translate: `${-direction * el.offsetWidth}px 0` }], { duration: SLIDE_MS, easing: EASING, fill: 'forwards' }).finished
      }),
      ...dissolving.map((el) => el.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: FADE_OUT_MS, easing: 'linear', fill: 'forwards' }).finished),
    ]).then(done, done)
    function done() {
      leaving.current = false
      const was = pageNow.current
      commit()
      // The switch didn't happen (still the same page once React has had time to render): bring the old one back
      // rather than leave it hidden.
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (pageNow.current !== was || !entering.current) return
        entering.current = 0
        for (const el of [...slides(), ...fades()]) el.getAnimations().forEach((a) => a.cancel())
      }, 120)
    }
  }

  const swipeBind = useSwipe(
    (direction) => {
      settling.current = false
      if (!canGo(direction)) return springBack()
      leave(direction, () => onSwitch(direction))
    },
    (dx) => {
      if (reducedMotion() || leaving.current) return
      if (dx === null) {
        settling.current = true
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (settling.current) springBack()
          settling.current = false
        }, 0)
        return
      }
      // Swiping is off altogether (neither way goes): the card doesn't even rubber-band.
      if (!canGo(1) && !canGo(-1)) return
      // Towards a market: the card follows the finger. Past the last one: a short rubber band.
      const pull = canGo(dx < 0 ? 1 : -1) ? 1 : 0.18
      for (const el of slides()) el.style.translate = `${dx * pull}px 0`
    },
    area,
  )

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const from = entering.current
    if (!from) return
    entering.current = 0
    const motion = !reducedMotion()
    // The track has already brought the new card into place: it just resets (now with that card in the middle).
    for (const el of slides()) {
      el.getAnimations().forEach((a) => a.cancel())
      el.style.translate = ''
    }
    for (const el of fades()) {
      el.getAnimations().forEach((a) => a.cancel())
      if (motion) el.animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 }], { duration: FADE_IN_MS, easing: 'linear' })
    }
  }, [page])

  return {
    bind: swipeBind,
    /** Switch by tap (tabs, market button): the same switch as a swipe, towards `direction`. */
    go: (direction: 1 | -1, commit: () => void) => leave(direction, commit),
  }
}
```

```ts
export type Shortcut = { id: string; label: string; art: ShortcutArt; badge?: { count: number } }

/**

 * (3 Nov: no Fractional or Market hours). The US home's quick access lives here, in the white body; the grey summary
 * has no product tiles on the US tab.
 */
export const usShortcuts: Shortcut[] = [
  { id: 'analysis', label: 'Analysis', art: 'analysis' },
  { id: 'etfs', label: 'ETFs', art: 'etf' },
  { id: 'watchlist', label: 'Watchlist', art: 'watchlist' },
  { id: 'referral', label: 'Referral', art: 'referral' },
]

/**
 * Top movers: three lists, picked with the chips.
 * All three come from the company catalogue (src/shared/data/companies.ts — a real Yahoo Finance snapshot, refreshed
 * at runtime), so they're read at render time: call `topMovers(list)` inside a component that calls `useMarketSnapshot()`.
 */
export type MoverList = 'gainers' | 'losers' | 'under-100'
/** How many cards a list shows (two rows of three). */
export const MOVERS_COUNT = 6

/** A catalogue company as a mover card shows it (same shape as the shared `Stock`). */
function asStock(c: Company): Stock {
  return { symbol: c.symbol, name: c.name, price: c.market!.price, changePct: c.market!.changePct, initials: c.initials, logoUrl: c.logoUrl }
}

/**
 * The stocks a list shows now. A gainer is up today and a loser down — a flat or falling stock never shows as a gainer.
 * Under ₹100 = the catalogue's cheapest stocks, cheapest first (the catalogue carries a few for it: IDEA, YESBANK,
 * SOUTHBANK, SUZLON, NHPC, IRFC); if a price climbs past ₹100 the card stays — fine for the prototype.
 */
export function topMovers(list: MoverList): Stock[] {
  const priced = Object.values(companies).filter((c) => c.market)
  const picked =
    list === 'under-100'
      ? priced.sort((a, b) => a.market!.price - b.market!.price)
      : companiesByChange(list).filter((c) => (list === 'gainers' ? c.market!.changePct > 0 : c.market!.changePct < 0))
  return picked.slice(0, MOVERS_COUNT).map(asStock)
}

/** Smart Invest: managed strategies (auto buy & sell). Last week = one result per trading day. */
export type Strategy = {

  lastWeek: { day: 'M' | 'T' | 'W' | 'Th' | 'F'; result: 'profit' | 'loss' }[]
```

### `src/flows/stocks/index.tsx`

```tsx
import { emailSupport } from '../../shared/support'
import { useEffect, useState, type ComponentProps } from 'react'
import type { Flow } from '../types'
import { goToTab } from '../../shared/ui/MainNav'
import type { Go } from '../types'
import { Home, markUsIntroSeen } from './screens/Home'
import { t } from './copy'
import { activeHomeVersions, DEFAULT_HOME_VERSION } from './components/homeVersions'
import { themes, themeScreenId, type ThemeId, type UsState } from './components/us/data'
import { ThemePage } from './screens/ThemePage'
import { BrandsPage } from './screens/BrandsPage'
import { AnalystPicksPage } from './screens/AnalystPicksPage'
import { setUsJourney, useUsJourney } from '../../shared/userStatus'
import { ActivationApprovedSheet } from './components/us/sheets/ActivationApprovedSheet'
import { ActivationSubmittedSheet } from './components/us/sheets/ActivationSubmittedSheet'
import { UsFtuxSheet } from './components/us/sheets/UsFtuxSheet'

/** The US tab's taps, by screen id: Activate US Stocks → the activation pages (us-stocks-94: declarations, then the bank), a stock → its page (not activated, in the US Stocks flow), View all / a theme → Market on the US list. */
const usNav = (go: Go) => ({ onActivateUs: () => go('us-stocks-94'), onUsStock: () => go('us-stocks-13'), onUsMarket: () => go('market-10'), onUsTheme: (id: ThemeId) => go(themeScreenId(id)), onUsEtfs: () => go('us-stocks-71'), onUsEtf: () => go('us-stocks-72'), onUsPicks: () => go('stocks-29'), onUsBrands: () => go('stocks-31'), onUsHoldings: () => go('us-stocks-77'), onInHoldings: () => go('us-stocks-05') })

/** The top bar and navbar taps every Home screen shares. */
/** Search from the Home field: the Stocks tab on IND, the US tab on US (search-29). */
const searchFor = (market: 'in' | 'us') => (market === 'us' ? 'search-29' : 'search-01')

const chrome = (go: Go) => ({ onTab: (t: Parameters<typeof goToTab>[1]) => goToTab(go, t), onSearch: (m: 'in' | 'us') => go(searchFor(m)), onProfile: () => go('profile-01'), onCommodities: () => go('fno-08'), onAddMoney: () => go('deposit-01') })

/** Wallet icon on the US tab, by where the user is (screens of the US Stocks flow): Indian wallet · under review · failed · $0 · funded. */
const walletFor: Record<UsState, string> = { kyc: 'us-stocks-53', activate: 'us-stocks-53', review: 'us-stocks-55', support: 'us-stocks-57', failed: 'us-stocks-56', activated: 'us-stocks-20', onTheWay: 'us-stocks-28', ready: 'us-stocks-59', holding: 'us-stocks-59' }

/** A Home screen on the US tab in one of the user's US Stocks states (Figma frames designed in the US Stocks flow). */
const usHome = (go: Go, usState: UsState, extra: Partial<ComponentProps<typeof Home>> = {}) => <UsTabInState go={go} state={usState} extra={extra} />

/**
 * A US tab screen: it shows its own state and sets the user status to it on arrival, so the floating "US Stocks
 * activation" switcher beside the phone matches. Picking another status there shows that state in place (with that
 * state's taps; the screen's own sheet and auto-advance belong to its state only).
 */
function UsTabInState({ go, state, extra }: { go: Go; state: UsState; extra: Partial<ComponentProps<typeof Home>> }) {
  const live: UsState = useUsJourney()
  const [arrived, setArrived] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => { setUsJourney(state); setArrived(true) }, [state])
  const shown = arrived ? live : state
  return <Home market="us" usState={shown} {...chrome(go)} {...usNav(go)} onWallet={() => go(walletFor[shown])} {...(shown === state ? extra : stateTaps(go, shown))} />
}

/** Each state's own taps on the Home (the card's button, a US stock), as on that state's screen. */
const stateTaps = (go: Go, usState: UsState): Partial<ComponentProps<typeof Home>> => {
  switch (usState) {
    case 'kyc': return { onActivateUs: () => go('kyc-01'), onUsStock: () => go('us-stocks-74') }
    case 'support': return { onActivateUs: () => emailSupport(t('us.support.subject')) }
    case 'activated': return { onActivateUs: () => go('us-stocks-20') }
    case 'onTheWay': return { onActivateUs: () => go('us-stocks-28') }
    case 'ready': return { onActivateUs: () => go('market-09') } // Explore US Stocks → Market with US picked
    case 'holding': return { onUsStock: (sym) => go(sym === 'NVDA' ? 'us-stocks-32' : 'us-stocks-31') }
    default: return {}
  }
}

/**
 * stocks-01: the Home in the user status picked in the prototype settings (src/shared/userStatus — KYC, US Stocks
 * activation, USD wallet, holdings). Picking a status shows its US tab. A US stock opens the stock page and the wallet
 * the wallet's US tab, which follow the same status (the wallet opens on the Indian tab until US Stocks is activated).
 */
function HomeInState({ go }: { go: Go }) {
  const usState: UsState = useUsJourney()
  const wallet = usState === 'kyc' || usState === 'activate' ? 'us-stocks-53' : 'us-stocks-54'
  return <Home market="us" usState={usState} {...chrome(go)} {...usNav(go)} {...stateTaps(go, usState)} onUsStock={() => go('us-stocks-13')} onWallet={() => go(wallet)} introOnOpen />
}

/**
 * Stocks — the Stocks tab, the app's home after login. Built from the live app's screenshots (shared 2026-10-17,
 * re-matched to the live app over ADB on 2026-10-22; there's no Figma for it yet). One long page; the board shows it as frames scrolled to each part.
 */
export const stocks: Flow = {
  id: 'stocks',
  title: 'Stocks',
  description: 'The Stocks tab — the home after login: indices, holdings, products, movers, watchlists, ideas.',
  figmaFile: '',
  options: [
    // Jojo's homepage versions (designs/lemonn-us-stocks-design.html "Homepage version"): applies to every Home screen.
    {
      id: 'homeVersion',
      group: 'Home',
      label: 'Homepage version',
      picker: 'dropdown',
      values: activeHomeVersions.map((v) => ({ value: v.id, label: `${v.id.toUpperCase()} · ${v.name}` })),
      default: DEFAULT_HOME_VERSION,
      // One tap on the floating "V8" button (phone) moves to the next version, on any screen (user, 5 Nov).
      quickSwitch: true,
      floatOn: ['stocks-01', 'stocks-02', 'stocks-03', 'stocks-04', 'stocks-05', 'stocks-06', 'stocks-07', 'stocks-09', 'stocks-10', 'stocks-11', 'stocks-13', 'stocks-14', 'stocks-15', 'stocks-16', 'stocks-17', 'stocks-18', 'stocks-21', 'stocks-22'],
    },
    // FTUX guide for the IND / US switch: dims the screen, lights the switch with a tooltip. Shown every time a Home
    // opens (and again after a version change) while on; tap anywhere or ✕ to end it.
    // "Do more with Lemonn" shortcuts: V1 circles, V2 one outlined card with dividers (default).
    // Archived 3 Nov: the "Header" setting (Holdings on page · Holdings in card). Holdings on page is the only header;
    // the card variant stays in Home.tsx (HEADER_CARD) but is no longer offered.
```

### `src/flows/stocks/screens/AnalystPicksPage.module.css`

```css
/* Top analyst picks page (stocks-29 / 30). */

.disclaimer {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

/* Pick cards are tappable but flat on the page: border only, no shadow. Their head and footer bring their own 12
   padding, so the card's 8 row gap goes too (it doubled the space above the hairline).
   L3 gap: a clickable Card always adds elevation-low and has no prop to turn it off. */
.card.card[data-interactive] {
  gap: 0;
  box-shadow: var(--card-border);
}

/* A pick card's head: name over its LTP, then the average target over the rating at the end. */
.name {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  min-width: 0;
}

.title {
  overflow: hidden;
  font: var(--l3-text-label-16);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.sub {
  font: var(--l3-text-description-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.end {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.target {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-16);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

/* The card's bottom row, under a hairline: expected profit · analysts who recommend it. */
.footer {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light);
}

/* 12 so both halves stay on one line at 360 wide. */
.meta {
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* History: the day a group of picks closed. */
.day {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/screens/AnalystPicksPage.tsx`

```tsx
// stocks-29 / 30: Top analyst picks — the page Home's "View all" (US tab) opens. Built from the live app's Trade Ideas
// page (phone screenshots, 3 Nov), without its F&O tab. The Actionbar carries back + the title, with flat (underline)
// tabs Stocks · History in its bottom slot, so they stay put while the page scrolls.
// Stocks: one card per pick — name over its LTP, the analysts' average target over their rating; under a hairline, the
// expected profit and how many analysts recommend it (Trade Ideas: entry range + "Not in range", potential profit, TP · SL).
// History: closed picks grouped by the day they closed (Today, Yesterday, then the date) — name over entry → exit price,
// the return over "Target hit in 24 days" / "Exited in 9 days".
// Differences from the screenshots (L3 wins): signed % with no ▲ / ▼ arrows (PriceChange), flat tabs instead of pills.
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Avatar } from '@l3/components/Avatar'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { ListCell } from '@l3/components/ListCell'
import { PriceChange } from '@l3/components/PriceChange'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { usePreview } from '../../../shared/prototype'
import { useLiveQuote } from '../../../shared/data/live'
import { usLogo, viewUsStock } from '../../../shared/data/usStocks'
import { Usd } from '../../../shared/money'
import { Screen } from '../../../shared/ui/Screen'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { analystCount, analystPicks, closedPicks, closedReturn, PICKS_TODAY, usStock, type AnalystPick, type ClosedPick } from '../components/us/data'
import styles from './AnalystPicksPage.module.css'

export type PicksTab = 'stocks' | 'history'

type AnalystPicksPageProps = {
  /** The tab it opens on (stocks-29: Stocks, stocks-30: History). */
  tab?: PicksTab
  /** A pick was tapped (already remembered with `viewUsStock`) → its US stock page. */
  onStock?: (sym: string) => void
}

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

/** An ISO date (2026-10-30) as days since 1970, so two dates subtract to a number of days. */
const dayNumber = (iso: string) => {
  const [y, m, d] = iso.split('-').map(Number)
  return Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d) / 86_400_000
}

/** History's heading for a closing day: Today, Yesterday, or "30 Oct 2026". */
function dayHeading(iso: string) {
  const daysAgo = dayNumber(PICKS_TODAY) - dayNumber(iso)
  if (daysAgo === 0) return t('picksPage.today')
  if (daysAgo === 1) return t('picksPage.yesterday')
  const [y, m, d] = iso.split('-').map(Number)
  return `${d} ${MONTHS[m - 1]} ${y}`
}

/** One open pick. Tapping it opens the stock. */
function PickCard({ pick, onOpen }: { pick: AnalystPick; onOpen: (sym: string) => void }) {
  const stock = usStock(pick.sym, pick.name)
  const live = useLiveQuote(pick.sym, stock.price, stock.change)
  // The average target is fixed by the analysts; the expected profit is measured from the snapshot price.
  const target = stock.price * (1 + pick.expectedProfit / 100)
  const total = analystCount(pick)
  return (
    <Card
      padding="none"
      className={styles.card}
      onClick={() => onOpen(pick.sym)}
      aria-label={t('picksPage.cardLabel', { name: pick.name, rating: pick.rating, pct: pick.expectedProfit.toFixed(2), analysts: pick.analystsPct, total })}
    >
      <Inset padding="12">
        <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="12">
          <Avatar src={usLogo(pick.sym)} initials={pick.sym.slice(0, 2)} size={40} />
          <span className={styles.name}>
            <span className={styles.title}>{pick.name}</span>
            <span className={styles.sub}>{t('picksPage.ltp')} <Usd value={live.price} layout="inline" /></span>
          </span>
          <span className={styles.end}>
            <span className={styles.target}><Usd value={target} layout="inline" /></span>
            <Tag variant="secondary" color={pick.rating === 'Strong Buy' ? 'success' : 'neutral'}>{t(`picksPage.rating.${pick.rating === 'Strong Buy' ? 'strongBuy' : 'buy'}`)}</Tag>
          </span>
        </Stack>
      </Inset>
      <div className={styles.footer}>
        <Inset padding="12">
          <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="08">
            <span className={styles.meta}>
              {t('picksPage.expectedProfit')} <PriceChange value={pick.expectedProfit} size="sm" />
            </span>
            <span className={styles.meta}>{t('picksPage.analysts', { pct: pick.analystsPct, total })}</span>
          </Stack>
        </Inset>
      </div>
    </Card>
  )
}

/** One closed pick: name over entry → exit price, the return over how it closed and after how long. */
function ClosedRow({ pick, onOpen }: { pick: ClosedPick; onOpen: (sym: string) => void }) {
  const ret = closedReturn(pick)
  const outcome = t(`picksPage.outcome.${pick.outcome}`, { days: pick.days })
  return (
    <ListCell
      variant="card"
      raised={false}
      onClick={() => onOpen(pick.sym)}
      iconLeft={<Avatar src={usLogo(pick.sym)} initials={pick.sym.slice(0, 2)} size={40} label={pick.name} />}
      labelSize="16"
      label={pick.name}
      description={<><Usd value={pick.entry} layout="inline" /> → <Usd value={pick.exit} layout="inline" /></>}
      trailing={<PriceChange value={ret} size="lg" />}
      caption={outcome}
      aria-label={t('picksPage.closedLabel', { name: pick.name, outcome, pct: ret.toFixed(2) })}
    />
  )
}

/** History: closed picks under a heading per closing day (the data is newest first). */
function History({ onOpen }: { onOpen: (sym: string) => void }) {
  const days = [...new Set(closedPicks.map((p) => p.closedOn))]
  return (
    <Stack gap="24">
      {days.map((day) => (
        <Stack key={day} gap="12">
          <h3 className={styles.day}>{dayHeading(day)}</h3>
          {closedPicks.filter((p) => p.closedOn === day).map((pick) => <ClosedRow key={pick.sym} pick={pick} onOpen={onOpen} />)}
        </Stack>
      ))}
    </Stack>
  )
}

export function AnalystPicksPage({ tab: initialTab = 'stocks', onStock }: AnalystPicksPageProps) {
  const { back, go } = usePreview()
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<PicksTab>(initialTab)
  const open = (sym: string) => { viewUsStock(sym); onStock?.(sym) }
  const tabs = (['stocks', 'history'] as const).map((value) => ({ value, label: t(`picksPage.tab.${value}`) }))
  return (
    <Screen
      top={
        <Actionbar
          title={t('picksPage.title')}
          headingLevel={2}
          onBack={() => { if (!back?.()) go('stocks-09') }}
          backLabel={t('picksPage.back')}
          bottom={<Tabs appearance="underline" width="fill" aria-label={t('picksPage.tabsLabel')} items={tabs} value={tab} onChange={(v) => setTab(v as PicksTab)} />}
        />
      }
    >
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="24">
        <Stack gap="16">
          {tab === 'stocks'
            ? <Stack gap="12">{analystPicks.map((pick) => <PickCard key={pick.sym} pick={pick} onOpen={open} />)}</Stack>
            : <History onOpen={open} />}
          <p className={styles.disclaimer}>{t('picksPage.disclaimer')}</p>
        </Stack>
      </Inset>
    </Screen>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/screens/BrandsPage.tsx`

```tsx
// stocks-31: Brands You Know — the page Home's "View all" (US tab) opens. A simple list: back + the title (how many
// stocks under it), then every brand (the eight on Home first) as list cards — logo, name, price and today's move, like
// a theme's "All stocks".
// The fine print closes the page.
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { usePreview } from '../../../shared/prototype'
import { useLiveQuote } from '../../../shared/data/live'
import { usLogo, viewUsStock } from '../../../shared/data/usStocks'
import { Usd } from '../../../shared/money'
import { Screen } from '../../../shared/ui/Screen'
import { StockListCard } from '../../../shared/ui/StockListCard'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { allBrands, usStock, type Brand } from '../components/us/data'
import styles from './BrandsPage.module.css'

type BrandsPageProps = {
  /** A brand was tapped (already remembered with `viewUsStock`) → its US stock page. */
  onStock?: (sym: string) => void
}

function BrandRow({ brand, onOpen }: { brand: Brand; onOpen: (sym: string) => void }) {
  const stock = usStock(brand.sym, brand.name)
  const live = useLiveQuote(brand.sym, stock.price, stock.change)
  return <StockListCard symbol={brand.sym} name={brand.name} logoUrl={usLogo(brand.sym)} price={<Usd value={live.price} layout="inline" />} changePct={live.changePct} onOpen={() => onOpen(brand.sym)} />
}

export function BrandsPage({ onStock }: BrandsPageProps) {
  const { back, go } = usePreview()
  const open = (sym: string) => { viewUsStock(sym); onStock?.(sym) }
  return (
    <Screen
      top={<Actionbar title={t('brandsPage.title')} description={t('brandsPage.count', { count: allBrands.length })} headingLevel={2} onBack={() => { if (!back?.()) go('stocks-09') }} backLabel={t('brandsPage.back')} />}
    >
      <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="24">
        <Stack gap="32">
          <Stack gap="12">
            {allBrands.map((brand) => <BrandRow key={brand.sym} brand={brand} onOpen={open} />)}
          </Stack>
          <p className={styles.footnote}>{t('brandsPage.footnote')}</p>
        </Stack>
      </Inset>
    </Screen>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/screens/Home.module.css`

```css
/*
 * Stocks home — page layout. A grey summary area (indices, holdings, products) and, over its bottom edge, the feed on
 * a rounded sheet (radius 32 at the top), like the live app. The grey area is intentional and high-emphasis (the
 * account summary), so a large surface/secondary block is allowed here (DESIGN_SYSTEM 7.2). The layout is L3 Stack /
 * Section; what those blocks don't cover lives here: uneven padding (16 / 48, 16 / 24), the feed's overlap and
 * top-only radius, the default surface and the accent tints.
 */
.summary {
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-24) 0 var(--l3-spacing-48); /* 24 under the index marquee, which sits above it */
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
}

.feed {
  position: relative;
  margin-top: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-24));
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-16) 0 var(--l3-spacing-24); /* 16 from the sheet's top edge to the first section */
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-32) var(--l3-radius-32) 0 0;
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

/* Smart Invest sits on the brand tint, edge to edge. */
.tinted[data-tint='brand'] {
  background: var(--l3-surface-accent-brand-light);
}

/*
 * Every clickable card on Home (L3 Cards and card-style ListCells, flat ones too) has its 1px edge and L3's soft
 * shadow (2026-11-04; it replaced the 2026-10-22 "edge only" call).
 */
.flatCards.flatCards [data-interactive][data-variant='default'] {
  box-shadow: var(--card-border), var(--l3-shadow-elevation-soft);
}

.flatCards.flatCards [data-interactive][data-variant='card'] {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light), var(--l3-shadow-elevation-soft); /* 1px: Figma stroke weight has no variable */
}


/* Home versions V3, V4: the L3 IND / US switch at the top of the feed's rounded sheet (the feed then starts under it). */
.sheetHead {
  position: relative;
  margin-top: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-24));
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-32) var(--l3-radius-32) 0 0;
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

/* The feed under that head starts right after its 16 (no 32 of its own on top). */
.feedTabbed.feedUnderHead {
  padding-top: 0;
}

/* Home version V9: no index ticker, so no band behind it. */
.marquee[data-ticker='off'] .band {
  display: none;
}

/* With the IND / US tabs above it (components/MarketTabs) the feed no longer overlaps the summary or rounds its top:
   the strip's line and notch are the sheet's top edge. */
.feedTabbed {
  margin-top: 0;
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-24); /* 24 under the tabs' line (the rounded sheet without tabs has 16) */
  border-radius: 0;
}

/*
 * The header. The top bar hangs from a sticky block with no height of its own (the spacer under it holds its 64 at the
 * top of the page), so hiding it never moves the page. The index marquee is the page's own strip, sticky right under
 * the top bar — no second copy. Its white band (12 above and below the strip, drawn behind it) fades in from the grey
 * summary as soon as the page scrolls. Scrolling down, the top bar slides up out of sight while the same marquee glides
 * up into its place, together, so the header reads as one block turning into a slimmer one; the compact tabs unfold
 * from under the band once the notched tabs have gone beneath it. No animation on arrival or with reduced motion.
 */
.header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 4; /* over the marquee (3), the feed and the notched tab (1); under sheets (--app-layer-sheet) */
  flex: none;
  height: 0;
}

.topBar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
}

.topBar[data-hidden] {
  translate: 0 -100%;
}

.spacer {
  flex: none;
  height: var(--l3-size-64); /* the top bar's height (TopBar.module.css) */
}

.marquee {
  --band-pad: var(--l3-spacing-12);

  position: sticky;
  top: var(--l3-size-64); /* right under the top bar */
  z-index: 3; /* over the summary and the notched tabs scrolling under it */
  flex: none;
}

/* Top bar away: up into its place, the band's 12 above the strip now inside the screen. */
.marquee[data-state='down'] {
  translate: 0 calc(var(--band-pad) - var(--l3-size-64));
}

.band {
  position: absolute;
  inset: calc(-1 * var(--band-pad)) 0;
  z-index: -1;
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary); /* the summary's grey: invisible at the top of the page */
}

.marquee:not([data-state='top']) .band {
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

.marquee:not([data-state='top']):not([data-tabs]) .band {
  box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px hairline */
}

/* The compact tabs hang under the band and unfold out of it (clipped, so they never show above its edge). */
.pinnedTabs {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + var(--band-pad));
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.pinnedTabs > * {
  translate: 0 -100%;
}

.pinnedTabs[data-open] {
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.pinnedTabs[data-open] > * {
  translate: 0 0;
}

/* One slow, smooth curve for every part, so they move as one. Colours don't fade: the band turns white at once, with
 * the top bar and the status bar. */
.header[data-animate] .topBar,
.marquee[data-animate],
.marquee[data-animate] .pinnedTabs > * {
  transition-duration: var(--l3-motion-duration-long);
  transition-timing-function: var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.header[data-animate] .topBar,
.marquee[data-animate],
.marquee[data-animate] .pinnedTabs > * {
  transition-property: translate;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .header[data-animate] .topBar,
  .marquee[data-animate],
  .marquee[data-animate] .pinnedTabs > * {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/*
 * Two-homes versions V10, V11: the IND / US switch rides in the sticky block above the ticker (12 between them), so it
 * stays on screen while the page scrolls. It sits on the block's band, so it has no background of its own.
 */
.stickySwitch {
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-12);
}

/*
 * V10: the pill group's track gets the page's white so it stands out on the grey summary (L3's track is
 * surface/secondary, the same grey — invisible here). Once scrolled the band turns white, so the track goes back to
 * grey. Only the round track itself (role=tablist): MarketSwitch's wrapper carries the same data-appearance, and painting
 * it too drew a square box with sharp corners around the pills. L3 gap: Tabs pill-group has no track-surface option.
 */
.stickySwitch[data-look='pill'] [role='tablist'][data-appearance='pill-group'] {
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px hairline */
}

.marquee:not([data-state='top']) .stickySwitch[data-look='pill'] [role='tablist'][data-appearance='pill-group'] {
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* The top cards' track: the market on show is in the flow (the track is its height); the other one sits just off
   screen beside it, so a swipe or a switch slides it into view. */
.cardTrack {
  position: relative;
}

.cardSlide[data-side] {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  width: 100%;
}

.cardSlide[data-side='after'] {
  left: 100%;
}

.cardSlide[data-side='before'] {
  right: 100%;
}

/*
 * V14: the page white all the way (surface/default) — the top bar, the sticky band, the summary and the feed, which
 * then needs no overlap or rounded top. Scrolled, the band keeps its 1px hairline.
 */
.header[data-white] .topBar > header,
.flatCards[data-white] .band,
.flatCards[data-white] .summary {
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

.flatCards[data-white] .summary {
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-12); /* + the ticker box's own 12 below the strip: 24, as on the other versions */
  padding-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-16); /* + the feed's own 16: 32 down to its first section, as between sections */
}

.flatCards[data-white] .feed {
  margin-top: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
}

/*
 * V14: the sticky block holds two containers, edge to edge — the tabs, then the ticker — with no band reaching outside
 * it (--band-pad 0: the band is the block). The ticker's 12 above and below are inside its own container, and every
 * index's tap area (its card) takes that full height, the 12s included; the dividers stay the strip's height.
 */
.marquee[data-white] {
  --band-pad: 0px;
}

.marquee[data-white] .stickySwitch {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.tickerBox {
  position: relative;
}

.tickerBox [role='region'] > * > [data-interactive] {
  padding-block: var(--l3-spacing-12);
}

.tickerBox [role='region'] > * > [aria-hidden='true'] {
  margin-block: var(--l3-spacing-12);
}

/*
 * V15 "One home": the grey summary is the user's, across markets (components/HubSummary). The white sheet over its edge
 * is the markets: its head — flat IN / US tabs and the ticker — sticks under the top bar (which stays put in V15), and
 * loses its rounded top there, with a hairline under it. The feed starts 24 under the head.
 */
.hubSummary {
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-08); /* the top bar's own spacing above; no ticker here */
}

.hubFeed {
  padding-top: 0;
}

.hubHead {
  position: sticky;
  top: var(--l3-size-64);
  z-index: 3;
  margin-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-32) var(--l3-radius-32) 0 0;
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

.hubHead[data-stuck] {
  border-radius: 0;
  box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px hairline */
}

/* V15 on white: no rounded sheet, so the market head is square too. */
.flatCards[data-white] .hubHead {
  border-radius: 0;
}

/* V16, US tab once holding (Figma 6441:3): the hero (UsHero) is the summary — its own surface and rounded foot — and the
   feed starts 20 under it, flat on the page (no overlapping rounded sheet). */
.summary[data-hero] {
  /* 12: the marquee's band hangs 12 under the ticker and would cover the hero's top (Figma: 32 from the band to the
     overline, not 20). */
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12) 0 0;
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
}
.feed[data-hero] {
  margin-top: 0;
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-20);
  border-radius: 0;
}

/* V16 with a hero on show (Figma 6441:3): the top bar, the tabs and the ticker's band take the hero's surface, so the
   top of the page is one block down to the hero's rounded foot (no change of colour after the ticker). Once scrolled
   they turn surface/default as on every version. Search and the wallet sit on surface/secondary circles, as in Figma. */
.header[data-hero-top] header:not([data-scrolled]) {
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
}
.header[data-hero-top] header:not([data-scrolled]) > button:not(:first-child) {
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
}
.marquee[data-hero-top][data-state='top'] .band {
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
}
```
