### `src/flows/stocks/screens/Home.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Aerobar } from '@l3/components/Aerobar'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { Section } from '@l3/components/Section'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { msCheckCircle, msCurrencyRupee } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { useAutoAdvance, useFlowOption, usePreview } from '../../../shared/prototype'
import { user } from '../../../shared/data/user'
import { viewUsStock } from '../../../shared/data/usStocks'
import { MainNav, rememberStocksHome, takeStocksTab, type Section as NavSection } from '../../../shared/ui/MainNav'
import { Screen } from '../../../shared/ui/Screen'
import { Disclosure, IdeaBaskets } from '../components/Ideas'
import { Announcement, Highlights, Sectors, SmartInvest } from '../components/Invest'
import { HoldingsSummary, HoldingsSwitcher, IndexStrip, ProductCards, type HoldingsView } from '../components/Overview'
import { ProductRowF1 } from '../components/ProductRowF1'
import { MarketSwitch, MarketTabs, PinnedMarketTabs, type Market } from '../components/MarketTabs'
import { DEFAULT_HOME_VERSION, homeVersion, type HomeVersion } from '../components/homeVersions'
import { MarketSwitchGuide } from '../components/MarketSwitchGuide'
import { HomeSwitcher } from '../components/HomeSwitcher'
import { HubSummary } from '../components/HubSummary'
import { TopBar } from '../components/TopBar'
import { DEPOSIT_ETA, depositOnTheWay } from '../../../shared/data/usDeposit'
import { DepositProgressSheet } from '../../../shared/ui/DepositProgressSheet'
import { TransferStatusCard } from '../components/us/TransferProgress'
import { activatedStates, inKycCard, usIndices, type ThemeId, type UsState } from '../components/us/data'
import { UsActivationCard } from '../components/us/UsActivationCard'
import { UsHome } from '../components/us/UsHome'
import { UsHero } from '../components/us/UsHero'
import { UsFtuxSheet } from '../components/us/sheets/UsFtuxSheet'
import { HeroButtons, HeroShell, HoldingsHero } from '../components/HoldingsHero'
import { getCompany } from '../../../shared/data/companies'
import { InShortcutsF1 } from '../components/InShortcutsF1'
import { holdings } from '../../../shared/data/portfolio'
import { inr } from '../../../shared/data/format'
import { UsHomeF1, UsRoundShortcuts } from '../components/us/UsHomeF1'
import { neighbour, useSwipeBetween } from '../components/useSwipeBetween'
import { Shortcuts, TopMovers, Watchlists } from '../components/Discover'
import { productsClassic, products, productsF1, productsF1Us, productsWithInvest, productsWithUs, type MoverList } from '../data'
import { t } from '../copy'
import styles from './Home.module.css'

/** Where the page is scrolled to — the board shows the long page as several frames, like the live app's screenshots. */
export type HomePart = 'top' | 'movers' | 'invest' | 'sectors' | 'highlights' | 'more'

/** The header's scroll state: 'top' (top bar alone), 'down' (top bar away, marquee sticky), 'up' (top bar back in over the sticky marquee). */
type ScrollState = 'top' | 'down' | 'up'
/** Scrolling this far in one direction (px, as in the US Stocks prototype) changes the direction. */
const DIRECTION_DELTA = 6

type Props = {
  scrollTo?: HomePart
  /** Which market tab is open: IN Stocks (default) or US Stocks. The tabs switch it in place. */
  market?: Market
  /** Which Top movers list is picked (board state). */
  movers?: MoverList
  /** The main navbar: go to another tab. */
  onTab?: (section: NavSection) => void
  /** Tapping the search field opens the Search screen (search-01), where the typing happens. */
  /** The search field: opens Search on the tab matching the market shown (IND → Stocks, US → US). */
  onSearch?: (market: Market) => void
  /** The profile icon opens Profile & settings (profile-01). */
  onProfile?: () => void
  /** The wallet icon in the top bar. */
  onWallet?: () => void
  /** V16 IND tab, the Commodities shortcut → the Commodities home. */
  onCommodities?: () => void
  /** V16 IND hero, Add money → the Add money screen (deposit-01). */
  onAddMoney?: () => void
  /** US tab: where the user is with US Stocks — picks the card on top and the toast (default: not activated). */
  usState?: UsState
  /** US tab: the card's button — Activate US Stocks / Retry / Add money / Explore, by `usState`. */
  onActivateUs?: () => void
  /** The US holdings card was tapped → Portfolio, Holdings, with the US Stocks card upfront. */
  onUsHoldings?: () => void
  /** The Indian holdings card: Portfolio, Holdings, on the Indian holdings. */
  onInHoldings?: () => void
  /** US tab: a US stock was tapped (already remembered with `viewUsStock`) → its stock page. */
  onUsStock?: (sym: string) => void
  /** US tab: "View all" / a theme (Market was handed what to open on) → the Market page. */
  onUsMarket?: () => void
  /** A theme card on the US tab → the theme's page. */
  onUsTheme?: (id: ThemeId) => void
  /** The US tab's ETFs shortcut → the ETF list. */
  onUsEtfs?: () => void
  /** A Discover ETFs row (the symbol is already remembered with `viewUsStock`) → the ETF page. */
  onUsEtf?: () => void
  /** US tab, Top analyst picks' View all → the Top analyst picks page. */
  onUsPicks?: () => void
  /** US tab: Brands You Know's View all → the Brands page. */
  onUsBrands?: () => void
  /** Prototype: after 2 s go on to this screen (the under-review Home moves on to "activated" by itself). */
  autoNext?: string
  /** A sheet over the page: the US Stocks intro, "activation submitted". */
  sheet?: ReactNode
  /** The app's first Home (stocks-01): the US Stocks intro sheet, with its waving flag, over it once (until closed). */
  introOnOpen?: boolean
}

/** The US Stocks intro shows once, ever (8 Nov, the user's call): closed once, it stays closed on later visits and
 *  reloads too (kept in this browser). It can still be seen any time as its own screen, stocks-11. */
const INTRO_SEEN_KEY = 'us-intro-seen'
let introShownThisLoad = (() => {
  try { return localStorage.getItem(INTRO_SEEN_KEY) === '1' } catch { return false }
})()

/** The intro was seen (closed here, or on stocks-11, after Lemonn KYC): the Home doesn't open it again. */
export const markUsIntroSeen = () => {
  introShownThisLoad = true
  try { localStorage.setItem(INTRO_SEEN_KEY, '1') } catch { /* storage off: once per load */ }
}

/**
 * stocks-01 … 07 · Stocks home — the app's first L1 screen (the Stocks tab).
 * Top bar: the screen's own (components/TopBar) — profile initials, a search pill, the wallet — as in the live app.
 * Cards on this screen have no shadow (designer's one-off call, 2026-10-22: screens/Home.module.css flatCards). The search field is the way into Search: tapping it opens the Search
 * screen (stocks tab, keyboard up) — nothing is typed here. Then, on a grey summary area: today's indices, the holdings and the
 * products; and on the rounded sheet over it, the feed: shortcuts, top movers, watchlists, Smart Invest (brand tint),
 * an announcement (the campaign's artwork), sectors, highlights, idea baskets and the broker's disclosure.
 */
/** Archived "Header" variant: true puts the holdings inside the top card (the card the US tab uses for activation). */
const HEADER_CARD = false as boolean

export function Home({ scrollTo = 'top', market = 'in', movers, onTab, onSearch, onProfile, onWallet, onCommodities, onAddMoney, usState = 'activate', onActivateUs, onUsHoldings, onInHoldings, onUsStock, onUsMarket, onUsTheme, onUsEtfs, onUsEtf, onUsPicks, onUsBrands, autoNext, sheet, introOnOpen = false }: Props) {
  // Money on the way: its card opens the deposit explainer over Home (the timed move to "money ready" waits while it's open).
  const [explaining, setExplaining] = useState(false)
  useAutoAdvance(explaining ? undefined : autoNext, 2000)
  // The US Stocks intro on opening the app (8 Nov, the user's ask): only once, over the Home in whatever status.
  // Only on the F1 versions (V16, V17: the jojo branch's work); the other versions keep their Home as it was.
  // Marked seen when it's closed (not when it mounts: the preview can mount a Home it doesn't show, which used it up).
  const [intro, setIntroOpen] = useState(() => introOnOpen && !introShownThisLoad)
  const setIntro = (open: boolean) => {
    if (!open) markUsIntroSeen()
    setIntroOpen(open)
  }
  const page = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  // The design version (the prototype's "Homepage version" option): where the IND / US switch sits and how it looks.
  const version = homeVersion(useFlowOption('stocks', 'homeVersion', DEFAULT_HOME_VERSION))
  // The market switch guide (prototype setting, on by default) shows every time this Home opens, and again for each
  // homepage version picked; ending it hides it for this version until the Home opens again.
  const guideOn = useFlowOption('stocks', 'switchGuide', 'off') === 'on'
  // Archived 3 Nov: the "Header" setting. The holdings are always on the page; flip this to see them inside the top card.
  const headerCard = HEADER_CARD
  const [guideDoneFor, setGuideDoneFor] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const guiding = guideOn && !sheet && guideDoneFor !== version.id
  const hasSwitch = version.place !== 'none'
  // Two homes (V10–V13): the switch changes the whole page, not only the feed, and stays on screen.
  const twoHomes = version.scope === 'page'
  // V14: white all the way — no grey summary, no rounded sheet (Home.module.css, [data-white]).
  const white = version.surface === 'white' || undefined
  // V15: you first, then the markets — its own summary, and the IN / US tabs + ticker sticky at the top of the feed.
  const hub = version.layout === 'hub'
  // V15: the market head has reached the top bar (it loses its rounded top and gets a hairline).
  const [headStuck, setHeadStuck] = useState(false)
  const hubHead = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  // V13: the market chip's "Choose market" sheet.
  // The navbar, or going back, brings the user back to the Stocks home on the IND / US tab they left it on.
  const { screenId, cameBack } = usePreview()
  const [chosenTab, setTab] = useState<Market>(() => (screenId && takeStocksTab(screenId, cameBack)) || market)
  // V1 has no switch: the page is the IND tab.
  const tab: Market = hasSwitch ? chosenTab : 'in'
  useEffect(() => {
    if (screenId) rememberStocksHome(screenId, tab)
  }, [screenId, tab])
  // The index strip slides in once the tab has changed (not on arrival).
  const [stripSlides, setStripSlides] = useState(false)
  // One header, no copies. The top bar hangs from a sticky, zero-height block (so it never moves the page); the page's
  // own index marquee is sticky under it. Scrolling: the marquee stays put and turns white. Scrolling down: the top bar
  // slides away and the same marquee glides up into its place; the compact tabs unfold from under it once the notched
  // ones have gone beneath it. Any upward scroll: the top bar slides back in and the marquee glides down under it.
  const [scrollState, setScrollState] = useState<ScrollState>(scrollTo === 'top' ? 'top' : 'up')
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(scrollTo !== 'top')
  // Not animated until the page has settled on arrival (a board frame opens already scrolled, with the header in place).
  const [animate, setAnimate] = useState(false)
  const pinnedNow = useRef(scrollTo !== 'top')
  // The compact tabs pin under the marquee only when the switch scrolls with the page (versions with it mid or on top).
  const hasTabsInPage = useRef(false)
  hasTabsInPage.current = !twoHomes && !hub && (version.place === 'mid' || version.place === 'top')
  // The switch lives in the top bar (V5, V12, V13): the bar never slides away — while scrolled it stays, surface/primary.
  const switchInBar = useRef(false)
  switchInBar.current = version.place === 'header' || version.place === 'picker' || hub
  const direction = useRef<'down' | 'up'>(scrollTo === 'top' ? 'down' : 'up')
  const lastTop = useRef(0)
  const spacer = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const marquee = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const band = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  // "Money ready": the toast shows on the US tab until it times out (6 s) — also when the tab is left and come back to.
  const [toastGone, setToastGone] = useState(false)
  const showToast = usState === 'ready' && tab === 'us' && !toastGone

  // Scrolled past the top: the top bar turns surface/primary (TopBar `scrolled`).
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false)

  // Where the feed starts, in the scroll container's coordinates: the strip's bottom edge.
  const feedTop = () => {
    const body = page.current?.parentElement
    const strip = page.current?.querySelector('[data-home="tabs"]')
    if (!body || !strip) return 0
    return strip.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - body.getBoundingClientRect().top + body.scrollTop
  }
  /**
   * Where the sticky header ends on screen (from the top of the scroll area) once it has settled in a state: the
   * marquee's white band (12 above and below the strip) under the top bar, or at the very top when the top bar is away;
   * plus the compact tabs when they're pinned.
   */
  const headerBottom = (state: ScrollState, withTabs: boolean) => {
    const strip = marquee.current?.offsetHeight ?? 0
    const pad = ((band.current?.offsetHeight ?? strip) - strip) / 2
    const bar = spacer.current?.offsetHeight ?? 0
    const bottom = state === 'down' ? pad + strip + pad : bar + strip + pad
    return bottom + (withTabs ? (page.current?.querySelector('[data-home="tabs"]') as HTMLElement | null)?.offsetHeight ?? 0 : 0)
  }
  /**
   * The header's scroll states (as the US Stocks prototype's: 'top' / 'down' / 'up', a 6 px delta before the direction
   * changes). 'top': the page is at its top. Scrolled: 'down' hides the top bar, 'up' shows it again (always 'up' when the switch is in the bar). The compact tabs
   * pin once the notched tabs have gone under the marquee's band.
   */
  const sync = () => {
    const body = page.current?.parentElement
    if (!body) return
    const top = body.scrollTop
    const delta = top - lastTop.current
    if (Math.abs(delta) >= DIRECTION_DELTA) {
      direction.current = delta > 0 ? 'down' : 'up'
      lastTop.current = top
    }
    const state: ScrollState = top > 0 ? (switchInBar.current ? 'up' : direction.current) : 'top'
    const pin = hasTabsInPage.current && feedTop() - top <= headerBottom(state, false)
    pinnedNow.current = pin
    setScrollState(state)
    setPinned(pin)
    setScrolled(top > 0)
    const head = hubHead.current
    setHeadStuck(!!head && head.getBoundingClientRect().top - body.getBoundingClientRect().top <= (spacer.current?.offsetHeight ?? 0))
  }
  // Scrolled by code (arrival, tab switch): not a gesture, so the direction stays as it is.
  const scrollBodyTo = (top: number) => {
    const body = page.current?.parentElement
    if (!body) return
    body.scrollTop = top
    lastTop.current = body.scrollTop
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    const body = page.current?.parentElement
    if (!body) return
    sync()
    body.addEventListener('scroll', sync, { passive: true })
    return () => body.removeEventListener('scroll', sync)
  }, [])

  // Board frames: open the page scrolled to a part (the screen's body is this page's scroll container), the target
  // right under the header (top bar + marquee + pinned tabs, as after scrolling down and back up a little). Keep
  // aligning (a frame at a time) until it settles.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const root = page.current
    const body = root?.parentElement
    const target = root?.querySelector(`[data-home="${scrollTo}"]`)
    if (!body || !target || scrollTo === 'top') {
      setAnimate(true)
      return
    }
    let frame = 0
    let tries = 0
    const align = () => {
      const covered = headerBottom('up', pinnedNow.current)
      const delta = target.getBoundingClientRect().top - body.getBoundingClientRect().top - covered
      if (Math.abs(delta) < 1 || tries++ > 8) {
        setAnimate(true)
        return
      }
      scrollBodyTo(body.scrollTop + delta)
      sync()
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(align)
    }
    align()
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame)
  }, [scrollTo])

  // IND ↔ US in place: tap the switcher or swipe the top card. A swipe slides the card across; a tap switches at once
  // (no slide-out first: it read as a ~1 s lag on phones, the user's call, 3 Nov). Either way the feed fades in.
  const switchTo = (next: Market) => {
    if (next === tab) return
    setStripSlides(true)
    setTab(next)
  }
  // Prototype: a new US Stocks state picked in the settings ("Home state") is shown on the US tab, where it changes things.
  const shownState = useRef(usState)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (usState === shownState.current) return
    shownState.current = usState
    switchTo('us')
  }, [usState])
  const markets: Market[] = ['in', 'us']
  const hasSwitchNow = useRef(hasSwitch)
  hasSwitchNow.current = hasSwitch
  // Swiping between IND and US only once both have a holdings card (US Stocks holds stocks); before that, the tabs only.
  const canSwipeNow = useRef(false)
  canSwipeNow.current = usState === 'holding'
  const swipe = useSwipeBetween({
    canGo: (direction) => hasSwitchNow.current && canSwipeNow.current && neighbour(markets, tab, direction) !== null,
    onSwitch: (direction) => switchTo(neighbour(markets, tab, direction)!),
    page: tab,
    area: '[data-market-card]',
    slides: () => [...(page.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-market-card]') ?? [])],
    fades: () => [...(page.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-market-part]') ?? [])],
  })
  useEffect(() => {
    const body = page.current?.parentElement ?? null
    swipe.bind(body)
    return () => swipe.bind(null)
  }, [])
  // Switching while scrolled: the page stays where it is (the other tab's feed at the same depth, header unchanged);
  // a shorter feed ends the page where it ends.
  const firstTab = useRef(true)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (firstTab.current) {
      firstTab.current = false
      return
    }
    const body = page.current?.parentElement
    // Two homes: the other market is another page, so it opens at its top.
    if (body && twoHomes) scrollBodyTo(0)
    // V15: switched with the market head stuck under the top bar: the other market's feed starts from its top.
    const head = hubHead.current
    if (body && head && headStuck) scrollBodyTo(body.scrollTop + head.parentElement!.getBoundingClientRect().top - body.getBoundingClientRect().top - (spacer.current?.offsetHeight ?? 0))
    if (body) lastTop.current = body.scrollTop
    sync()
  }, [tab, version.id])

  // Under a switch in the middle the feed starts right below it; otherwise it overlaps the summary on a rounded sheet.
  const switchInPage = (next: Market) => switchTo(next)
  // The US tab's summary: the status card (KYC → activation → add money → buy) in place of the holdings until every
  // step is done and the user holds a US stock; then the US holdings in dollars replace the card.
  const usCard = usState !== 'holding'
  // V16 (Figma 6441:3): the US tab's own design — the holdings hero (once holding) and the F1 feed.
  const f1 = version.usHome === 'f1'
  const f1Hero = f1 && !usCard
  // V16: the tab on show leads with a hero (IND always; US once holding), and the header takes the hero's surface so
  // the top of the page is one block (Figma: no change of colour between the ticker and the hero).
  // Every state on V16 (8 Nov): the holdings hero, or the state's card on the hero's surface (HeroShell), so the top
  // always ends in the same rounded foot — never the grey summary under the feed's overlapping sheet.
  const heroTop = f1
  // The glow takes the status card's colour until US Stocks is active (under review / contact support: honey; failed:
  // red); from activated on, unchanged.
  const preActivation = !activatedStates.includes(usState)
  // Just activated (the green card): a slight green, as soft as before activation (8 Nov).
  const justActivated = usState === 'activated'
  const shellTone = justActivated ? 'green' : !preActivation ? undefined : usState === 'failed' ? 'red' : usState === 'review' || usState === 'support' ? 'honey' : undefined
  // V2–V4 (the switch over the feed): the tabs are the feed's, not the page's. The top keeps "IN Stocks holdings" with its
  // own IN / US switch, whatever tab the feed is on; only the index marquee follows the tabs. The US activation card
  // moves into the US tab's feed — except Lemonn KYC pending, which takes the holdings' place (and leaves the feed).
  const feedTabs = version.place === 'mid' && !twoHomes
  const [holdingsView, setHoldingsView] = useState<HoldingsView>('overall')
  const onProduct = (id: string) => {
    if (id === 'us-stocks') switchTo('us')
    // Smart invest: down to the page's Smart Invest section, right under the header.
    if (id === 'smart-invest') {
      const target = page.current?.querySelector('[data-home="invest"]')
      const body = page.current?.parentElement
      if (target && body) body.scrollTo({ top: body.scrollTop + target.getBoundingClientRect().top - body.getBoundingClientRect().top - headerBottom('up', pinnedNow.current), behavior: 'smooth' })
    }
  }
  // While the Lemonn KYC is pending the product tiles under it are hidden (nothing can be traded yet).
  // The top of the summary. IND: "Start your KYC" while the Lemonn KYC is pending (nothing is verified, so Indian stocks
  // can't be traded either), else the holdings. US: the status card (KYC → activation → add money → buy) until the
  // user holds a US stock. Header card on: the holdings sit inside the card — on IND always, on US once activated (with
  // the state's next step, e.g. Add money, below them).
  const inCard = (node: ReactNode) => <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00">{node}</Inset>
  // A version without the IND / US switch: only the IND summary.
  const inSummaryTop = () => {
    return headerCard ? inCard(<UsActivationCard holdings={<HoldingsSummary onOpen={onInHoldings} />} />) : <HoldingsSummary onOpen={onInHoldings} />
  }
  // Lemonn KYC pending: one card, "Start your KYC", on both tabs (nothing, US Stocks included, works before it). Once US
  // Stocks is activated, each market's top card is a card, so holdings that would sit on the page go into the plain card there (as with Header "Holdings in card").
  const topCard = (market: Market) => {
    if (market === 'in') return <UsActivationCard holdings={<HoldingsSummary onOpen={onInHoldings} />} />
    if (headerCard && activatedStates.includes(usState)) return <UsActivationCard state={usState} holdings={<HoldingsSummary us onOpen={onUsHoldings} usEmpty={usState !== 'holding'} />} onCta={onActivateUs} />
    // Money on the way (V16 has its own, in the hero): the holdings card as when holding, at $0.00, with the small card under it.
    if (usState === 'onTheWay') return (
      <Stack gap="12">
        <UsActivationCard holdings={<HoldingsSummary us onOpen={onUsHoldings} usEmpty />} />
        <TransferStatusCard onOpen={() => setExplaining(true)} />
      </Stack>
    )
    return usCard ? <UsActivationCard state={usState} onCta={onActivateUs} /> : <UsActivationCard holdings={<HoldingsSummary us onOpen={onUsHoldings} />} />
  }
  // The top card is what slides sideways when the market switches — by a swipe on it (once both markets hold stocks)
  // or a tap on the switcher; the rest of the page dissolves into the other market's.
  // Both markets' cards sit side by side in one track (IND left, US right), the other one just off screen: a swipe drags
  // the track so the other card slides into view, and a tap on the switcher slides it across the same way.
  // FLAG: hand-made carousel — L3 has none.
  // V17: the product row (Figma 6548:45253) inside the hero, in place of its two buttons (Buy NVDA · Add USD, Buy
  // RELIANCE · Add INR), and under the status card where there's no hero (8 Nov).
  const heroCards = f1 && !!version.cards
  const onRowProduct = (id: string) => {
    if (id === 'mutual-funds') onTab?.('mutualFund')
    else if (id === 'fno') onTab?.('fno')
    else if (id === 'commodities') onCommodities?.()
    else if (id === 'etfs') onUsEtfs?.()
    // Themes: the prototype has no list of themes, so the first one (AI). Fractional: the hero's stock (NVDA), where any
    // amount from $1 buys a slice.
    else if (id === 'themes') onUsTheme?.('ai')
    else if (id === 'fractional') {
      viewUsStock('NVDA')
      onUsStock?.('NVDA')
    }
    else if (id === 'boosted-etfs') {
      // The ETF list opens on its Boosted tab (its sessionStorage hand-off, EtfListScreen).
      try { sessionStorage.setItem('etf:tab', 'leveraged') } catch { /* storage off: the Regular tab */ }
      onUsEtfs?.()
    }
  }
  // The US tab's row: Boosted ETFs, Themes, Fractional.
  const cardsRail = (m: Market) => <ProductRowF1 items={m === 'us' ? productsF1Us : productsF1} fill={m === 'us'} onProduct={onRowProduct} />
  const topCards = (
    <div className={styles.cardTrack} data-market-card>
      {markets.map((m) => (
        <div key={m} className={styles.cardSlide} data-side={m === tab ? undefined : m === 'us' ? 'after' : 'before'} aria-hidden={m !== tab || undefined} inert={m !== tab || undefined}>
          {m === 'us' && f1Hero ? (heroCards ? <UsHero onHoldings={onUsHoldings}>{cardsRail(m)}</UsHero> : <UsHero onHoldings={onUsHoldings} onBuy={onUsStock} onAddUsd={onWallet} />)
            : m === 'in' && f1 ? (
              // IND hero (no Figma): the US hero's look with the green glow. The products are in the shortcut strip under it.
              <HoldingsHero market="in" value={inr(holdings.current)} returnPct={holdings.returnPct} onHoldings={onInHoldings}>
                {/* As the US hero's pair. Buy RELIANCE does nothing yet: the prototype has no Indian stock page. V17: the
                    product cards instead. */}
                {heroCards ? cardsRail(m) : <HeroButtons
                  buy={{ label: t('f1.hero.buy', { sym: IN_HERO_STOCK }), mark: getCompany(IN_HERO_STOCK)?.logoUrl, round: true }}
                  add={{ label: t('f1.hero.addMoney'), icon: <Icon icon={msCurrencyRupee} size={20} />, onClick: onAddMoney }}
                />}
              </HoldingsHero>
            )
            // Money ready on V16: the holdings hero as when holding (the NVDA holding), no card; the "Your money is
            // ready" aerobar says it (8 Nov).
            : f1 && m === 'us' && usState === 'ready' ? (heroCards ? <UsHero onHoldings={onUsHoldings}>{cardsRail(m)}</UsHero> : <UsHero onHoldings={onUsHoldings} onBuy={onUsStock} onAddUsd={onWallet} />)
            // Money on the way on V16: the activated hero at $0.00 with the "Money on the way" card in place of its buttons (8 Nov).
            : f1 && m === 'us' && usState === 'onTheWay' ? (heroCards
              ? <UsHero empty onHoldings={onUsHoldings}><Stack gap="16"><TransferStatusCard onOpen={onActivateUs} />{cardsRail(m)}</Stack></UsHero>
              : <UsHero empty onHoldings={onUsHoldings}><TransferStatusCard onOpen={onActivateUs} /></UsHero>)
            : f1 ? <HeroShell market={m} tone={shellTone} subtle={preActivation || justActivated}>{heroCards ? <Stack gap="16">{inCard(topCard(m))}{cardsRail(m)}</Stack> : inCard(topCard(m))}</HeroShell>
            : inCard(topCard(m))}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
  const indexStrip = tab === 'us' ? <IndexStrip key="us" items={usIndices} label={t('us.indices.label')} slideIn={stripSlides} /> : <IndexStrip key="in" slideIn={stripSlides} />
  const feedClass = version.place !== 'mid' ? styles.feed : version.look === 'folder' ? `${styles.feed} ${styles.feedTabbed}` : `${styles.feed} ${styles.feedTabbed} ${styles.feedUnderHead}`

  // The intro's button: activate (not activated yet: KYC or the risk disclosure, as the Home's own card) or, once US
  // Stocks is active, explore it (the US tab). ✕ just closes it.
  const usActive = activatedStates.includes(usState)
  const introSheet = (
    <UsFtuxSheet
      cta={usActive ? t('us.ftux.ctaExplore') : undefined}
      onePlate
      onActivate={() => {
        setIntro(false)
        if (usActive) switchTo('us')
        else onActivateUs?.()
      }}
      onClose={() => setIntro(false)}
    />
  )

  return (
    <Screen
      sheet={sheet ?? (explaining ? <DepositProgressSheet deposit={depositOnTheWay()} eta={DEPOSIT_ETA} onClose={() => setExplaining(false)} /> : intro && f1 ? introSheet : guiding && <MarketSwitchGuide key={version.id} onView={() => switchInPage('us')} onClose={() => setGuideDoneFor(version.id)} />)}
      toast={showToast && <Aerobar type="success" floating icon={<Icon icon={msCheckCircle} />} heading={t('us.ready.title')} paragraph={t('us.ready.subtitle')} duration={6000} onClick={onActivateUs} onDismiss={() => setToastGone(true)} />}
      bottom={<MainNav value="stocks" onChange={onTab} />}
    >
      <div className={styles.header} data-animate={animate || undefined} data-white={white} data-hero-top={heroTop || undefined}>
        <div className={styles.topBar} data-hidden={scrollState === 'down' || undefined} inert={scrollState === 'down' || undefined}>
          <TopBar scrolled={scrolled} initials={initials(user.name)} onProfile={onProfile} onSearch={() => onSearch?.(tab)} onWallet={onWallet}
            compactSearch={twoHomes}
            placeholder={twoHomes && tab === 'us' ? t('search.placeholderUs') : undefined}
            market={version.place === 'picker' ? { value: tab, onSwitch: () => switchTo(tab === 'us' ? 'in' : 'us') } : undefined}
            start={version.place === 'header' && twoHomes && <MarketSwitch topBar appearance="pill-group" look={version} value={tab} onChange={switchInPage} />}
            end={version.place === 'header' && !twoHomes && <MarketSwitch compact appearance="pill-group" look={version} value={tab} onChange={switchInPage} />} />
        </div>
      </div>
      {/* Holds the top bar's place at the top of the page (the bar itself hangs from the sticky header above). */}
      <div ref={spacer} className={styles.spacer} aria-hidden="true" />
      <HomeSwitcher />
      <Stack ref={page} className={styles.flatCards} data-white={white}>
        {version.place === 'top' && !twoHomes && <MarketSwitchFor version={version} value={tab} onChange={(next) => switchTo(next)} />}
        {/* The page's one index marquee: sticky under the top bar, and up to the very top while the top bar is away. */}
        {/* V14: this block is the one container for the tabs and the ticker, each in its own container inside it. */}
        {!hub && <div ref={marquee} className={styles.marquee} data-white={white} data-home="top" data-state={scrollState} data-tabs={pinned || undefined} data-animate={animate || undefined} data-ticker={version.ticker ? undefined : 'off'} data-hero-top={heroTop || undefined}>
          <div ref={band} className={styles.band} aria-hidden="true" />
          {/* Two homes: the switch rides in the sticky block, above the ticker, so it never scrolls away. */}
          {version.place === 'top' && twoHomes && (
            <div className={styles.stickySwitch} data-look={version.look}>
              {version.look === 'underline'
                ? <MarketSwitch bare appearance="underline" look={version} value={tab} onChange={switchInPage} />
                : <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00"><MarketSwitch bare appearance="pill-group" look={version} value={tab} onChange={switchInPage} /></Inset>}
            </div>
          )}
          {/* V14: the ticker has a container of its own (the tabs' is the one above), 12 above and below inside it, and each
              index's tap area runs that full height (Home.module.css, .tickerBox). */}
          {!version.ticker ? null : white ? <div className={styles.tickerBox}>{indexStrip}</div> : indexStrip}
          {/* Two homes keep their switch in this block, so they have no compact tabs (hidden ones left a 1px underline peeking out under the band). */}
          {!twoHomes && (
            <div className={styles.pinnedTabs} data-open={pinned || undefined} inert={!pinned || undefined}>
              <PinnedMarketTabs value={tab} onChange={(next) => switchTo(next)} />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>}
        {hub ? (
          <div key="summary-hub" className={`${styles.summary} ${styles.hubSummary}`} data-home="top">
            <HubSummary usState={usState} onInHoldings={onInHoldings} onUsHoldings={onUsHoldings} onActivateUs={onActivateUs} onTransfer={() => setExplaining(true)} onProduct={onProduct} />
          </div>
        ) : feedTabs ? (
          <Stack key="summary-feed-tabs" gap="24" className={styles.summary}>
            {usState === 'kyc'
              ? <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="00"><UsActivationCard state="kyc" onCta={onActivateUs} /></Inset>
              : <HoldingsSwitcher view={holdingsView} onView={setHoldingsView} usEmpty={usState !== 'holding'} />}
            {usState !== 'kyc' && <ProductCards key={version.tiles} items={tiles[version.tiles]} onProduct={onProduct} />}
          </Stack>
        ) : (
          <Stack key="summary" gap="24" className={styles.summary} data-hero={heroTop || undefined}>
            {usState === 'kyc'
              ? (f1 ? <HeroShell market={tab} subtle>{inCard(<UsActivationCard spec={inKycCard} onCta={onActivateUs} />)}</HeroShell> : inCard(<UsActivationCard spec={inKycCard} onCta={onActivateUs} />))
              : hasSwitch ? topCards : inSummaryTop()}
            {/* The US tab has no tiles here (every version): its quick access is the shortcuts in the white body. No empty
                box either, or the summary's gap would leave 24 of extra grey under the card. */}
            {usState !== 'kyc' && tab === 'in' && !f1 && (
              <div data-market-part>
                <ProductCards key={version.tiles} items={tiles[version.tiles]} onProduct={onProduct} />
              </div>
            )}
          </Stack>
        )}
        {version.place === 'mid' && !hub && <MarketSwitchFor version={version} value={tab} onChange={(next) => switchTo(next)} />}
        {/* The white sheet stays; only what's on it changes (with the tiles above, in one movement). */}
        <div className={hub ? `${styles.feed} ${styles.hubFeed}` : feedClass} data-hero={heroTop || undefined}>
          {/* V15: the markets start here — flat IN / US tabs and that market's ticker, one sticky block under the top bar. */}
          {hub && (
            <div ref={hubHead} className={styles.hubHead} data-stuck={headStuck || undefined}>
              <MarketSwitch bare appearance="underline" look={version} value={tab} onChange={switchInPage} />
              <div className={styles.tickerBox}>{indexStrip}</div>
            </div>
          )}
          {tab === 'in' ? (
            <Stack key="in" gap="32" data-market-part>
              {f1 && !version.cards
                ? <InShortcutsF1 onMutualFunds={() => onTab?.('mutualFund')} onFno={() => onTab?.('fno')} onCommodities={onCommodities} />
                : <Shortcuts />}
              <div data-home="movers"><TopMovers initial={movers} /></div>
              <Watchlists />
              <Section paddingBlock="24" className={styles.tinted} data-tint="brand" data-home="invest"><SmartInvest /></Section>
              <Announcement />
              <div data-home="sectors"><Sectors /></div>
              <div data-home="highlights"><Highlights /></div>
              <div data-home="more"><IdeaBaskets /></div>
              <Disclosure />
            </Stack>
          ) : f1 && version.usBody === 'classic' ? (
            // V18: V17's top over V14's US feed, with V17's round shortcuts in place of its strip (the hero has the card).
            <Stack key="us" gap="32" data-market-part>
              <UsHome card={false} shortcuts={<UsRoundShortcuts onEtfs={onUsEtfs} onPicks={onUsPicks} />} usState={usState} onActivate={onActivateUs} onStock={onUsStock} onMarket={onUsMarket} onTheme={onUsTheme} onEtfs={onUsEtfs} onEtf={onUsEtf} onPicks={onUsPicks} onBrands={onUsBrands} />
            </Stack>
          ) : f1 ? (
            <Stack key="us-f1" gap="32" data-market-part>
              <UsHomeF1 roundShortcuts={heroCards} onStock={onUsStock} onMarket={onUsMarket} onTheme={onUsTheme} onEtfs={onUsEtfs} onEtf={onUsEtf} onPicks={onUsPicks} />
            </Stack>
          ) : (
            <Stack key="us" gap="32" data-market-part>
              <UsHome card={feedTabs && !hub && usState !== 'kyc'} usState={usState} onActivate={onActivateUs} onStock={onUsStock} onMarket={onUsMarket} onTheme={onUsTheme} onEtfs={onUsEtfs} onEtf={onUsEtf} onPicks={onUsPicks} onBrands={onUsBrands} />
            </Stack>
          )}
        </div>
      </Stack>
    </Screen>
  )
}

const tiles = { classic: productsClassic, today: products, withUs: productsWithUs, withInvest: productsWithInvest }

/** The stock the V16 IND hero offers to buy (Reliance: India's largest company, as NVDA on the US hero). */
const IN_HERO_STOCK = 'RELIANCE'

/**
 * The IND / US switch of a version that has it in the page: the notched folder tabs (V2, V7, V8), or L3 Tabs — a pill
 * group (V3, V6, V9) or underline tabs (V4). In the middle, the L3 Tabs sit at the top of the feed's rounded sheet.
 */
function MarketSwitchFor({ version, value, onChange }: { version: HomeVersion; value: Market; onChange: (market: Market) => void }) {
  if (version.look === 'folder') return <MarketTabs value={value} onChange={onChange} look={version} place={version.place === 'top' ? 'top' : 'mid'} />
  const appearance = version.look === 'underline' ? 'underline' : 'pill-group'
  if (version.place !== 'mid') return <MarketSwitch onTop={version.place === 'top'} appearance={appearance} look={version} value={value} onChange={onChange} />
  return <div className={styles.sheetHead}><MarketSwitch bare appearance={appearance} look={version} value={value} onChange={onChange} /></div>
}

/** "Rohan Mehta" → "RM": the profile's initials. */
function initials(name: string) {
  return name.split(' ').map((part) => part.charAt(0)).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/screens/ThemePage.module.css`

```css
/* The theme overview card: name over its one-line description, the return (with its period switcher) on the right. */
.about {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.name {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-18);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

.desc {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-description-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

/* The return column: the period switcher's tap area is stretched over all of it, out to the card's top, bottom and
   right edges (the card's 12 padding), so a tap anywhere on the period or the return switches it. */
.returns {
  position: relative;
  align-self: stretch;
  justify-content: center;
}

.periodSwitch.periodSwitch {
  position: static;
}

.periodSwitch.periodSwitch::before {
  inset: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-12));
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
  transform: none;
}

/* How returns are counted and that it's not a recommendation, under the stocks. */
.footnote {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

/* Clips the themes either side of the current one (they show only while a swipe or a tap slides them in). Sideways
   only, and it never shrinks below its content: the page under the tabs scrolls vertically as usual. */
.viewport {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  min-height: 100%;
  overflow-x: clip;
}

/* The sliding track (a swipe drags it sideways): fills the page so a swipe can start anywhere under the tabs. */
.body {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 100%;
}

/* The themes before and after: one page width off either side of the current one, top-aligned with it. */
.panel[data-side='before'],
.panel[data-side='after'] {
  position: absolute;
  inset-block-start: 0;
  inline-size: 100%;
}

.panel[data-side='before'] {
  inset-inline-start: -100%;
}

.panel[data-side='after'] {
  inset-inline-start: 100%;
}
```

### `src/flows/stocks/screens/ThemePage.tsx`

```tsx
// stocks-23 … 28: Themes — every theme of "Explore by themes" on one page, laid out like the ETFs page (us-stocks-71).
// The Actionbar carries back + "Themes" with the themes as flat (underline) tabs, each with its icon, in its bottom slot,
// so they stay put while the page scrolls and switching theme never leaves the page. Switching slides the body sideways:
// a tap slides the new theme in from its side; a left / right swipe on the body drags it with the finger, and the next (or previous) theme — laid beside it, as in a
// carousel — comes into view with it (the stocks flow's `useSwipeBetween`). A theme card on Home opens it on that theme (one
// screen per theme: stocks-23 AI & chips … 28 Dollar parking); "View all" opens it on the first.
// Under the tabs, for the picked theme, two sections:
// 1. About it, kept short — one card: its name and a one-line description, its return on the right (1Y; an L3 Select
//    switcher above it steps to 3Y and 1M).
// 2. "All stocks": its stocks as list cards.
// The fine print (how returns are counted, not a recommendation) closes the page.
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { PriceChange } from '@l3/components/PriceChange'
import { Section } from '@l3/components/Section'
import { SectionHeader } from '@l3/components/SectionHeader'
import { Select } from '@l3/components/Select'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { msDevices, msElectricCar, msHealthCross, msMemory, msPaid, msSavings } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { usePreview } from '../../../shared/prototype'
import { useLiveQuote } from '../../../shared/data/live'
import { usLogo, viewUsStock } from '../../../shared/data/usStocks'
import { Usd } from '../../../shared/money'
import { Screen } from '../../../shared/ui/Screen'
import { StockListCard } from '../../../shared/ui/StockListCard'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { neighbour, useSwipeBetween } from '../components/useSwipeBetween'
import { themeById, themeMonthReturn, themes, usStock, type ThemeId } from '../components/us/data'
import styles from './ThemePage.module.css'

type ThemePageProps = {
  /** The theme it opens on (the card that was tapped; View all → the first). */
  theme: ThemeId
  /** A stock was tapped (already remembered with `viewUsStock`) → its page. */
  onStock?: (sym: string) => void
  /** Back (the screen before, wherever the page was opened from). */
  onBack?: () => void
}

/** Each theme's icon on its pill. */
const THEME_ICONS: Record<ThemeId, string> = {
  ai: msMemory,
  bigtech: msDevices,
  dividend: msPaid,
  ev: msElectricCar,
  health: msHealthCross,
  parking: msSavings,
}

function ThemeStock({ sym, onOpen }: { sym: string; onOpen: (sym: string) => void }) {
  const stock = usStock(sym)
  const live = useLiveQuote(sym, stock.price, stock.change)
  return <StockListCard symbol={sym} name={stock.name} logoUrl={usLogo(sym)} price={<Usd value={live.price} layout="inline" />} changePct={live.changePct} onOpen={() => onOpen(sym)} />
}

/** The return periods the switcher steps through, starting on 1Y. */
const PERIODS = ['1y', '3y', '1m'] as const
type Period = (typeof PERIODS)[number]

/**
 * About the theme, kept short: its name and one line on what it is, with its return on the right. The period above the
 * return is an L3 Select switcher (↕): each tap steps 1Y → 3Y → 1M. Its tap area covers the whole right part of the card
 * (period and return, edge to edge), so it's easy to hit.
 */
function ThemeOverview({ id }: { id: ThemeId }) {
  const theme = themeById(id)
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<Period>('1y')
  const pct = period === '1m' ? themeMonthReturn(theme.symbols) : theme.returns[period]
  const next = () => setPeriod(PERIODS[(PERIODS.indexOf(period) + 1) % PERIODS.length])
  return (
    <Card aria-label={t(`us.theme.${id}`)}>
      <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="16">
        <Stack gap="04" className={styles.about}>
          <h3 className={styles.name}>{t(`us.theme.${id}`)}</h3>
          <p className={styles.desc}>{t(`us.theme.${id}.desc`)}</p>
        </Stack>
        <Stack gap="04" align="end" className={styles.returns}>
          <Select size="sm" subtle icon="swap" onClick={next} className={styles.periodSwitch} aria-label={t('us.themes.periodSwitch')}>
            {t(`us.themes.period.${period}`)}
          </Select>
          <PriceChange value={pct} size="lg" />
        </Stack>
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  )
}

/** One theme's page under the tabs: its overview card, "All stocks", the fine print. */
function ThemeBody({ id, onOpen }: { id: ThemeId; onOpen: (sym: string) => void }) {
  const theme = themeById(id)
  return (
    <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="24">
      <Stack gap="32">
        <ThemeOverview id={id} />
        <Section gap="16">
          <SectionHeader title={t('us.themes.allStocks')} description={t('us.themes.stocks', { count: theme.symbols.length })} headingLevel={3} />
          <Stack gap="12">
            {theme.symbols.map((sym) => <ThemeStock key={sym} sym={sym} onOpen={onOpen} />)}
          </Stack>
        </Section>
        <p className={styles.footnote}>{t('us.themes.footnote')}</p>
      </Stack>
    </Inset>
  )
}

export function ThemePage({ theme: initialTheme, onStock, onBack }: ThemePageProps) {
  const { back, go } = usePreview()
  const [id, setId] = useState<ThemeId>(initialTheme)
  const goBack = onBack ?? (() => { if (!back?.()) go('stocks-09') })
  const open = (sym: string) => { viewUsStock(sym); onStock?.(sym) }
  const order = themes.map((item) => item.id)
  const tabs = themes.map((item) => ({ value: item.id, label: t(`us.theme.${item.id}`), iconLeft: <Icon icon={THEME_ICONS[item.id]} /> }))

  // The body that slides, and the side the next theme comes in from (1: from the right, -1: from the left).
  const body = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const comingFrom = useRef<1 | -1 | 0>(0)
  const swipe = useSwipeBetween({
    page: id,
    canGo: (direction) => neighbour(order, id, direction) !== null,
    onSwitch: (direction) => {
      const next = neighbour(order, id, direction)
      // The track has already slid the neighbour into place: no slide-in after it.
      if (next) setId(next)
    },
    slides: () => (body.current ? [body.current] : []),
    fades: () => [],
  })
  // A tap on a tab. The theme next door: the same carousel slide as a swipe. Further away: it slides straight in from
  // its side (no slide-out first, so it answers at once).
  const pick = (next: ThemeId) => {
    const step = order.indexOf(next) - order.indexOf(id)
    if (!step) return
    if (Math.abs(step) === 1) return swipe.go(step as 1 | -1, () => setId(next))
    comingFrom.current = step > 0 ? 1 : -1
    setId(next)
  }
  // Runs after the swipe hook has reset the body: the new theme glides in from where the old one left.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const from = comingFrom.current
    comingFrom.current = 0
    const el = body.current
    if (!from || !el || matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return
    el.animate([{ translate: `${from * el.offsetWidth}px 0` }, { translate: '0 0' }], { duration: 280, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)' })
  }, [id])

  return (
    <Screen
      top={
        <Actionbar
          title={t('us.themes.pageTitle')}
          headingLevel={2}
          onBack={goBack}
          backLabel={t('us.themes.back')}
          bottom={<Tabs appearance="underline" aria-label={t('us.themes.railLabel')} items={tabs} value={id} onChange={(v) => pick(v as ThemeId)} />}
        />
      }
    >
      <div className={styles.viewport}>
        <div ref={(el) => { body.current = el; swipe.bind(el) }} className={styles.body}>
          {/* The theme before and after sit just off-screen on either side, so a swipe brings them into view. Keyed by
              theme: the one that slides in stays the same page once it becomes the current one. */}
          {[neighbour(order, id, -1), id, neighbour(order, id, 1)].map((themeId, at) => themeId && (
            <div key={themeId} className={styles.panel} data-side={['before', 'current', 'after'][at]} inert={at !== 1} aria-hidden={at !== 1 || undefined}>
              <ThemeBody id={themeId} onOpen={open} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Screen>
  )
}
```

### `src/shared/copy.ts`

```ts
/**
 * UI copy. Every user-facing string of a flow lives in ONE file, `src/flows/<flow-id>/copy.json` — flat keys
 * ("empty.title") → the text. Screens read it through the flow's `t`:
 *
 *   t('empty.title')                       → "No search results found"
 *   t('group.results', { list, count })    → "Stocks (8)"   ({name} placeholders are filled in)
 *
 * Sample data (stock names, prices, watchlists) stays in the flow's data.ts — copy.json is only the words the app
 * itself says: titles, labels, buttons, empty states, accessible names. Porting a flow: this file is the string
 * table (Flutter ARB / iOS Localizable.strings).
 */
export type CopyVars = Record<string, string | number>

export function makeCopy<Copy extends Record<string, string>>(flow: string, copy: Copy) {
  return function t(key: keyof Copy & string, vars?: CopyVars): string {
    const template = copy[key] ?? key
    return vars ? template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (m, name: string) => (name in vars ? String(vars[name]) : m)) : template
  }
}
```

### `src/shared/data/broker.ts`

```ts
// The broker behind the Lemonn app — shown wherever the app needs its regulatory line (Stocks home, Profile).

/** The broker's regulatory line, in full. */
export const disclosure =
  'The online broking and mutual fund execution services are provided by NU Investors Technologies Pvt. Ltd. | CIN U67200MH2021PTC364704 | SEBI Registration No. INZ000304837 | SEBI DP Registration No. IN-DP-712-2022 | SEBI Research Analyst Registration No. INH000016764 | NSE member code 90251.'
```

### `src/shared/data/companies.ts`

```ts
// The company catalogue — every Indian listed stock the prototype shows, with what a card, a list row or the stock
// (asset) page needs: identity, logo, profile and a real market snapshot.
//
// - Logos come from the design system (@l3/assets/company-logos).
// - Profiles (founded, headquarters, website, one line about the business) are written here — public facts.
// - Market data (price, day / 52-week range, volume, 3 months of daily closes, sector, industry) comes from
//   market-snapshot.json, refreshed from Yahoo Finance by `npm run market:snapshot` (see scripts/market-snapshot.mjs).
//   Near-live, not live: the bundled copy is used at first, then the app re-reads ./market-snapshot.json (published
//   next to the page; refreshed every 15 minutes in market hours by the site's GitHub Action) on load and every
//   5 minutes. `companies` / `getCompany()` then return the newer numbers; call `useMarketSnapshot()` in a screen
//   that shows prices so it re-renders when they change.
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'
import { companyLogo } from '@l3/assets/company-logos'
import bundled from './market-snapshot.json'

export type Exchange = 'NSE' | 'BSE'

export type CompanyProfile = {
  /** NSE trading symbol — the key everywhere (RELIANCE). */
  symbol: string
  /** How the app writes it (Reliance Industries). */
  name: string
  /** Two letters for the Avatar when there's no logo. */
  initials: string
  exchanges: Exchange[]
  founded: number
  headquarters: string
  website: string
  /** One sentence on the business. */
  about: string
}

export type DailyClose = { date: string; close: number }

export type MarketData = {
  /** Last traded price, ₹. */
  price: number
  prevClose: number
  /** Day change, ₹ and %. */
  change: number
  changePct: number
  dayHigh: number
  dayLow: number
  high52: number
  low52: number
  volume: number | null
  sector: string | null
  industry: string | null
  /** Daily closes, oldest first (about 3 months) — for sparklines and the stock page chart. */
  closes: DailyClose[]
}

export type Company = CompanyProfile & {
  /** Logo image URL from the design system, or undefined (show `initials`). */
  logoUrl?: string
  /** The snapshot's market data, or undefined if the symbol wasn't fetched. */
  market?: MarketData
}

const both: Exchange[] = ['NSE', 'BSE']
const company = (symbol: string, name: string, initials: string, founded: number, headquarters: string, website: string, about: string): CompanyProfile => ({
  symbol, name, initials, exchanges: both, founded, headquarters, website, about,
})

/** Profiles, by NSE symbol (one line each — scripts/market-snapshot.mjs reads the symbols from here). */
export const profiles = {
  ADANIENT: company('ADANIENT', 'Adani Enterprises', 'AE', 1988, 'Ahmedabad', 'adanienterprises.com', 'The Adani Group’s incubator — airports, roads, data centres, mining and new energy.'),

export type CompanySymbol = keyof typeof profiles

type Snapshot = { source: string; fetchedAt: string; quotes: Record<string, Partial<MarketData> & { closes?: DailyClose[] }> }

/** When the market data shown now was fetched (ISO date-time) and from where. Updated in place by the runtime refresh. */
export const marketSnapshot = { fetchedAt: bundled.fetchedAt, source: bundled.source }

function toCompany(p: CompanyProfile, snapshot: Snapshot, fallback?: MarketData): Company {
  const q = snapshot.quotes[p.symbol]
  return { ...p, logoUrl: companyLogo(p.symbol), market: q?.price != null ? (q as MarketData) : fallback }
}

/** Every company with logo and market data, by NSE symbol. */
export const companies = Object.fromEntries(Object.values(profiles).map((p) => [p.symbol, toCompany(p, bundled as Snapshot)])) as Record<CompanySymbol, Company>

// ── Runtime refresh ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()

function apply(snapshot: Snapshot) {
  if (!(snapshot.fetchedAt > marketSnapshot.fetchedAt)) return // ISO strings sort by time; never go back to older data
  // A symbol the published file doesn't have yet (added to the catalogue after the site's copy) keeps the numbers we have.
  for (const p of Object.values(profiles)) companies[p.symbol as CompanySymbol] = toCompany(p, snapshot, companies[p.symbol as CompanySymbol]?.market)
  Object.assign(marketSnapshot, { fetchedAt: snapshot.fetchedAt, source: snapshot.source })
  listeners.forEach((l) => l())
}

/** Re-read the published snapshot (same origin — no API call). Fails quietly: the numbers we have stay. */
export async function refreshMarket() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('market-snapshot.json', { cache: 'no-cache' })
    if (res.ok) apply(await res.json())
  } catch { /* offline, or the file isn't there — keep what we have */ }
}

const REFRESH_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  refreshMarket()
  setInterval(() => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') refreshMarket() }, REFRESH_MS)
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') refreshMarket() })
}

function subscribe(listener: () => void) {
  listeners.add(listener)
  return () => { listeners.delete(listener) }
}

/** Re-renders the calling component when fresher market data arrives; returns its `fetchedAt`. */
export function useMarketSnapshot(): string {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => marketSnapshot.fetchedAt)
}

/** One company by NSE symbol (undefined if it isn't in the catalogue). */
export function getCompany(symbol: string): Company | undefined {
  return (companies as Record<string, Company | undefined>)[symbol]
}

/** All companies, sorted by today's change — for "top gainers / losers" style lists. */
export function companiesByChange(direction: 'gainers' | 'losers'): Company[] {
  const list = Object.values(companies).filter((c) => c.market)
  return list.sort((a, b) => (direction === 'gainers' ? b.market!.changePct - a.market!.changePct : a.market!.changePct - b.market!.changePct))
}
```

### `src/shared/data/format.ts`

```ts
/** ₹ with Indian grouping: inr(123456.5) → "₹1,23,456.50"; inr(1000, 0) → "₹1,000". */
export const inr = (n: number, decimals = 2) =>
  '₹' + n.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: decimals, maximumFractionDigits: decimals })

/** $ with US grouping: usd(1234.5) → "$1,234.50"; usd(1000, 0) → "$1,000". */
export const usd = (n: number, decimals = 2) =>
  '$' + n.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: decimals, maximumFractionDigits: decimals })

/** "9876543210" → "98765 43210" (how Indian mobile numbers are read out). */
export const phone = (digits: string) => (digits.length > 5 ? `${digits.slice(0, 5)} ${digits.slice(5)}` : digits)

/** Keep the last `visible` characters: mask('ABCPM1234K', 1, 5) → "ABCPM****K". */
export const mask = (s: string, keepStart: number, keepEnd: number) =>
  s.slice(0, keepStart) + '•'.repeat(Math.max(0, s.length - keepStart - keepEnd)) + s.slice(s.length - keepEnd)
```

### `src/shared/data/live.ts`

```ts
// Live-looking prices for the prototype. Every price on screen moves a little around its real value (the market
// snapshots: market-snapshot.json for Indian stocks, us-market-snapshot.json for US), ticking every 2 s.
// FLAG: simulated movement — there is no free live feed a browser page can call (Yahoo sends no CORS header; Finnhub
// and the like need a key). The level is real (the snapshot); only the wiggle around it is made up. Each symbol moves
// on its own smooth path (a few slow sine waves), never more than ±0.6 % from the snapshot, the same on every device.
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'

const TICK_MS = 2000

let tick = 0
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()

function subscribe(onChange: () => void) {
  listeners.add(onChange)
  if (!timer) {
    timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.visibilityState === 'hidden') return
      tick += 1
      listeners.forEach((l) => l())
    }, TICK_MS)
  }
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(onChange)
    if (!listeners.size && timer) {
      clearInterval(timer)
      timer = undefined
    }
  }
}

/** Re-render every ticking price now (fresher snapshot data arrived), one tick early. */
export function nudgeLive() {
  tick += 1
  listeners.forEach((l) => l())
}

/** The live clock: a number that goes up by one every 2 s while anything on screen listens. */
export function useLiveTick(): number {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => tick, () => 0)
}

/** A stable number in [0, 1) for a symbol (its path's phase and speed). */
function hash(key: string, salt: number) {
  let n = 2166136261 ^ salt
  for (const c of key) n = Math.imul(n ^ c.charCodeAt(0), 16777619)
  return ((n >>> 0) % 10000) / 10000
}

/** How far a symbol has moved from its snapshot price at a tick: a fraction, within ±0.006. */
export function liveDrift(key: string, at: number): number {
  const a = hash(key, 1), b = hash(key, 2), c = hash(key, 3)
  return 0.0035 * Math.sin(at * (0.21 + a * 0.2) + a * 6.28) + 0.0018 * Math.sin(at * (0.73 + b * 0.4) + b * 6.28) + 0.0007 * Math.sin(at * (1.9 + c) + c * 6.28)
}

export type LiveQuote = {
  price: number
  /** Day change, % (against yesterday's close, so it moves with the price). */
  changePct: number
  /** Day change in the price's currency. */
  change: number
  /** Which way the last tick went: for a brief up / down flash. */
  moved: 'up' | 'down' | 'none'
}

/** A price and its day change % as they are at a tick (yesterday's close is worked back from the snapshot's %). */
export function liveQuote(key: string, price: number, changePct: number, at: number): LiveQuote {
  const prevClose = price / (1 + changePct / 100)
  const now = price * (1 + liveDrift(key, at))
  const before = price * (1 + liveDrift(key, at - 1))
  const round = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100
  const p = round(now)
  return {
    price: p,
    change: round(p - prevClose),
    changePct: round(((p - prevClose) / prevClose) * 100),
    moved: at === 0 || round(before) === p ? 'none' : p > round(before) ? 'up' : 'down',
  }
}

/** A price that ticks: `useLiveQuote('NVDA', 204.64, -4.22)`. */
export function useLiveQuote(key: string, price: number, changePct: number): LiveQuote {
  return liveQuote(key, price, changePct, useLiveTick())
}
```

### `src/shared/data/marketHandoff.ts`

```ts
/**
 * What another screen asks the Market page to open on — e.g. Home's "View all" on Top Movers opens Market on the US
 * list, Top gainers, with the cap picked on Home. The caller sets it right before going to Market; Market reads it once
 * when it opens (and clears it), so going back to Market later shows its defaults again. In a real app this is the
 * navigation argument of the Market route.
 */
export type MarketHandoff = {
  market: 'in' | 'us'
  /** A Market list tab id ('all', 'gainers', 'losers', 'under-100', 'under-500'). */
  tab?: string
  /** Market filters, by group: 'sort' and 'index' take one id, the others a list (see src/flows/market/data.ts). */
  filters?: Partial<{ sort: string; index: string; quick: string[]; cap: string[]; sector: string[] }>
}

let pending: MarketHandoff | null = null

/** Ask the Market page to open on this market / tab / filters (call it right before going to Market). */
export function handToMarket(handoff: MarketHandoff) {
  pending = handoff
}

/** The Market page: what was handed to it, once (then it's cleared). */
export function takeMarketHandoff(): MarketHandoff | null {
  const handoff = pending
  pending = null
  return handoff
}
```

```ts
// The US Stocks deposit on its way (paid in ₹, not yet in the USD wallet). Shared because Home's "Money on the way"
// card and the US wallet both explain it with the same sheet (shared/ui/DepositProgressSheet).

/** A deposit paid on the bank's page: $ that will land, ₹ that left the bank, and which bank. */
export type SentDeposit = { usd: number; inr: string; bank: string }

/** When a deposit paid now is ready to trade (the prototype's fixed day). */
export const DEPOSIT_ETA = 'by Thu 8 PM'

/** Shown when no deposit was paid in this session (a screen opened straight from the list). */
const SAMPLE_DEPOSIT: SentDeposit = { usd: 1035.37, inr: '₹91,320', bank: 'HDFC Bank ••7821' }

let sent: SentDeposit | null = null

/** Remember the deposit being paid (Add money → the bank's page). */
export const setSentDeposit = (deposit: SentDeposit) => {
  sent = deposit
}

/** The deposit last paid, or the sample. Kept: it's shown until it lands. */
export const depositOnTheWay = (): SentDeposit => sent ?? SAMPLE_DEPOSIT
```

### `src/shared/data/usStocks.ts`

```ts
// US stocks — data more than one flow uses (the US Stocks flow, the Stocks home's US tab, the Market tab's US list).
// Prices are real: us-market-snapshot.json, from Yahoo Finance by `npm run us:snapshot` (scripts/us-market-snapshot.mjs),
// overrides the catalogue's numbers below and adds every other stock / ETF the app shows. `live.ts` makes them tick.
// Near-live, not live: the bundled copy is used at first, then the app re-reads ./us-market-snapshot.json (published by
// the build, refreshed every 15 minutes in US market hours by the site repo's Action, scripts/site-workflow-us.yml) on
// load and every 5 minutes, and updates the numbers below in place.
// Logos are in src/shared/assets/us-logos: full-colour SVGs (scripts/us-logos.mjs), PNGs for the few without one (L3 has company logos for Indian stocks only).
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'
import bundled from './us-market-snapshot.json'
import { nudgeLive } from './live'

export type UsStock = {
  sym: string
  name: string
  price: number
  /** Day change, %. */
  change: number
  exchange: string
  /** Logo path (asset()) — overrides the catalogue logo. */
  logo?: string
  /** Logo plate colour behind a transparent logo. */
  plate?: string
}

export const catalogue: Record<string, Omit<UsStock, 'sym'>> = {
  NVDA: { name: 'NVIDIA Corp', price: 188.42, change: 1.24, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  AAPL: { name: 'Apple Inc', price: 262.82, change: 0.89, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  MSFT: { name: 'Microsoft Corp', price: 523.61, change: -0.42, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  GOOGL: { name: 'Alphabet Inc', price: 251.46, change: 0.92, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  GOOG: { name: 'Alphabet Inc', price: 252.03, change: 0.9, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  TSLA: { name: 'Tesla Inc', price: 433.72, change: 2.15, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  AMZN: { name: 'Amazon.com Inc', price: 224.21, change: -0.37, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  META: { name: 'Meta Platforms', price: 734, change: 0.64, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  NFLX: { name: 'Netflix Inc', price: 1187, change: -1.12, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  NKE: { name: 'Nike Inc', price: 64.3, change: 0.48, exchange: 'NYSE' },
  MCD: { name: 'McDonald’s Corp', price: 301.55, change: -0.21, exchange: 'NYSE' },
  KO: { name: 'Coca-Cola Co', price: 69.42, change: 0.18, exchange: 'NYSE' },
  SBUX: { name: 'Starbucks Corp', price: 84.1, change: -0.66, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  V: { name: 'Visa Inc', price: 344.7, change: 0.37, exchange: 'NYSE' },
  UBER: { name: 'Uber Technologies', price: 96.2, change: 1.05, exchange: 'NYSE' },
  AMD: { name: 'Advanced Micro Devices', price: 214.9, change: 3.12, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  AVGO: { name: 'Broadcom Inc', price: 342.37, change: 2.87, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  MU: { name: 'Micron Technology', price: 192.4, change: 1.4, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  LULU: { name: 'Lululemon Athletica', price: 168.3, change: -1.6, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  JPM: { name: 'JPMorgan Chase', price: 296.2, change: 0.31, exchange: 'NYSE' },
  // Mid and small caps — so the Market tab's cap filters have stocks in every tier.
  LYFT: { name: 'Lyft Inc', price: 22.4, change: 1.8, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  ETSY: { name: 'Etsy Inc', price: 61.2, change: -0.9, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
  SONO: { name: 'Sonos Inc', price: 14.1, change: -1.3, exchange: 'NASDAQ' },
}

type SnapshotQuote = { name: string | null; exchange: string | null; price: number; changePct: number; open?: number | null; prevClose: number; dayHigh: number | null; dayLow: number | null; high52: number | null; low52: number | null; volume: number | null; closes: number[] }
type IndexQuote = { price: number; changePct: number }
type Snapshot = { source: string; fetchedAt: string; quotes: Record<string, SnapshotQuote>; indices: Record<string, IndexQuote>; fx?: { usdInr?: { price: number } } }

// The numbers in use now — the bundled snapshot's, replaced in place when a fresher one is read (see the runtime refresh).
const quotes: Record<string, SnapshotQuote> = { ...(bundled.quotes as unknown as Record<string, SnapshotQuote>) }
const indices: Record<string, IndexQuote> = { ...(bundled.indices as Record<string, IndexQuote>) }
const current = { fetchedAt: bundled.fetchedAt, source: bundled.source, usdInr: (bundled as unknown as Snapshot).fx?.usdInr?.price }

/** "Apple Inc." → "Apple Inc", "Airbnb, Inc." → "Airbnb Inc": the snapshot's legal names, as the app writes them. */
const tidyName = (name: string) => name.replace(/,? (Inc|Corp|Corporation|Co|Ltd|Plc|N\.V|S\.A)\.?$/i, (m) => ' ' + m.replace(/[,.]/g, '').trim()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()

// The snapshot's real price, day change and exchange for every symbol in it; the catalogue's own names stay.
function applyQuotes() {
  for (const [sym, q] of Object.entries(quotes)) {
    if (q.price == null) continue
    const known = catalogue[sym]
    catalogue[sym] = { name: known?.name ?? tidyName(q.name ?? sym), price: q.price, change: q.changePct, exchange: q.exchange ?? known?.exchange ?? 'NASDAQ' }
  }
}
applyQuotes()

/** When the US prices were taken (ISO time). */
export const usSnapshotAt = (): string => current.fetchedAt

/** The snapshot's full quote of a symbol (day range, 52-week range, volume, a month of closes), if it has one. */
export const usQuote = (symbol: string): SnapshotQuote | undefined => quotes[symbol]

/** Today's value of a US index (`sp-500`, `nasdaq`, `dow-jones`) from the snapshot. */
export const usIndexQuote = (id: string): IndexQuote | undefined => indices[id]

/** ₹ per $ in the snapshot (USDINR=X), or undefined if it has none. */
export const usdInrSnapshot = (): number | undefined => current.usdInr

// ── Runtime refresh ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()

function apply(next: Snapshot) {
  if (!(next.fetchedAt > current.fetchedAt)) return // ISO strings sort by time; never go back to older data
  // A symbol the published file doesn't have yet (added to the app after the site's copy) keeps the numbers we have.
  Object.assign(quotes, next.quotes)
  Object.assign(indices, next.indices)
  Object.assign(current, { fetchedAt: next.fetchedAt, source: next.source, usdInr: next.fx?.usdInr?.price ?? current.usdInr })
  applyQuotes()
  listeners.forEach((l) => l())
  nudgeLive() // every ticking price re-renders now, not at the next tick
}

/** Re-read the published US snapshot (same origin — no API call). Fails quietly: the numbers we have stay. */
export async function refreshUsMarket() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('us-market-snapshot.json', { cache: 'no-cache' })
    if (res.ok) apply(await res.json())
  } catch { /* offline, or the file isn't there — keep what we have */ }
}

const REFRESH_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  refreshUsMarket()
  setInterval(() => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') refreshUsMarket() }, REFRESH_MS)
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') refreshUsMarket() })
}

function subscribe(listener: () => void) {
  listeners.add(listener)
  return () => { listeners.delete(listener) }
}

/** Re-renders the calling component when fresher US data arrives; returns its `fetchedAt`. */
export function useUsMarketSnapshot(): string {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => current.fetchedAt)
}

// A full-colour SVG (the mark on its brand colour, edge to edge — scripts/us-logos.mjs) wins over the older PNG (a mark on
// transparent, which shows on the L3 Avatar's grey); the PNG stays for the few symbols that have no SVG.
const logoFiles = import.meta.glob('../assets/us-logos/*.{png,svg}', { eager: true, query: '?url', import: 'default' }) as Record<string, string>
const symbolOf = (path: string) => path.slice(path.lastIndexOf('/') + 1, path.lastIndexOf('.'))
const logoBySymbol = new Map(
  Object.entries(logoFiles)
    .sort(([a], [b]) => Number(a.endsWith('.svg')) - Number(b.endsWith('.svg')))
    .map(([path, url]) => [symbolOf(path), url]),
)

/** Symbols that have a logo file in src/shared/assets/us-logos. */
export const usLogoSymbols: string[] = [...logoBySymbol.keys()].sort()

/** The logo of a US company (SVG or PNG URL), or undefined (show initials). */
export const usLogo = (symbol: string): string | undefined => logoBySymbol.get(symbol)

// Logos from financialmodelingprep.com (2 Nov, ETF holdings) are transparent marks drawn for a white page: they sit on
// a static white plate so dark marks (Intuitive Surgical, Rocket Lab, Sony) show in dark mode too; the white marks
// (Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Samsung) sit on black.
const PLATED_WHITE = new Set('ABB ADI AMAT ASML ASTS BABA BIDU COP GE GRMN HXSCL ISRG KLAC LRCX MRVL MUFG NVO NXPI PDD RKLB RTX SAP SONY TM TSM TXN'.split(' '))
const PLATED_BLACK = new Set(['LMT', 'NOC', 'SSNLF'])
/** The plate a US logo needs inside an Avatar ('white' / 'black'), or undefined when the file brings its own. */
export const usLogoPlate = (symbol: string): 'white' | 'black' | undefined =>
  PLATED_BLACK.has(symbol) ? 'black' : PLATED_WHITE.has(symbol) ? 'white' : undefined

// The stock being looked at: a list (Market tab, Search …) sets it, the stock page reads it.
let viewed: string | undefined

/** Remember which US stock the stock page should open. */
export const viewUsStock = (symbol: string) => { viewed = symbol }

/** The symbol set by the last `viewUsStock`, or undefined if none yet. */
export const viewedUsStock = () => viewed
```
